lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GotMyKoffingInCinnabar
lines.text: I got my KOFFING in CINNABAR.\pIt's usually nice, but it breathes\npoison when it's angry.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GymIsGreatFullOfWomen
lines.text: Heheh! This GYM is great!\nIt's full of women!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerIsBadForCitysImage
lines.text: CELADON takes pride in its efforts\nto keep the city beautiful.\pThat's why the new GAME CORNER is\nbad for our city's image.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_BlewItAllAtSlots
lines.text: Moan…\nI blew it all at the slots!\pI knew I should have cashed in my\nCOINS for prizes!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_MyTrustedPalPoliwrath
lines.text: This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.\pIt evolved from a POLIWHIRL when\nI used a WATER STONE.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_Poliwrath
lines.text: POLIWRATH: Ribi ribit!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GetLostOrIllPunchYou
lines.text: What are you staring at?\nGet lost, or I'll punch you.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_KeepOutOfTeamRocketsWay
lines.text: Keep out of TEAM ROCKET's way!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_ExplainXAccuracyDireHit
lines.text:
TRAINER TIPS\pX ACCURACY boosts the accuracy of
techniques.\pDIRE HIT jacks up the likelihood
of critical hits.\pGet your items at the CELADON
DEPT. STORE!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: CELADON CITY\nThe City of Rainbow Dreams$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_MansionSign
lines.text: CELADON MANSION$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign
lines.text: Find what you need at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GuardSpecProtectsFromStatus
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pGUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON\nfrom status-reduction moves during\lbattle.\pGet your items at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_PrizeExchangeSign
lines.text: COINS exchanged for prizes!\nPRIZE EXCHANGE$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign
lines.text: ROCKET GAME CORNER\nThe playground for grown-ups!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_ScaldedTongueOnTea
lines.text:
Aaaagh, ow…
I scalded my tongue!\pThis nice old lady in the MANSION
gave me some TEA.\pBut it was boiling hot!
Gotta cool it to drink it.$

lines.label: Text_SoftboiledTeach
lines.text:
Hello, there!\pI've seen you about, but I never
had a chance to chat.\pIt must be good luck that brought
us together finally.\pI'd like to celebrate by teaching
you the move SOFTBOILED.$

lines.label: Text_SoftboiledDeclined
lines.text: I'll always be keeping an eye out\nfor you.\pI hope we can chat again.$

lines.label: Text_SoftboiledWhichMon
lines.text: So, who's the POKéMON that gets\nthe chance to learn SOFTBOILED?$

lines.label: Text_SoftboiledTaught
lines.text: I wish you the best of luck!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Text_SomeoneStoleSilphScope
lines.text: Oh, what am I to do…\pSomeone stole our SILPH SCOPE.\pThe thief came running this way,\nI'm sure of it.\pBut I lost sight of him!\nWhere'd he go?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Meowth
lines.text: MEOWTH: Meow!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_TryThisDrinkInstead
lines.text: You shouldn't spend all your money\non drinks.\pTry this instead.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_NothingBeatsThirstLikeTea
lines.text: Nothing beats thirst like some hot\nTEA.\pIt really is the best.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_MyDearMonsKeepMeCompany
lines.text: My dear POKéMON keep me company.\nMEOWTH even brings money home!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_DaisyComesToBuyTea
lines.text:
Oh, hello, dearie.
Did you enjoy my TEA?\pBy the way, dear. Are you, by any
chance, from PALLET TOWN?\pA girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,
she enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE
to buy some TEA.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Clefairy
lines.text: CLEFAIRY: Pi pippippi!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Nidoran
lines.text: NIDORAN♀: Kya kyaoo!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_ManagersSuite
lines.text: CELADON MANSION\nManager's Suite$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_2F_Text_GameFreakMeetingRoom
lines.text: GAME FREAK Meeting Room$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
lines.text: Me?\nI'm the programmer!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
lines.text: I'm the graphic artist!\nI drew you!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_IWroteTheStory
lines.text: I wrote the story!\nIsn't ERIKA cute?\pI like MISTY a lot, too!\nOh, and SABRINA, I like her!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImGameDesignerShowMeFinishedPokedex
lines.text: Is that right?\pI'm the game designer!\pFilling up your POKéDEX is tough,\nbut don't quit!\pWhen you finish, come tell me!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_CompletedPokedexCongratulations
lines.text: Wow! Excellent!\nYou completed your POKéDEX!\lCongratulations!\l…$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsTheGameProgram
lines.text: It's the game program! Messing with\nit could bug out the game!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_SomeonesPlayingGame
lines.text: Someone's playing a game instead of\nworking!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsScriptBetterNotLookAtEnding
lines.text: It's the script!\nBetter not look at the ending!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_GameFreakDevelopmentRoom
lines.text: GAME FREAK Development Room$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_Roof_Text_IKnowEverything
lines.text: I KNOW EVERYTHING!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_TheresNothingIDontKnow
lines.text:
There is nothing that I don't know,
like I wrote on the blackboard.\pI know about the world of POKéMON
in your GAME BOY ADVANCE!\pGet together with your friends and
enjoy trading POKéMON!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ObtainedAnEevee
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained an EEVEE!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_BoxIsFull
lines.text: ポケモンが　いっぱいだ\nボックスを　かえて　きなさい$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_WirelessAdapterLecture
lines.text: POKéMON Lecture\pPlaying with the Wireless Adapter$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ReadWhichHeading
lines.text: Which heading do you want to read?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
lines.text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is\nupstairs at any POKéMON CENTER.\pVisit one to link up with friend(s)\nusing your Wireless Adapter.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainDirectCorner
lines.text:
To link only with a friend, go to
the DIRECT CORNER.\pIt is the right counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo into the TRADE CORNER or the
COLOSSEUM with your friend.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainUnionRoom
lines.text:
To link and communicate with
anyone, go to the UNION ROOM.\pIt is the left counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo to the UNION ROOM and enjoy
meeting other TRAINERS.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_PamphletOnTMs
lines.text: It's a pamphlet on TMs.\p… …\pThere are fifty TMs in all.\pThere are also seven HMs that\ncan be used repeatedly.\pSILPH CO.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
lines.text: Hello!\nWelcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE.\pThe board on the right describes\nthe store layout.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorDescriptions
lines.text: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET\p3F: TV GAME SHOP\p4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\p5F: DRUGSTORE\pROOFTOP SQUARE: VENDING MACHINES$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_ServiceCounter
lines.text: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_SuperRepelMorePowerfulRepel
lines.text: SUPER REPEL keeps weak POKéMON at\nbay…\pHmm, it's a more powerful REPEL.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_BuyReviveForLongOutings
lines.text: For long outings, you should buy\nREVIVE.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: Top-Grade Items for TRAINERS!\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LanceComesToBuyCapes
lines.text: We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTStandsForOriginalTrainer
lines.text: Captured POKéMON are registered\nwith an ID No. and the OT.\pOT stands for “Original TRAINER” -\nthe TRAINER that caught it first.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_BuddyTradingKangaskhanForHaunter
lines.text: All right!\pMy buddy's going to trade me his\nKANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_HaunterEvolvedOnTrade
lines.text: Come on, HAUNTER!\pI love HAUNTER!\nI collect them!\pHuh?\pHAUNTER turned into a different\nPOKéMON while being traded!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanIdentifyTradeMonsByID
lines.text: You can identify POKéMON you get\nin trades by their ID Numbers.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItsSuperNES
lines.text: It's a Super NES.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRPG
lines.text: An RPG!\nThere's no time for that!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_SportsGame
lines.text: A sports game!\nDad'll like that!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_PuzzleGame
lines.text: A puzzle game!\nLooks addictive!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_FightingGame
lines.text: A fighting game!\nLooks tough!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_TVGameShop
lines.text: 3F: TV GAME SHOP$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RedGreenBothArePokemon
lines.text: Red and Green!\nBoth are POKéMON!$

lines.label: Text_CounterTeach
lines.text:
Oh, hi!
I finally finished POKéMON.\pNot done yet? How about I teach
you a good move?\pThe move I have in mind is
COUNTER.\pNot like the one I'm leaning on,
mind you!$

lines.label: Text_CounterDeclined
lines.text: You're not interested? Come see\nme if you change your mind.$

lines.label: Text_CounterWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nCOUNTER to?$

lines.label: Text_CounterTaught
lines.text: Are you using that COUNTER move\nI taught your POKéMON?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_GettingPokeDollAsPresent
lines.text: I'm getting a present for my\ngirlfriend.\pI guess a POKé DOLL will be it.\nIt's the popular thing.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_CanRunAwayWithPokeDoll
lines.text: I heard something useful.\pIf a wild POKéMON appears, you can\ndistract it with a POKé DOLL.\pYou can run away while the wild\nPOKéMON is distracted.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: Express yourself with gifts!\n4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\pEvolution Special!\nElement STONES on sale now!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ExplainStatEnhancers
lines.text:
POKéMON stat enhancers can be
bought only here.\pHP UP increases the base HP of a
POKéMON.\pCALCIUM raises the base SP. ATK
stat of one POKéMON.\pZINC boosts the base SP. DEF stat
of one POKéMON.\pCARBOS enhances the base SPEED
stat.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_HereForStatEnhancers
lines.text:
I'm here for POKéMON stat
enhancers.\pPROTEIN increases the base ATTACK
power.\pIRON increases the base DEFENSE
stat.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Drugstore
lines.text: 5F: DRUGSTORE$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyGiveHerDrink
lines.text: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!\p{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_GiveWhichDrink
lines.text: Give her which drink?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayFreshWaterHaveThis
lines.text: Yay!\pFRESH WATER!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

lines.label: Text_ReceivedItemFromLittleGirl
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the little girl.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM16
lines.text: TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof special attacks by your foe.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YaySodaPopHaveThis
lines.text: Yay!\pSODA POP!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM20
lines.text: TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.\pIt's a move that prevents status\nproblems among your POKéMON.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayLemonadeHaveThis
lines.text: Yay!\pLEMONADE!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM33
lines.text: TM33 contains REFLECT.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof physical attacks by your foe.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
lines.text: You don't have space for this!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImNotThirstyAfterAll
lines.text: No, thank you!\nI'm not thirsty after all!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_MySisterIsImmature
lines.text: My sister is a TRAINER, believe it\nor not.\pBut, she's so immature, she drives\nme nuts!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyIWantDrink
lines.text: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: ROOFTOP SQUARE:\nVENDING MACHINES$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_VendingMachineWhatDoesItHave
lines.text: A vending machine!\nWhat does it have?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NotEnoughMoney
lines.text: Oops, not enough money!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DrinkCanPoppedOut
lines.text: A can of {STR_VAR_1} popped out!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NoMoreRoomForStuff
lines.text: There's no more room for stuff!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NotThirsty
lines.text: Not thirsty!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CanExchangeCoinsNextDoor
lines.text: Welcome!\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nfabulous prizes next door.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WelcomeBuySomeCoins
lines.text: Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!\pDo you need some game COINS?\nWould you like to buy some?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ComePlaySometime
lines.text: No?\nPlease come play sometime!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SorryDontHaveCoinCase
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry.\nYou don't have a COIN CASE.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
lines.text: Whoops!\nYour COIN CASE is full.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CantAffordCoins
lines.text: You can't afford the COINS.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreYourCoins
lines.text: Thank you.\nHere are your COINS!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RumoredTeamRocketRunsThisPlace
lines.text: Keep this quiet.\pIt's rumored that this place is run\nby TEAM ROCKET.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ThinkMachinesHaveDifferentOdds
lines.text: I think these machines have\ndifferent odds.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DoYouWantToPlay
lines.text: Kid, do you want to play?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received10CoinsFromMan
lines.text: {PLAYER} received 10 COINS\nfrom the man.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedMyCoins
lines.text: You don't need my COINS!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinsComeAndGo
lines.text: Wins seem to come and go.\nNothing's a sure thing.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinOrLoseItsOnlyLuck
lines.text: These slot games…\nWin or lose, it's only by luck.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Hey!\pYou have better things to do,
champ in the making!\pCELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.\pShe is a user of GRASS-type
POKéMON, and at one with nature.\pShe might appear docile because of
her flower arranging…\pBut she's not one to be taken
lightly!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RareMonsForCoins
lines.text: They offer rare POKéMON that can\nbe exchanged for your COINS.\pBut, I just can't seem to win!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SoEasyToGetHooked
lines.text: Games are scary!\nIt's so easy to get hooked!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WantSomeCoins
lines.text: What's up?\nWant some COINS?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20CoinsFromNiceGuy
lines.text: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the nice guy.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouHaveLotsOfCoins
lines.text: You have lots of COINS!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedMoreCoinsForMonIWant
lines.text: Darn! I need more COINS for the\nPOKéMON I want!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreSomeCoinsShoo
lines.text: Hey, what? You're throwing me off!\nHere are some COINS, so shoo!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20CoinsFromMan
lines.text: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the man.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouveGotPlentyCoins
lines.text: You've got plenty of your own\nCOINS!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WatchReelsClosely
lines.text: The trick is to watch the reels\nclosely.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text: I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: Dang!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBattle
lines.text: The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might\nbe discovered!\pI better tell BOSS!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SwitchBehindPosterPushIt
lines.text: Hey!\pA switch behind the poster!?\nLet's push it!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsRequired
lines.text: A COIN CASE is required…$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveCoinCase
lines.text: Oops!\nDon't have the COIN CASE!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SlotMachineWantToPlay
lines.text: A slot machine!\nWant to play?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutOfOrder
lines.text: OUT OF ORDER\nThis is broken.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutToLunch
lines.text: OUT TO LUNCH\nThis is reserved.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SomeonesKeys
lines.text: Someone's keys!\nThey'll be back.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_FancyThatPorygon
lines.text: I sure do fancy that PORYGON!\nBut, it's hard to win at slots!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_RakedItInToday
lines.text: Gahaha! I raked it in today!\nIf only every day were like this…$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_CoinCaseRequired
lines.text: A COIN CASE is required…$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WeExchangeCoinsForPrizes
lines.text: We exchange your COINS for prizes.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WhichPrize
lines.text: Which prize would you like?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_HereYouGo
lines.text: はい どうぞ$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantPrize
lines.text: So, you want the {STR_VAR_1}?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantTM
lines.text: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2}\nis what you want?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_NeedMoreCoins
lines.text: Sorry, you'll need more COINS\nthan that.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_OopsNotEnoughRoom
lines.text: おきゃくさん もう もてないよ$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_OhFineThen
lines.text: あっ そう$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle
lines.text: You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadgeTakeThis
lines.text: The RAINBOWBADGE will make\nPOKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.\pIt also allows POKéMON to use\nSTRENGTH in and out of battle.\pPlease also take this with you.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM19FromErika
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM19\nfrom ERIKA.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19
lines.text: TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.\pHalf the damage it inflicts is\ndrained to heal your POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree that it's a\nwonderful move?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForThis
lines.text: You should make room for this.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro
lines.text: I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayDefeat
lines.text: You're too rough!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle
lines.text: Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetIntro
lines.text: Oh, welcome.\nI was getting bored.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetDefeat
lines.text: My makeup!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle
lines.text: GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaIntro
lines.text: …Weren't you peeking in here\nearlier?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaDefeat
lines.text: You're an eye-opener!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro
lines.text: Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaDefeat
lines.text: No!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle
lines.text: We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro
lines.text: Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nYou!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle
lines.text: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro
lines.text: Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nSplendid!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle
lines.text: I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
lines.text: Welcome to CELADON GYM!\pYou'd better not underestimate\nthe nice ladies here.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nBeaten!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
lines.text: I didn't bring my best POKéMON.\nWait until next time!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_ThisHotelIsForPeople
lines.text: POKéMON?\nNo, this is a hotel for people.\pWe're full up, unfortunately.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_OnVacationWithBrotherAndBoyfriend
lines.text: I'm on vacation with my brother and\nboyfriend.\pCELADON is such a pretty city!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_WhyDidSheBringBrother
lines.text: Why?\nWhy did she bring her brother?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_SisBroughtMeOnVacation
lines.text: Yippee! I'm on vacation!\nMy sis brought me along! Awesome!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_SlotsReelInTheDough
lines.text: Hehehe!\pThe slots just reel in the dough,\nbig-time!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_ShippedMonsAsSlotPrizes
lines.text: CHIEF!\pWe just shipped two thousand\nmore POKéMON as slot prizes\lagain today!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_DontTouchGameCornerPoster
lines.text: Don't touch the poster at the GAME\nCORNER!\pThere's no secret switch behind it!$

lines.label: Text_ItsABuddhistAltar
lines.text: ぶつだん　だ‥$

lines.label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeFluteAwakensSleepingMons
lines.text: A POKé FLUTE awakens sleeping\nPOKéMON. You know that.\pIt does so with a sound that only\nthey can hear.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RodeHereFromFuchsia
lines.text: I rode here from FUCHSIA.\pIt's an uphill ride on CYCLING\nROAD, so I'm exhausted.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToCyclingRoadIfIHadBike
lines.text: If I had a BIKE, I would go to\nCYCLING ROAD!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakingBreakRightNow
lines.text: Hi!\pSorry, but we're taking a break\nright now.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_OftenGoToDrugstore
lines.text: My POKéMON are weak, so I often\nhave to go to the DRUGSTORE.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_PsstBasementUnderGameCorner
lines.text: Psst! There's a basement under the\nGAME CORNER, I hear.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ManLostItAllAtSlots
lines.text: Munch…\pThe man at that table lost it all\nat the slots.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakeThisImBusted
lines.text:
Go ahead! Laugh!
I'm flat-out busted!\pNo more slots for me!
I'm going straight!\pHere!
I won't be needing this anymore!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ReceivedCoinCaseFromMan
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a COIN CASE\nfrom the man.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_MakeRoomForThis
lines.text: Make room for this!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ThoughtIdWinItBack
lines.text: I always thought I was going to\nwin it back…$

lines.label: CeruleanCave_B1F_Text_Mew
lines.text: Mew!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!\pYou're still struggling along back
here?\pI'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!\pHere, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalDefeat
lines.text: Hey!\nTake it easy!\lYou won already!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?\pI went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.\pThat added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!\pAfter all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.\pSince you're using his system,
you should go thank him.\pWell, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAsFavor
lines.text: Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmellYa
lines.text:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalVictory
lines.text: なんたって！\nおれは　てんさい　だからよ！$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text:
Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!\p…Huh?
Me?\pI'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: GRUNT: Stop! I give up!\nI'll leave quietly!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_OkayIllReturnStolenTM
lines.text: …Okay.\nI'll return the TM I stole.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt
lines.text: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from\nthe TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_BetterGetMovingBye
lines.text: I better get moving!\nBye!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun
lines.text: Make room for this!\nI can't run until I give it to you!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsntIt
lines.text: You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTrees
lines.text:
Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?\pEven that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCouldCutTree
lines.text:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.\pThat way, you could get to the
other side.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmusing
lines.text: You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed
lines.text: The people here were robbed.\pIt's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is\nbehind this most heinous crime!\pEven our POLICE FORCE has\ntrouble with the ROCKETS!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroUseSonicboom
lines.text: Okay! SLOWBRO!\nUse SONICBOOM!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroPayAttention
lines.text: Come on, SLOWBRO, pay attention!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroPunch
lines.text: SLOWBRO, punch!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_NoYouBlewItAgain
lines.text: No!\nYou blew it again!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroWithdraw
lines.text: SLOWBRO, WITHDRAW!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedience
lines.text: No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTookSnooze
lines.text: SLOWBRO took a snooze…$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroLoafingAround
lines.text: SLOWBRO is loafing around…$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTurnedAway
lines.text: SLOWBRO turned away…$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroIgnoredOrders
lines.text: SLOWBRO ignored orders…$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle
lines.text: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
lines.text:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
lines.text: Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBikeShop
lines.text: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_SorryYouCantAffordIt
lines.text: Sorry!\nYou can't afford it!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucherHereYouGo
lines.text: Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVoucherForBicycle
lines.text: {PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ThankYouComeAgain
lines.text: Thank you!\nCome back again sometime!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeNewBicycle
lines.text: How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_MakeRoomForBicycle
lines.text: You better make room for your\nBICYCLE!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodEnoughForMe
lines.text: A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButExpensive
lines.text: These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WowYourBikeIsCool
lines.text: Wow.\nYour BIKE is really cool!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_GermanFoldableBicyleFinallyOnMarket
lines.text: ついに　はつばい！\pドイツ　せい　さいこうきゅう\nおりたたみ　じてんしゃ！$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ShinyNewBicycle
lines.text: A shiny new BICYCLE!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
lines.text:
Hi, you're a new face!\pOnly those TRAINERS who have a
policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03
lines.text: TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
lines.text:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM03FromMisty
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM03\nfrom MISTY.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForThis
lines.text: You better make room for this!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro
lines.text: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaDefeat
lines.text: You overwhelmed me!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle
lines.text: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisIntro
lines.text: Splash!\pI'm first up!\nLet's do it!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisDefeat
lines.text: That can't be!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle
lines.text: MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTeam
lines.text: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazingSecrets
lines.text: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBadge
lines.text: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytime
lines.text: Come visit me anytime you wish.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash
lines.text: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut
lines.text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly
lines.text: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strength
lines.text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf
lines.text: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSmash
lines.text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfall
lines.text: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AllMonsWillObeyYou
lines.text: All POKéMON will obey you!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMForDig
lines.text:
Those miserable ROCKETS!\pLook what they've done to my
house!\pThey stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!\pI was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…\pThat cost me a bundle, it did!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDigWithoutTM
lines.text: I figure what's lost is lost.\pI decided to teach DIGLETT how to\nDIG without a TM.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryingToDigIntoNoGood
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG\ntheir way into no good!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftWayOut
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWithMyHusband
lines.text: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertaining
lines.text: Sigh…\nToo much time, too little to do…\pIs nothing entertaining happening\nanywhere?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformativeHaveThis
lines.text:
Ah!
A new news report!\pHmm…\pI see!
That was quite informative!\pI applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.\pAs my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsHaveBerries
lines.text:
Oh, oh!
Th-this news report!\pHmm…\pAmazing!
What an incredible piece of news!\pI haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!\pThanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareNewsWithOthers
lines.text: It seems such a shame to not share\nthis news with other folks…\pI wish I could tell someone…\nLet others know the news…$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpreadingNewsTakeThis
lines.text: Ah, you've spread the news for me?\pGood news becomes worthwhile when\nall sorts of people share it.\pAs my thanks for your spreading\nthe news, take this!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNewsSpreadHaveBerries
lines.text:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!\pThat piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.\pYes, indeed!\pConsider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.\pI'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfWithAllSortsOfNews
lines.text: I'm quite enjoying myself with all\nsorts of news.\pYes, I am satisfied!\nI won't be bored for a while.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchIsFull
lines.text: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nMy gift remains ungiven, then.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBerries
lines.text:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThing
lines.text: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesAtDirectCorner
lines.text:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNoBerries
lines.text: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInAllSortsOfThings
lines.text: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtBerryPowder
lines.text: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWhat
lines.text: With what would you like to \nexchange it?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBerryPowderForItem
lines.text: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
lines.text: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryPowder
lines.text: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
lines.text: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLikeToTradePowder
lines.text: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakMons
lines.text:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.\pPut your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.\pIf your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRareCandy
lines.text: Do you know about RARE CANDY?\nThey don't sell it in shops.\pI think it makes POKéMON grow\nvery quickly all of a sudden.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillDoesWhateverForRareMons
lines.text: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneCallsBillPokemaniac
lines.text: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCollectsRareMons
lines.text: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$

lines.label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTradingUpstairs
lines.text:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked…$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSinceBeforeLab
lines.text: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
lines.text: Scientists conduct experiments \nin the burned-out building.\pYou know, the one they call the\nPOKéMON MANSION.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: CINNABAR ISLAND\nThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_PokemonLab
lines.text: POKéMON LAB$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
lines.text: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_HeyIfItIsntPlayer
lines.text: Huh?\nHey, if it isn't {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIsland
lines.text:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!\pI hope you're still using my
PC system.\pWell, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?\pThere's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.\pA friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.\pHow about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_AllRightLetsGo
lines.text: All right, then.\nLet's go!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCenter
lines.text:
What, are you too busy?\pWell, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.\pI'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.\pCome see me when you're done with
your business here.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived
lines.text: Looks like my pal's boat arrived,\ntoo.\pHe sent it specially here to\nCINNABAR to pick me up.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouCanGoAgain
lines.text:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?\pMy buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.\pI'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.\pIf you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from\lVERMILION PORT.\pAll right, thanks for your company!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
lines.text:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
lines.text: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltimateFireMove
lines.text: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
lines.text: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM38FromBlaine
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM38\nfrom BLAINE.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
lines.text: TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
lines.text: Make space for this, child!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro
lines.text: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikDefeat
lines.text: Yow!\nHot, hot, hot!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle
lines.text: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro
lines.text: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnDefeat
lines.text: I surrender!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle
lines.text: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro
lines.text: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryDefeat
lines.text: Waah!\nMy studies were insufficient!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle
lines.text: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro
lines.text: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonDefeat
lines.text: Too hot to handle!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle
lines.text: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro
lines.text: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekDefeat
lines.text: Ow!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle
lines.text:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro
lines.text: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyDefeat
lines.text: Yowza!\nToo hot!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle
lines.text: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacIntro
lines.text: Fire is weak against H2O.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nSnuffed out!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle
lines.text: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
lines.text: {PLAYER}!\nYou beat that firebrand!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules
lines.text:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion1
lines.text: CATERPIE evolves into METAPOD?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2
lines.text: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion3
lines.text: POLIWAG evolves three times?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4
lines.text: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5
lines.text: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion6
lines.text: TM28 contains TOMBSTONY?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrough
lines.text: You're absolutely correct!\pGo on through!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_SorryBadCall
lines.text: Sorry!\nBad call!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAttack
lines.text: Don't they have X ATTACK?\pI like it because it raises the\nATTACK stat in battle.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNeverHurt
lines.text: It never hurts to have extra items.\nYou never know what might happen.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CinnabarGymLocked
lines.text:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.\pThere should be a key for it
somewhere.\pCould it be in that burned-out
mansion?\pThe GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitUnionRoom
lines.text:
Do you have lots of friends?\pLinking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.\pBut how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?\pWho knows, you may end up making
new friends.\pI think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EvolutionCanWaitForNewMoves
lines.text: POKéMON can still learn techniques\nafter canceling evolution.\pEvolution can wait until new moves\nhave been learned.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReadyToSailToOneIsland
lines.text: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!\nReady to set sail to ONE ISLAND?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhNotDoneYet
lines.text: Oh, you're still not done yet?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LetsGo
lines.text: Well, that's it.\nLet's go!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAndFuji
lines.text: It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_StudyMonsExtensively
lines.text: We study POKéMON extensively\nevery day.\pPeople often bring us rare POKéMON\nfor examination.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_PhotoOfLabFounderDrFuji
lines.text: A photo of the LAB's founder…\nDR. FUJI?!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_MeetingRoomSign
lines.text: POKéMON LAB\nMeeting Room$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_RAndDRoomSign
lines.text: POKéMON LAB\nR & D Room$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_TestingRoomSign
lines.text: POKéMON LAB\nTesting Room$

lines.label: Text_MetronomeTeach
lines.text:
Tch-tch-tch!
I'll teach you a nifty move.\pTeach it to a POKéMON, and watch
the fun unfold!\pIt's a move called METRONOME.
Does it strike your fancy?$

lines.label: Text_MetronomeDeclined
lines.text: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!$

lines.label: Text_MetronomeWhichMon
lines.text: Okay!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

lines.label: Text_MetronomeTaught
lines.text: Tch-tch-tch!\nThat's the sound of a METRONOME.\pIt tweaks your POKéMON's brain into\nusing moves it doesn't even know.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HaveYouAFossilForMe
lines.text:
Hiya!\pI am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.\pHere, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.\pYou!
Have you a fossil for me?$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoIsTooBad
lines.text: No!\nIs too bad!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalkJP
lines.text: ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！\pそこらへんを　すこし\nブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_FossilMonBackToLife
lines.text: You late.\nWhere were you?\pYour fossil is back to life!\nIt was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ReceivedMonFromDoctor
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the doctor.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
lines.text: ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ThatFossilIsOfMonMakeItLiveAgain
lines.text:
Oh!
That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!\pIt is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!\pMy Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HandedFossilToWeirdDoctor
lines.text: So!\nYou hurry and give me that!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the\n{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalk
lines.text: I take a little time!\nYou go for walk a little while!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_YouComeAgain
lines.text: Aiyah!\nYou come again!$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_FoundFossilInMtMoon
lines.text: I found this most remarkable fossil\ninside MT. MOON.\pI think it's of a rare, prehistoric\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_EeveeCanEvolveIntroThreeMons
lines.text: EEVEE can evolve into one of three\nkinds of POKéMON.$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_LegendaryBirdEmail
lines.text:
There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…$

lines.label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_AnAmberPipe
lines.text: An amber pipe!$

lines.label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
lines.text: I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\pIf I could get a POKéMON to use\nFLASH and light it up…$

lines.label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
lines.text: Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\pIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: FIVE ISLAND\nChrono Island: Where Time Goes$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow
lines.text: Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in\nthe MEADOW.\pBut they put up a weird building\non it, so I can't play there.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundHere
lines.text: It's been getting busier around\nthese parts lately.\pI haven't been catching many good\nfish lately, either.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_House1_JPText_HusbandWentOffFishing
lines.text: こんばんの　おかずは\nようい　しなくて　いいぞ！\pって　だんなが\nつりに　いったん　だけど‥\lしんじて　いいのかねえ$

lines.label: FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFishing
lines.text:
Don't worry about buying anything
for dinner tonight!\p…That's what my husband said when
he went off fishing today.\pI'm not sure if I can count on him
to live up to that promise.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToFamily
lines.text:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.\pI should have had a giant mansion
built on it.\pIt would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonIntro
lines.text: Aiyeeeeeh!\pI thought this was an ancient ruin.\nBut it's teeming with ghosts!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonDefeat
lines.text: Aiyeeeeeh!\nMercy!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPostBattle
lines.text: I'm trying to get out of here, but\nI always end up at the same spot.\pMaybe the number of boulders is\na hint…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIntro
lines.text: W-what do you intend to do with\nme?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDefeat
lines.text: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskYouToTakeMeHome
lines.text:
I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntro
lines.text: I think there is a mysterious power\nat work in this cave.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefeat
lines.text: If you don't go into the right\ntunnel, you won't get ahead.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPostBattle
lines.text: Earlier, a lady went into the caves\nahead.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_DoorNeedsTwoPasswords
lines.text: とびらを　あけるには\nパスワードが　2つ　いるようだ$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAnotherNeeded
lines.text: {PLAYER} entered a password.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\p… …  … …  … …\pAnother password is needed to\nopen the door…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDoorOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} entered two passwords.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\n“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\p… …  … …  … …\pThe WAREHOUSE's door opened!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_WarehouseDoorAlreadyOpen
lines.text: The WAREHOUSE's door is already\nopen.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Intro
lines.text: This area's strictly off-limits!\nOut, out!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Defeat
lines.text: Is this for real?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle
lines.text: You don't have any business here!\nGo home!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro
lines.text: There's nothing past here except\nour WAREHOUSE.\pSo what brings you here?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Defeat
lines.text: That wasn't supposed to happen…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle
lines.text: You're wanting to know what's inside\nthis WAREHOUSE?\pIt's better you didn't know.\nFor your own sake, I mean.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro
lines.text: You'd be wasting time even if you\nwere to get by me.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Defeat
lines.text: Oh, that makes me furious!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle
lines.text: You won't be able to get in without\nthe passwords anyway.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro
lines.text: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloDefeat
lines.text: Oh, so sharp!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostBattle
lines.text: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro
lines.text: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazDefeat
lines.text: Flap, flap!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostBattle
lines.text: There was a really somber guy\nover that way.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldIntro
lines.text: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDefeat
lines.text: Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPostBattle
lines.text: It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ScrubScrub
lines.text: Scrub, scrub…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_YourMonsLookHealthy
lines.text: Hello…\nYour POKéMON look healthy…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhereIBuriedMyOnix
lines.text: This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonixLemonadeOffering
lines.text: “Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnotherLemonadeOffering
lines.text: Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCanOfLemonade
lines.text: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouPleaseTakeThis
lines.text:
Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToYourMonsToo
lines.text: Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveRoomForIt
lines.text: If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHaveThingAsMyThanks
lines.text: Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ScrubScrubTectonix
lines.text: Scrub, scrub…\p… … …\nTECTONIX…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonix
lines.text: Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWayToPrepareMeal
lines.text: I'm on my way to prepare a meal\nfor a certain high-society person.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOnQuestToCatchEveryMon
lines.text: You're on a quest to catch every\nsingle kind of POKéMON?\p…How incredible. Please tell me if\nyou catch a strong one!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntro
lines.text: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyDefeat
lines.text: The shame of this…\nI'm red-faced…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPostBattle
lines.text: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaIntro
lines.text: Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDefeat
lines.text: This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPostBattle
lines.text: GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntro
lines.text: Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaDefeat
lines.text: Oh…\nMy feelings, they are blue…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPostBattle
lines.text: The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntro
lines.text: I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my, so strong.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPostBattle
lines.text: I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIntro
lines.text: I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my goodness gracious!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPostBattle
lines.text: A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinIntro
lines.text: I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinDefeat
lines.text: Oops!\nI rushed things!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPostBattle
lines.text: When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro
lines.text: I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefeat
lines.text: That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostBattle
lines.text: Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyThanksYouMayGoNow
lines.text: SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphysHouse
lines.text: SELPHY'S HOUSE$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_PleaseHearMyWish
lines.text: SELPHY: Oh?\nDo I know you from somewhere?\pOh, but that doesn't matter.\pI am exquisitely bored.\nPlease, hear my wish.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_WishToSeeMonPlease
lines.text: I wish to see a POKéMON.\nA darling {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to see one right away.\nPlease, make my wish come true.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhImTiredOfWaiting
lines.text: SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.\nI'm tired of waiting for you.\pI'll forgive you this time, but\nplease don't fail me next time.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_MonYouCaughtForMeThankYou
lines.text:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.\pOh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.\pGiggle…
I see a resemblance to you.\pThank you so kindly.\p… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?\pYou may leave.\p… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.\pSEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerYesMyLady
lines.text: Butler: Yes, my lady.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyGiveTokenOfAppreciation
lines.text: SELPHY: See to it that this person\nis given a token of appreciation.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerIShallDoAsYouBid
lines.text: Butler: I shall do as you bid,\nmy lady.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerPleaseAcceptThisAsHerThanks
lines.text: Butler: I sincerely thank you for\npleasing Lady SELPHY.\pPlease accept this as her thanks…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerBagAppearsToBeFull
lines.text: Butler: Your BAG appears to be\nunfortunately full.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhHowDisappointing
lines.text: Oh…\nHow disappointing.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyWishYouBestOfLuck
lines.text: SELPHY: I wish you the best of\nluck.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_LadySelphySmileHasBrillianceOfSun
lines.text: Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY\nhas the brilliance of the sun.\pPlease, I beg you to bring joy\nto Lady SELPHY.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMonsLockedInPen
lines.text: There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnlockedMonsFled
lines.text: The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: What do you think you're doing?!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Oh, but…\nToo much!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a kid like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: Don't…you…dare…laugh…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Intro
lines.text: I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Defeat
lines.text: I…\nI'm shattered…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1PostBattle
lines.text: You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSoYouCanComeBackThrough
lines.text:
I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Intro
lines.text:
That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Defeat
lines.text:
Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2PostBattle
lines.text: We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWithGraphsAndText
lines.text: A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIntro
lines.text:
I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonDefeat
lines.text: Gah! Darn!\nDarn! Darn!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPostBattle
lines.text: If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostLeaveMeBe
lines.text: What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GiovannisKidHasRedHair
lines.text:
What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTakeLookAtMons
lines.text:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?\pYou're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?\pLet me take a look.
… … …   … … …$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_HmmISeeIsee
lines.text: Ah, hmm…\nI see, I see…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonRightHaveThis
lines.text: Oh, impressive.\nYou treat your POKéMON right.\pI think you can be entrusted with\nthis.\pPlease, I'd like you to have this.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_ReceivedEggFromMan
lines.text: {PLAYER} received an EGG\nfrom the man!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveSpaceInYourParty
lines.text: …Unfortunately, you don't have\nspace for this in your party.\pYou'd better come back for it\nanother time.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_YouveComeBackForTheEgg
lines.text: やあ\nタマゴを　もらいに\lきて　くれたんだね$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetSomeoneLikeYou
lines.text: I received that EGG while I was\ntraveling.\pI'm glad I met someone like you.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRemindsMeOfDaisy
lines.text:
Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.\pSeeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.\pShe was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntro
lines.text: This is an excellent environment\nfor raising POKéMON.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefeat
lines.text: Your POKéMON are growing up\nadmirably well!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePostBattle
lines.text: You know, I think you have the\ntalent to be a good BREEDER.$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: FOUR ISLAND\nThe Warm, Blue, Floe Island$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned
lines.text: LORELEI has returned.\pDid she find the city life too\nstressful, I wonder?$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild
lines.text:
LORELEI has gone back.\pThe LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_RivalAlreadyGotEggBeSmellingYa
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey!
{PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here in the
SEVII ISLANDS?\pYou should quit copying me,
you know?\pAnyways, I already got my POKéMON
EGG, so I'm done with this island.\pHeh, I bet you don't even know
about POKéMON EGGS.\pYou'll never fill your NATIONAL
POKéDEX that way.\pBy the way, I saw someone we both
know on this island.\pWhy don't you go look around if
it makes you curious?\pMe, I don't have the time to
waste.\pBe smelling ya!$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedDolls
lines.text:
Oh, you found me!
Please don't tell LORELEI.\pDid you know that LORELEI has lots
and lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to
FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallCaveIce
lines.text: Ooh, chilly!\pI made a slushie using ice I\nshaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.\pIt's chilly and tasty!$

lines.label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleisHouse
lines.text: LORELEI'S HOUSE$

lines.label: JPText_BodySlamTeach
lines.text: そーれ　ぼよーん！\nどっちが　さきに　へたばるか？\lのしかかり　しょうぶ　してるんだ\pきみは　なかまに　はいったら\nつぶれそうだな‥\lかわりに　きみの　ポケモンに\lのしかかり　おしえて　やろっか？$

lines.label: JPText_BodySlamDeclined
lines.text: また　おいで　ぼよーん！$

lines.label: JPText_BodySlamWhichMon
lines.text: どの　ポケモンに\nおしえたい　かい？$

lines.label: JPText_BodySlamTaught
lines.text: ぼよよーん！$

lines.label: FourIsland_House1_Text_YoureAwfullyHeavy
lines.text: There! Boing!\nYou're awfully heavy!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiKeepHandsOffMons
lines.text: LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\pDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ShutItLadyLeaveUsBe
lines.text: Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\pDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiPlayerHelpMeKickPoachersOut
lines.text:
LORELEI: {PLAYER}?!
What are you doing here?\pNo, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help.\pHelp me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else.\pThey've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off!\pAre you ready?
You take that one, please!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text: W-what?!\pWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: We didn't plan on this!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWhereHaveYouTakenMons
lines.text:
LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak.\pYou!
Tell me!\pWhere have you taken the captured
POKéMON?\pI'm smashing your ring once and
for all!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_NotTellingYouThat
lines.text: N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWellDeepFreezeYou
lines.text:
LORELEI: If you won't confess,
we'll deep-freeze you.\pMy LAPRAS is furious for what
you've done to its friends.\pGo, LAPRAS!
ICE BEAM…$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_OkayRocketWareHouseFiveIsland
lines.text:
Wawaah! Okay!
I'll talk!\pThe POKéMON are in the ROCKET
WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.\pThere! I said it!
We'll be going now!\p…But I doubt you'll ever make it
into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!\pHeheheheh!$

lines.label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYouThisIsAwful
lines.text:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…\pI was born and raised here on
these islands.\pI had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…$

lines.label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnythingWereToHappenToIsland
lines.text:
LORELEI: There's something weighing
heavily on my mind.\pIf anything were to happen on
the island where I was born…\pI wouldn't know about it if I were
in the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI wonder if that would make me
irresponsible to my home…$

lines.label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnToLeagueInShortWhile
lines.text:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve
all the problems here?\pThat's wonderful.\pThat means there isn't any reason
for me to be here all the time.\pThank you…\pI'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE
in a short while.$

lines.label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhatICanHereAndNow
lines.text: I don't know what will happen in\nthe future, but…\pI will do what I can here and now.\nThat's all I can do.$

lines.label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_StuffedMonDollsGalore
lines.text: Stuffed POKéMON dolls galore!$

lines.label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThisIsland
lines.text:
We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!\pWhen LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.$

lines.label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid
lines.text:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.\pBut there is one exception you
need to know about.\pThe ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.$

lines.label: Text_BodySlamTeach
lines.text:
Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?$

lines.label: Text_BodySlamDeclined
lines.text: Come again!\nBoing!$

lines.label: Text_BodySlamWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?$

lines.label: Text_BodySlamTaught
lines.text: Boioing!$

lines.label: FourIsland_House1_Text_FatMan
lines.text: それ　ぼよーん！\nおまえ　おもいなあー！$

lines.label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIceMonsInCave
