lines.text: There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.$

lines.label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCarePeopleFoundEggBefore
lines.text:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.$

lines.label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPokemonJournalHasntArrived
lines.text: What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame
lines.text: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?\pThere are some rare POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront
lines.text: The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front\nof the entrance.\pOut back is the SAFARI GAME for\ncatching POKéMON.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara
lines.text: ERIK: Where's SARA?\nI said I'd meet her here.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere
lines.text: That item ball in there…\nWere you wanting that?\pMe, too!\n…Huh? That's a POKéMON?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: FUCHSIA CITY\nBehold! It's Passion Pink!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneSign
lines.text: POKéMON PARADISE\nSAFARI ZONE$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariGameSign
lines.text: SAFARI GAME\nPOKéMON-U-CATCH!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WardensHomeSign
lines.text: SAFARI ZONE\nWARDEN'S HOME$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign
lines.text: POKéMON PARADISE!\nWelcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\lSAFARI ZONE OFFICE$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign
lines.text: Name: CHANSEY\nCatching one is all up to chance.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign
lines.text: Name: VOLTORB\nThe very image of a POKé BALL.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign
lines.text: Name: KANGASKHAN\pA maternal POKéMON that raises its\nyoung in a pouch on its belly.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign
lines.text: Name: SLOWPOKE\nFriendly and very slow moving.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign
lines.text: Name: LAPRAS\nAKA the king of the seas.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign
lines.text: Name: OMANYTE\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign
lines.text: Name: KABUTO\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$

lines.label: Text_SubstituteTeach
lines.text:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN
baby.\pI'd love to be a substitute for the
baby…\pAnd snuggle in the mother
KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.\pBut only POKéMON can use the
technique SUBSTITUTE…\pWant me to teach SUBSTITUTE to
one of your POKéMON?$

lines.label: Text_SubstituteDeclined
lines.text: Oh, really?\nSUBSTITUTE seems so fun…$

lines.label: Text_SubstituteWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSUBSTITUTE?$

lines.label: Text_SubstituteTaught
lines.text: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside\na KANGASKHAN belly pouch…$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader
lines.text: My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro
lines.text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat
lines.text: Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle
lines.text: When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadge
lines.text:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of
battle.\pAh!
Take this, too!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM06FromKoga
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM06\nfrom KOGA.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06
lines.text: Sealed within that TM06 lies\nTOXIC!\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
lines.text: Make space for this, child!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro
lines.text: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenDefeat
lines.text: What?\nExtraordinary!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle
lines.text: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
lines.text: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
lines.text: I'm done for!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
lines.text: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
lines.text: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
lines.text: You had me fooled!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
lines.text: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro
lines.text: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilDefeat
lines.text: Whoa!\nYou've got it!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle
lines.text: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro
lines.text: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarDefeat
lines.text: Awoo!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle
lines.text: I still have much to learn.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
lines.text: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
lines.text: You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
lines.text: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
lines.text: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFalseTeeth
lines.text: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, \nbut he's still very much active.\pAll his teeth are false, though.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson
lines.text: Hmm?\nYou've met BILL?\pHe's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnMonData
lines.text: BILL files his own POKéMON data on\nhis PC.\pDid he show you?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
lines.text: I'm the FISHING GURU's older\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTakeThis
lines.text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchBetterMons
lines.text:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pA crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?\pBut with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_OhThatsDisappointing
lines.text: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
lines.text: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForGift
lines.text: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToForgetMove
lines.text: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMonShouldForgetMove
lines.text: Which POKéMON should forget a\nmove?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
lines.text: Which move should be forgotten?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} seems to know only one\nmove…$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
lines.text: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?\nThat move should be forgotten?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenMoveCompletely
lines.text: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForgetOtherMoves
lines.text: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowMoves
lines.text: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafariZonePennants
lines.text: Don't they have any pennants\npromoting the SAFARI ZONE?\pHow about some paper lanterns?\nAren't there even any calendars?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed
lines.text: Did you try X SPEED?\nIt speeds up a POKéMON in battle.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBecomeGoodTrainerWithOneMon
lines.text: You can't become a good TRAINER\nwith just one strong POKéMON.\pBut raising many POKéMON evenly\nis no easy task, either.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonLeagueWestOfViridian
lines.text: There's a narrow trail west of\nVIRIDIAN CITY.\pIt goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.\nThe HQ governs all TRAINERS.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitSafariZoneForPokedex
lines.text: If you're working on a POKéDEX,\nvisit the SAFARI ZONE.\pAll sorts of rare POKéMON breed\nthere.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
lines.text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlaySafariGameFor500
lines.text: For just ¥500, you can play the\nSAFARI GAME.\pYou can roam the wide-open safari\nand catch what you like.\pWould you like to play?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ThatllBe500WeOnlyUseSpecialBalls
lines.text: That'll be ¥500, please!\pWe only use a special kind of \nPOKé BALLS here.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlayerReceived30SafariBalls
lines.text: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS\nfrom the attendant.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CallYouOnPAWhenYouRunOut
lines.text: We'll call you on the PA when you\nrun out of time or SAFARI BALLS.\pWell, I'll wish you the best of\nluck!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_OkayPleaseComeAgain
lines.text: Okay.\nPlease come again!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_OopsNotEnoughMoney
lines.text: Oops!\nNot enough money!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoingToLeaveSafariZoneEarly
lines.text: Are you going to leave the\nSAFARI ZONE early?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PleaseReturnSafariBalls
lines.text: Please return any SAFARI BALLS\nyou may have left.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoodLuck
lines.text: Good luck!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CatchFairShareComeAgain
lines.text: Did you catch your fair share?\nCome again!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_FirstTimeAtSafariZone
lines.text: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ExplainSafariZone
lines.text:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.\pEach zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.\pUse the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.\pYou can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.\pIf you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but\lharder to catch.\pIf you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but\leasier to catch.\pWhen you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_SorryYoureARegularHere
lines.text: Sorry, you're a regular here!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_NicknamedWardenSlowpoke
lines.text: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_WardenIsVeryKnowledgeable
lines.text: WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_CouldntUnderstandWarden
lines.text: WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_PrizeInSafariZone
lines.text:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHefifoo
lines.text: WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!\pHa lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.\nHeff hee fwee!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHoHoo
lines.text: Ah howhee ho hoo!\nEef ee hafahi ho!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHaHoo
lines.text: Ha?\nHe ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTeethToWarden
lines.text: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH\nto the WARDEN.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPoppedInHisTeeth
lines.text: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonGiveYouSomething
lines.text:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLassieGiveYouSomething
lines.text:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ReceivedHM04FromWarden
lines.text: {PLAYER} received HM04\nfrom the WARDEN.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStrength
lines.text:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.\pIt lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.\pOh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_YouHaveTooMuchStuff
lines.text: なんや　にもつ\nいっぱいやんけ！$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosFossilsOnDisplay
lines.text: POKéMON photos and fossils are on\ndisplay.$

lines.label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_OldMonMerchandiseOnDisplay
lines.text: Old POKéMON merchandise is on\ndisplay.$

lines.label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pAt the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will
face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose, you have to start all
over again!\pThis is it!
Go for it!$

lines.label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaceEliteFourGoodLuck
lines.text: From here on, you face the\nELITE FOUR one by one.\pIf you win, a door opens to the\nnext TRAINER. Good luck!$

lines.label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LoreleiIsAbsentClosedForTimeBeing
lines.text:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted
your time coming here.\pLORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is
absent, you see.\pAs a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is
closed for the time being.$

lines.label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AgathaWhuppedUs
lines.text:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are
horrifically terrifying in toughness.\pI took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON
and raised them to the max.\pI went at AGATHA feeling pretty
confident, but she whupped us.\pThat old lady's also got a really
short fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get
that scary lady hollering.$

lines.label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LancesCousinGymLeaderFarAway
lines.text: Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR\nmember is in the blood.\pFrom what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_DoYouBelieveInGhosts
lines.text: Do you believe in ghosts?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_SoThereAreBelievers
lines.text: Really?\nSo there are believers…$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_JustImaginingWhiteHand
lines.text: Hahaha, I guess not.\pThat white hand on your shoulder…\nI'm just imagining it.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSite
lines.text: This town is known as the grave\nsite of POKéMON.\pMemorial services are held in\nPOKéMON TOWER.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_GhostsAppearedInTower
lines.text: Ghosts appeared in POKéMON TOWER.\pI think they're the spirits of\nPOKéMON that the ROCKETS killed.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: LAVENDER TOWN\nThe Noble Purple Town$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_SilphScopeNotice
lines.text: New SILPH SCOPE!\nMake the Invisible Plain to See!\pSILPH CO.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_VolunteerPokemonHouse
lines.text: LAVENDER VOLUNTEER\nPOKéMON HOUSE$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Text_PokemonTowerSign
lines.text: POKéMON TOWER\nBecalm the Spirits of POKéMON$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Cubone
lines.text: CUBONE: Kyarugoo!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCubonesMother
lines.text: Those horrible ROCKETS!\nThey deserve no mercy!\pThat poor CUBONE's mother…\pIt was killed trying to escape from\nTEAM ROCKET.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonTowerIsGone
lines.text: The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is\ngone!\pSomeone must have soothed its\nrestless spirit!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WantMeToRateNicknames
lines.text: Hello, hello!\nI am the official NAME RATER!\pWant me to rate the nicknames of\nyour POKéMON?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_CritiqueWhichMonsNickname
lines.text: Which POKéMON's nickname should\nI critique?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_GiveItANicerName
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\pBut, would you like me to give it\na nicer name?\pHow about it?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WhatShallNewNicknameBe
lines.text: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsName
lines.text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ISeeComeVisitAgain
lines.text: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsSameName
lines.text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_TrulyImpeccableName
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable name!\pTake good care of {STR_VAR_1}!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
lines.text: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatRaiseItems
lines.text:
I'm searching for items that raise
the stats of POKéMON.\pThey're effective over the course
of a single battle.\pX ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED, 
and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.\pDo you know where I can get them?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives
lines.text: Did you buy some REVIVES?\nThey revive any fainted POKéMON!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanChallengeYou
lines.text: Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will\nchallenge you with two POKéMON\lat the same time.\pIf that happens, you have to send\nout two POKéMON to battle, too.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SoldNuggetFromMountainsFor5000
lines.text: この　あいだ　やまおくで\nきんのたまを　ひろい　ましてね！\pつかえない　しなもの　ですが\nうったら　なんと　5000¥でした$

lines.label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RocketsDoAnythingForMoney
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET will do anything for\nthe sake of money!\pThere is no job too dirty, no deed\ntoo heinous, no crime too wicked!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CubonesMotherKilledByRockets
lines.text: I saw CUBONE's mother trying to\nescape from TEAM ROCKET.\pShe was killed trying to get away…$

lines.label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PeoplePayForCuboneSkulls
lines.text: You know how the CUBONE species\nwears skulls, right?\pPeople will pay a lot for one.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearMrFujiNotFromAroundHere
lines.text: I recently moved to this town.\pI hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_WhereDidMrFujiGo
lines.text: That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here.\nWhere'd he go?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiWasPrayingForCubonesMother
lines.text: MR. FUJI had been praying alone\nfor CUBONE's mother.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiLooksAfterOrphanedMons
lines.text: This is really MR. FUJI's house.\pHe's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MonsNiceToHug
lines.text: It's so warm!\nPOKéMON are so nice to hug.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_Nidorino
lines.text: NIDORINO: Gaoo!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_Psyduck
lines.text: PSYDUCK: Gwappa!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_IdLikeYouToHaveThis
lines.text:
MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…\pYour POKéDEX quest is one that
requires strong dedication.\pWithout deep love for POKéMON,
your quest may fail.\pI'm not sure if this will help you,
but I'd like you to have it.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ReceivedPokeFluteFromMrFuji
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE\nfrom MR. FUJI.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ExplainPokeFlute
lines.text: Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE,\nsleeping POKéMON will spring awake.\pTry using it on POKéMON that are\nsleeping obstacles.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MustMakeRoomForThis
lines.text: You must make room for this!$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_HasPokeFluteHelpedYou
lines.text: MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE\nhelped you?$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_GrandPrizeDrawingClipped
lines.text: POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.$

lines.label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_PokemonMagazinesLineShelf
lines.text: POKéMON magazines line the shelf.\pPOKéMON INSIDER…\pPOKéMON FAN…$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionTeach
lines.text:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionDeclined
lines.text: Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionWhichMon
lines.text: You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionTaught
lines.text: Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionTeachJP
lines.text: こ　この　かざんが\nもし　だいばくはつ　したら\lお　おれら　ひとたまりも\lないなあ　‥ブルブル！\pこ　こわい　ついでに\nだいばくはつ　でも　おぼえてみる？$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionDeclinedJP
lines.text: や　やっぱ　こわいもんな\nブルブル$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionWhichMonJP
lines.text: つ　つよきだね！\nじゃあ　どの　ポケモンに　する？$

lines.label: Text_ExplosionTaughtJP
lines.text: かざんで　だいばくはつを‥\nす　すごい　スリル！$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere
lines.text: Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLost
lines.text: What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLast
lines.text: Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain
lines.text: Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGoldeen
lines.text: What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_SnoopsBeenListeningIn
lines.text: Hey!\nThis snoop's been listening in!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Huh, what?$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Why'd you have to win?$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Wait!\nBut how?$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontStepInsideThere
lines.text:
What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro
lines.text: An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat
lines.text: Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle
lines.text: They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro
lines.text: Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethDefeat
lines.text: Atchah!\nYou're shockingly good!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle
lines.text: When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro
lines.text: I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat
lines.text: I think I tried to overdo it…$

lines.label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle
lines.text: The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…$

lines.label: MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F_Text_FoundARuby
lines.text: {PLAYER} found a RUBY!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro
lines.text: WHOA!\nYou shocked me!\l…Oh, you're just a kid!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\nShocked again!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle
lines.text: Kids like you shouldn't be\nwandering around here in the dark.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro
lines.text: Did you come to explore the cave,\ntoo?$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshDefeat
lines.text: Losing stinks!\nIt's so uncool.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle
lines.text: I came all the way down here to\nshow off to girls.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro
lines.text: Wow! It's way bigger in here than\nI thought!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nI lost it!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle
lines.text: How do you get out of here?\nIt's so big, I may get lost.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanIntro
lines.text: What!\nDon't sneak up on me!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanDefeat
lines.text: My POKéMON won't do!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle
lines.text: I have to find stronger POKéMON.\nWhere might they be?$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro
lines.text: What?\nI'm waiting for my friends to find\lme here.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisDefeat
lines.text: I lost?$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle
lines.text: I came because I heard there are\nsome very rare fossils here.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro
lines.text: Suspicious men are in the cave.\nWhat about you?$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentDefeat
lines.text: You got me!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle
lines.text: I saw them!\nI'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro
lines.text: You need to go through this cave\nto get to CERULEAN CITY.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyDefeat
lines.text: I lost.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle
lines.text: ZUBAT is tough!\nBut if you can catch one, you'll\lbe able to count on it.$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_ZubatIsABloodsucker
lines.text: Beware!\nZUBAT is a bloodsucker!$

lines.label: MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils
lines.text: Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro
lines.text: Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelDefeat
lines.text: Okay!\nI'll share!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil
lines.text: We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine
lines.text: All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegeneratesFossils
lines.text: Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\pThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Urgh!\nNow I'm mad!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\lWe strike fear with our strength!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: I blew it!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: So, you are good…$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\pIt could be bad news!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: I'm steamed!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil
lines.text: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil
lines.text: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ObtainedHelixFossil
lines.text: Obtained the HELIX FOSSIL!$

lines.label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ObtainedDomeFossil
lines.text: Obtained the DOME FOSSIL!$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_BillLetsGoSeeCelio
lines.text:
BILL: Here we are!
This is ONE ISLAND.\pThere are several islands around
here, and this is one of them.\pMy friend CELIO sent the boat to
fetch me here.\pHe's in charge of the island's PC
network by his lonesome.\p…Why am I telling you this now?
Let's just go see CELIO!$

lines.label: Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail
lines.text: Ahoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere
lines.text:
Here we are on an island smack in
the middle of nowhere.\pWe're lucky to have an upstanding
young man like CELIO here.\pMy granddaughter was in a tizzy
over CELIO's friend.\pSomething about a famous
POKéMANIAC?\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto
lines.text:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we now have PC linkage
with people in KANTO.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn
lines.text:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we finally have PC linkage
with people in HOENN.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man.\pHe would make a fine husband for
my granddaughter!$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: ONE ISLAND\nFriends Gather at Knot Island$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign
lines.text: Expanding the POKéMON World!\nPOKéMON NET CENTER$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_ReturnToCinnabar
lines.text: グレンタウンに　もどりますか？$

lines.label: OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat
lines.text: Hi, sight-seeing, are you?\nIsn't the warm climate here great?$

lines.label: OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnSunnyDays
lines.text: On sunny days, I step out and gaze\nupon the volcano.\pThat's my daily routine.$

lines.label: OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberErupted
lines.text: Let me think… When was the last\ntime MT. EMBER erupted?$

lines.label: OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereForever
lines.text: Young people all want to go off to\nbig cities.\pBut I want to stay here forever!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro
lines.text: The weather's gorgeous!\nPerfect for a battle!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaDefeat
lines.text: Aiyeeeeh!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattle
lines.text: Please don't splash my face!\nYou'll ruin the makeup.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro
lines.text: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you're so awful.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBattle
lines.text: I like that cap you have.\nMaybe I should wear one, too…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro
lines.text: Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers\ninto the sky.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnDefeat
lines.text: Well, aren't you tough?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle
lines.text: The sky is immense around these\nparts.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro
lines.text: I took a break from swimming,\nonly to have you challenge me?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettDefeat
lines.text: Hey, what the…\nYou're good, you!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBattle
lines.text: Instead of using SURF all the time,\nyou should swim some.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro
lines.text: Wait! Wait a second!\nI think I've hooked a big one!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyDefeat
lines.text: I've lost it all again…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattle
lines.text: Not only did I lose, the big one\ngot away from me, too!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro
lines.text: Could you help me out with my\ntraining?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat
lines.text: You were a cut above me.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBattle
lines.text: It's clear that you're skilled.\nI like you!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro
lines.text: There isn't a day in which we don't\ntrain!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaDefeat
lines.text: I'm such a fool!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattle
lines.text: I'll train even harder from now on!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro
lines.text: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaDefeat
lines.text: Gasp…\nGasp…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle
lines.text: I lost because I'm pooped from all\nthe running I did…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro
lines.text: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughDefeat
lines.text: Why me?!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle
lines.text: Even martial artists are becoming\nfashion conscious these days…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro
lines.text: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceDefeat
lines.text: Awww, blown!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattle
lines.text: The water in volcanic regions is\ndelicious.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro
lines.text: My lunch filled us up, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireDefeat
lines.text: That made me all sweaty.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBattle
lines.text: What should I do?\nI feel famished again.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro
lines.text: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaDefeat
lines.text: KIA: Huh?!\nI can't believe it!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle
lines.text: KIA: How could there be anyone\nbetter than my big brother?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: KIA: If you want to battle with\nus, you have to bring at least two\lPOKéMON with you.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro
lines.text: MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid\nof nothing!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikDefeat
lines.text: MIK: Whoa!\nThat's too much!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle
lines.text: MIK: How could my combination\nwith KIA fail?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MIK: Hey, do you want to battle\nwith us two?\pBring two or more POKéMON with\nyou, then.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: This is KINDLE ROAD.\pGo straight for MT. EMBER.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign
lines.text: Light the Fire in Your Heart!\nEMBER SPA$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterWarmsMeToCore
lines.text:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_EnjoyBowlOfChowder
lines.text: My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterExquisiteFullyRefreshed
lines.text: The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSpringIsTherapeutic
lines.text: Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHowSmoothMySkinIs
lines.text: Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_BrunoVisitsSpaOnOccasion
lines.text:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedThisToMakeEmberSpa
lines.text:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_ExplainHM06
lines.text: That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHeyThereCelio
lines.text: BILL: Hey, there!\nCELIO!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCantBelieveYouCameOut
lines.text: CELIO: BILL!\nI can't believe you came out here.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHowsYourResearchComing
lines.text: BILL: Well, absolutely!\nHow's your research coming along?\p…Oh, wait a sec.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMyBuddyCelio
lines.text: {PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.\nHe's one dedicated PC MANIAC!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsRisingPokemonChamp
lines.text: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising\ncontender as the POKéMON CHAMP!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsReigningPokemonChamp
lines.text: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the\nreigning POKéMON CHAMP!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioThatsReallyImpressive
lines.text: CELIO: That's really impressive.\pI hate to say it, but I have zero\naptitude for battling.\pAnyways, I'm glad to meet you.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBringMeUpToSpeed
lines.text: BILL: So, bring me up to speed.\nHow's your machine running?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCsCantLinkWithYours
lines.text: CELIO: It's running fine, but we're\ntoo remote out here.\pThe PCs on this island just can't\nlink with your PC, BILL.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetMeHelpYou
lines.text: BILL: Oh, yeah?\nOkay, let me take a look-see.\p…Hang on here…\nI think we can make it work.\lLet me help you, okay?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDeliverThisMeteoritePlayer
lines.text:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?\p…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?\pThe island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.\pThere's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.\pHe has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.\pWe keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.\pSo, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AcceptedMeteoriteFromBill
lines.text: {PLAYER} accepted the METEORITE\nfrom BILL.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPleaseTakeThis
lines.text: CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going\nto TWO ISLAND, please take this.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetsYouTravelBetweenIslands
lines.text: It's a PASS for the ferry service\nserving the local islands.\pIt will let you travel between the\nISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.\pOh, you should have this, too.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedExtraPageForTownMap
lines.text: {PLAYER} received an extra page\nfor the TOWN MAP!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedTownMap
lines.text: {PLAYER} received\na TOWN MAP!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatchYouLater
lines.text: BILL: I'll catch you later!\nSay hi to the guy for me!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAboutLikeThis
lines.text: Hmm…\pHow about we try this like this…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWorkingStrollAWhileMore
lines.text:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pDid you see?
We got the PC working!\pI've got a few things to show
CELIO here.\pCan you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryForBeingPoorHost
lines.text: I'm sorry for taking up so much of\nBILL's time.\pI'm also sorry for being such a \npoor host on your visit here.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UsualPCServicesUnavailable
lines.text: The usual PC services aren't\navailable…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillOhHeyPlayer
lines.text: BILL: Oh, hey!\n{PLAYER}!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeGotItDone
lines.text: BILL: What kept you so long?\nBeen out having a good time?\pWe got it done.\nThe PCs are up and running!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioJobWentQuick
lines.text: CELIO: The job went incredibly\nquick.\pBILL is one amazing guy…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillYouveLearnedALot
lines.text: BILL: No, no! There was almost\nnothing left for me to do.\pCELIO, I have to hand it to you.\nYou've learned a lot.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioOhReallyEhehe
lines.text: CELIO: Oh, really?\nEhehe…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeShouldHeadBackToKanto
lines.text: BILL: Well, there you have it.\nI'm finished with the job.\lWe should head back to KANTO.\pCELIO, I'll be seeing you again.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPromiseIllShowYouAroundSometime
lines.text: CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry\nthat we sent you off alone today.\pI promise, I will show you around\nthese islands sometime.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImModifyingMyNetworkMachine
lines.text:
CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.\pHow am I doing?\pWell, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.\pWhen I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,\l{PLAYER}.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCaughtMoreMonMaybeICanBeUseful
lines.text:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?\pOh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.\pDo you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeTradingFromTrainersFarAway
lines.text:
I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.\pI'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.\pWhen I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from\lTRAINERS far away.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpecialGemstone
lines.text: But, there is a slight catch.\pFor the link to work, the Machine\nneeds a special gemstone.\pIt's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,\nbut I haven't found one yet.\pWho knows where it could be.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingToFindGem
lines.text:
I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.\pAs a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…\pIf I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.\pBut this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhThats
lines.text: Oh!\nTh-that's…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HandedRubyToCelio
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed the RUBY\nto CELIO.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskOneMoreFavor
lines.text: Thank you!\n{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.\p… … …  … … …\pUm… May I ask one more giant favor\nof you?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseINeedYourHelp
lines.text: It… It's not anything weird.\nPlease, I need your help.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherGemstoneInSeviiIslands
lines.text:
While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.\pThere is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.\pThat other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.\p{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReturnedTriPassForRainbowPass
lines.text: {PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and\nreceived the RAINBOW PASS.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedExtraMapPage
lines.text: Obtained an extra page for the\nTOWN MAP!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetYouGetToAllIslands
lines.text: This is my own ferry PASS.\pIt will let you get to all the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I can't do\nit without your help.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HandedSapphireToCelio
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed the SAPPHIRE\nto CELIO.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYouGiveMeTime
lines.text:
CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…\p{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?\pYou don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.\pThank you so much!\pNow it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OkayThisIsGood
lines.text: Okay, this is good…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUpWithLanette
lines.text: I did it!\nI linked up with LANETTE!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedToLinkWithHoennThankYou
lines.text:
{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!\pI've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!\pFinally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!\p{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!\pThanks to you, my dream came
true…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouBestOfLuck
lines.text: I…\nI'm not crying.\pThat's enough about me!\p{PLAYER}, you're going to keep\nlooking for exotic POKéMON, right?\pI wish you the best of luck!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHearingRumorsAboutYou
lines.text: CELIO: Hello!\p{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors\nabout you.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFirstMonWasAbra
lines.text:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?\pBILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHometownInGoldenrod
lines.text:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?\pI've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.\pBILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.\pI'd like to go there one day.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCantStomachMilk
lines.text: {PLAYER}, is there anything that\nyou can't stand?\pApparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFromPalletDontKnowIt
lines.text: Oh, you're a stranger here!\nHi! Where did you come from?\p…PALLET TOWN?\nI don't know it!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EnormousVolcanoOnIsland
lines.text: On this island, there's an enormous\nvolcano.\pIt hasn't erupted lately, so why\nnot enjoy a hike?$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICouldTradeWithBoyfriend
lines.text: I wish I could trade POKéMON with\nmy boyfriend who lives far away…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWithFarAwayBoyfriend
lines.text: I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend\nfar away!\pEveryone's saying that we can\nthank you and CELIO.\pSo, thank you!$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineUnderAdjustment
lines.text: Network Machine\nLink Level 0\p…POKéMON Storage System under\nadjustment…$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKanto
lines.text: Network Machine\nLink Level 1\pLink established with the KANTO\nregion.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKantoAndHoenn
lines.text: Network Machine\nLink Level 2\pLink established with the KANTO\nand HOENN regions.$

lines.label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedTriPass
lines.text: Obtained the TRI-PASS!$

lines.label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro
lines.text: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.$

lines.label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraDefeat
lines.text: I lost…\nIt feels awful.$

lines.label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBattle
lines.text: The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.$

lines.label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsWashUpOnBeach
lines.text: Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_OakDontGoOut
lines.text: OAK: Hey! Wait!\nDon't go out!$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon
lines.text:
OAK: It's unsafe!
Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!\pYou need your own POKéMON for
your protection.\pI know!
Here, come with me!$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo
lines.text: I'm raising POKéMON, too.\pWhen they get strong, they can\nprotect me.$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC
lines.text: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now store and recall items\nand POKéMON as data via PC.$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_OakPokemonResearchLab
lines.text: OAK POKéMON RESEARCH LAB$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_PlayersHouse
lines.text: {PLAYER}'s house$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_RivalsHouse
lines.text: {RIVAL}'s house$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: PALLET TOWN\nShades of your journey await!$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex
lines.text: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nYou're back, are you?\pHow much have you filled in your\nPOKéDEX?\pMay I see it?\pLet's see…$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEffort
lines.text: You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…\pHm, it looks as if you're putting\nin an honest effort.\pWhen you manage to fill it some\nmore, come show me, please.$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowMe
lines.text:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!?
Now, this is impressive!\pThere's something I wanted to ask
of you, {PLAYER}.\pCome.
Follow me.$

lines.label: PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling
lines.text:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
You seem to be enjoying traveling.\pKnowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily
imagine you going out to even more\lexotic locales.\pGood for you, good for you.
Hohoho.$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllBoysLeaveOakLookingForYou
lines.text: MOM: …Right.\nAll boys leave home someday.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllGirlsLeaveOakLookingForYou
lines.text: MOM: …Right.\nAll girls dream of traveling.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickRest
lines.text: MOM: {PLAYER}!\nYou should take a quick rest.$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LookingGreatTakeCare
lines.text: MOM: Oh, good! You and your\nPOKéMON are looking great.\lTake care now!$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVFourBoysOnRailroad
lines.text: There's a movie on TV.\nFour boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.\p…I better go, too.$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVGirlOnBrickRoad
lines.text: There's a movie on TV.\nA girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.\p…I better go, too.$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OopsWrongSide
lines.text: Oops, wrong side…$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PlayedWithNES
lines.text: {PLAYER} played with the NES.\p…Okay!\nIt's time to go!$

lines.label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PressLRForHelp
lines.text: It's a posted notice…\pIf you're confused, ask for HELP!\nPress the L or R Button!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGrampsIsntAround
lines.text: {RIVAL}: What, it's only {PLAYER}?\nGramps isn't around.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalFedUpWithWaiting
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Gramps!\nI'm fed up with waiting!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalNoFairWhatAboutMe
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! No fair!\nWhat about me?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoChoosePlayer
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Heh, I don't need to be\ngreedy like you. I'm mature!\pGo ahead and choose, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllTakeThisOneThen
lines.text: {RIVAL}: I'll take this one, then!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalReceivedMonFromOak
lines.text: {RIVAL} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. OAK!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalMyMonLooksTougher
lines.text: {RIVAL}: My POKéMON looks a lot\ntougher than yours.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLetsCheckOutMons
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}!\nLet's check out our POKéMON!\pCome on, I'll take you on!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalDefeat
lines.text: WHAT?\nUnbelievable!\lI picked the wrong POKéMON!$

lines.label: Text_RivalVictory
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Yeah!\nAm I great or what?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoToughenMyMon
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my\nPOKéMON battle to toughen it up!\p{PLAYER}! Gramps!\nSmell you later!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGramps
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Gramps!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalWhatDidYouCallMeFor
lines.text: {RIVAL}: I almost forgot!\nWhat did you call me for?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLeaveItToMeGramps
lines.text: {RIVAL}: All right, Gramps!\nLeave it all to me!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTellSisNotToGiveYouMap
lines.text:
{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but you
won't be necessary for this.\pI know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP
from my sis!\pI'll tell her not to lend you one,
{PLAYER}! Hahaha!\pDon't bother coming around to
my place after this!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThreeMonsChooseOne
lines.text:
OAK: {RIVAL}?
Let me think…\pOh, that's right, I told you to
come! Just wait!\pHere, {PLAYER}.\pThere are three POKéMON here.\pHaha!\pThe POKéMON are held inside
these POKé BALLS.\pWhen I was young, I was a serious
POKéMON TRAINER.\pBut now, in my old age, I have
only these three left.\pYou can have one.
Go on, choose!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBePatientRival
lines.text: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}.\nYou can have one, too!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakWhichOneWillYouChoose
lines.text: OAK: Now, {PLAYER}.\pInside those three POKé BALLS are\nPOKéMON.\pWhich one will you choose for\nyourself?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHeyDontGoAwayYet
lines.text: OAK: Hey!\nDon't go away yet!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingCharmander
lines.text: Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice.\nYou should raise it patiently.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you're claiming the\nFIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingSquirtle
lines.text: Hm! SQUIRTLE is your choice.\nIt's one worth raising.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you've decided on the\nWATER POKéMON SQUIRTLE?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingBulbasaur
lines.text: I see! BULBASAUR is your choice.\nIt's very easy to raise.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you want to go with\nthe GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThisMonIsEnergetic
lines.text: This POKéMON is really quite\nenergetic!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedMonFromOak
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. OAK!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCanReachNextTownWithMon
lines.text: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nyour POKéMON can battle it.\pWith it at your side, you should be\nable to reach the next town.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBattleMonForItToGrow
lines.text: OAK: {PLAYER}, raise your young\nPOKéMON by making it battle.\pIt has to battle for it to grow.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveSomethingForMe
lines.text:
OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}!
How is my old POKéMON?\pWell, it seems to be growing more
attached to you.\pYou must be talented as a POKéMON
TRAINER.\pWhat's that?
You have something for me?$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DeliveredOaksParcel
lines.text: {PLAYER} delivered OAK'S PARCEL.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCustomBallIOrdered
lines.text: Ah! \nIt's the custom POKé BALL!\pI had it on order.\nThank you!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveRequestForYouTwo
lines.text: OAK: Oh, right!\nI have a request for you two.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPokedexOnDesk
lines.text: On the desk there is my invention,\nthe POKéDEX!\pIt automatically records data on\nPOKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a high-tech encyclopedia!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTakeTheseWithYou
lines.text: OAK: {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}.\nTake these with you.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedPokedexFromOak
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX\nfrom PROF. OAK.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatchMonsForDataTakeThese
lines.text:
OAK: You can't get detailed data
on POKéMON by just seeing them.\pYou must catch them to obtain
complete data.\pSo, here are some tools for
catching wild POKéMON.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedFivePokeBalls
lines.text: {PLAYER} received five POKé BALLS.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExplainCatching
lines.text:
When a wild POKéMON appears,
it's fair game.\pJust throw a POKé BALL at it and
try to catch it!\pThis won't always work, however.\pA healthy POKéMON can escape.
You have to be lucky!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCompleteMonGuideWasMyDream
lines.text:
To make a complete guide on all
the POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!\pBut, I'm too old.
I can't get the job done.\pSo, I want you two to fulfill my
dream for me.\pGet moving, you two.\pThis is a great undertaking in
POKéMON history!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMonsAroundWorldWait
lines.text: POKéMON around the world wait for\nyou, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakAddedNothingToPokedex
lines.text:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
How is your POKéDEX shaping up?\p{RIVAL} has already caught some
POKéMON and added to the data.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let's have a look at
your POKéDEX.\p…What's the matter?
You've added no new data at all.\pI'll give you these, so do try a
little harder.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakComeSeeMeSometime
lines.text: OAK: Come see me sometime.\pAfter all, I want to know how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_BlankEncyclopedia
lines.text: It's like an encyclopedia, but the\npages are blank.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ThoseArePokeBalls
lines.text: Those are POKé BALLS.\nThey contain POKéMON!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OaksLastMon
lines.text: That's PROF. OAK's last POKéMON.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PressStartToOpenMenu
lines.text: Press START to open the MENU!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_SaveOptionInMenu
lines.text: The SAVE option is on the MENU.\nUse it regularly.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_AllMonTypesHaveStrongAndWeakPoints
lines.text: All POKéMON types have strong and\nweak points against others.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_EmailMessage
lines.text:
There's an e-mail message here.\p…\pFinally!
The ultimate TRAINERS of the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE are ready to\ltake on all comers!\pBring your best POKéMON and see
how you rate as a TRAINER!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ
INDIGO PLATEAU\pPROF. OAK, please visit us!
…$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_StudyAsOaksAide
lines.text: I study POKéMON as PROF. OAK's\nAIDE.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DaisyWillGroomMons
lines.text:
Hi, {PLAYER}. I bet you've become
good friends with your POKéMON.\pBy the way, did you know about
DAISY?\pIf you show DAISY your POKéMON,
she can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom
a POKéMON for you.\pThis is a secret, so please don't
tell anyone.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsGoingToHaveRadioShow
lines.text: PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK's POKéMON SEMINAR.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsAuthorityOnMons
lines.text: PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakFavorToAskYouPlayer
lines.text: Ah, now this is excellent!\p{PLAYER}, I have another important\nfavor to ask of you.\pI need you to listen closely.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakSightingsOfRareMons
lines.text:
Recently, there have been sightings
of many rare POKéMON species.\pI'm talking about POKéMON that
have never been seen in KANTO.\pI would love to go see things for
myself, but I'm much too old.\pSince I can't do it, {PLAYER}, I'd
like you to go in my place.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalJustLetMeHandleEverything
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, I heard that!\pGramps, what's with favoring
{PLAYER} over me all the time?\pI went and collected more POKéMON,
and faster, too.\pYou should just let me handle
everything.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNeedYourHelpTooNeedToSeePokedexes
lines.text: OAK: I know, I know.\nOf course I need your help, too.\pNow, I need to see both your\nPOKéDEXES.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTookBothPokedexUnits
lines.text: PROF. OAK took both POKéDEX\nunits.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNowTheseUnitsCanRecordMoreData
lines.text: … … …  … … …\p… … …  … … …\p…And that's done!\pNow these units can record data on\na lot more POKéMON.$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PlayersPokedexWasUpgraded
lines.text: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMustReallyWorkToFillPokedex
lines.text:
Now, {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}!\pThis time, you really must work
towards filling your POKéDEXES.\pI urge you to make them the best
and the most complete of all time!\pTruly, this is a monumentally great
undertaking in POKéMON history!$

lines.label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllCompleteThePokedex
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Gramps, calm down.
Don't get so excited.\pI'll get the POKéDEX completed,
don't you worry about a thing.\pI think I'll try looking around
ONE ISLAND first…\pAnyways, I'm outta here!$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAtLab
lines.text: DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pMy brother, {RIVAL}, is out at\nGrandpa's LAB.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBattledRival
lines.text: DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had\na battle against {RIVAL}.\pI wish I'd seen that!$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGrandpaThisWillHelp
lines.text: Grandpa asked you to run an\nerrand?\pGee, that's lazy of him.\nHere, this will help you.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ReceivedTownMapFromDaisy
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a TOWN MAP\nfrom DAISY.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
lines.text: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownMap
lines.text: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMonsRest
lines.text: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfKanto
lines.text: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCrammedFullOfBooks
lines.text: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroomMon
lines.text:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good timing.\pI'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?\pOh, but look.
Your POKéMON are a little dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyGrooming
lines.text: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_GroomWhichOne
lines.text: Which one should I groom?$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceInNoTime
lines.text: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnEgg
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirstMon
lines.text: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveYouMore
lines.text: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryHappy
lines.text: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFriendly
lines.text: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUpToYou
lines.text: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarWithYouYet
lines.text: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayItGlaresAtYou
lines.text: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonHateYouSoMuch
lines.text: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?$

lines.label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LovelyAndSweetClefairy
lines.text: “The lovely and sweet\nCLEFAIRY”$

lines.label: Text_DreamEaterTeach
lines.text:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!$

lines.label: Text_DreamEaterDeclined
lines.text: …Snore…$

lines.label: Text_DreamEaterWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?$

lines.label: Text_DreamEaterTaught
lines.text: …ZZZ…\nI…can't eat…anymore…$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon
lines.text: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerHere
lines.text:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum
lines.text: Did you check out the MUSEUM?$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazing
lines.text: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo
lines.text: Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum
lines.text: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing
lines.text: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_ThatsRightItsHardWork
lines.text: That's right!\nIt's hard work!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildMonsOut
lines.text: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChallengersFollowMe
lines.text: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock
lines.text: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieves
lines.text: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_MuseumOfScience
lines.text: PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_DefeatedBrockYouCanHaveTreasure
lines.text: あッれー！\nその　ジムバッジ‥‥\lすげえな　タケシに　かったのかよ！\pかんどう　したから\nおれの　たからもの　やるよ！$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_BerriesInsideUseCarefully
lines.text: なかには　きのみが　はいってるぜ\pやくに　たつ　きのみも\nはいって　いるから\lだいじに　つかって　くれよ！$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_MonsWillUseHeldBerriesOnTheirOwn
lines.text: ポケモンに　きのみを\nもたせて　おけば\lたたかっている　ときに\lかってに　つかって　くれるんだ\pキズぐすり　とか　どくけし　より\nてがるで　べんり　だろ？$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_OhPlayer
lines.text: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis
lines.text: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFromAide
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunningShoes
lines.text: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
lines.text: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab
lines.text: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMom
lines.text: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
lines.text:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
lines.text: Wait!\nTake this with you.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM39FromBrock
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM39\nfrom BROCK.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39
lines.text:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
lines.text:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
lines.text: You don't have room for this.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro
lines.text: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamDefeat
lines.text: Darn!\pLight-years isn't time…\nIt measures distance!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle
lines.text: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop
lines.text:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetsGetHappening
lines.text: All right!\nLet's get happening!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrders
lines.text:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappening
lines.text: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial
lines.text: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: PewterCity_House1_Text_Nidoran
lines.text: NIDORAN♂: Bowbow!$

lines.label: PewterCity_House1_Text_NidoranSit
lines.text: NIDORAN, sit!$

lines.label: PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinicky
lines.text:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…$

lines.label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniquesAsTheyGrow
lines.text: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.$

lines.label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIfStatused
lines.text:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFromShadyGuy
lines.text: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMonsDiligently
lines.text: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChildsTicket
lines.text: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ComeAgain
lines.text: Come again!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Right50YThankYou
lines.text: Right, ¥50!\nThank you!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
lines.text: You don't have enough money.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
lines.text: Please enjoy yourself.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatAmberIs
lines.text: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsGeneticMatter
lines.text: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossilizedSap
lines.text: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround
lines.text: あちらへ　おまわりください$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratefulForLongLife
lines.text: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAmberExamined
lines.text:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmberFromMan
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChecked
lines.text: Ssh!\nGet the OLD AMBER checked!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
lines.text: You don't have space for this.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossilsOnExhibit
lines.text: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.$
