lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPieceOfAmber
lines.text: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFossil
lines.text: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil
lines.text: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

lines.label: Text_SeismicTossTeach
lines.text:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?$

lines.label: Text_SeismicTossDeclined
lines.text: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.$

lines.label: Text_SeismicTossWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?$

lines.label: Text_SeismicTossTaught
lines.text: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAboutMoonStone
lines.text: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVForMoonLanding
lines.text: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceExhibitThisMonth
lines.text: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
lines.text: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
lines.text: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_SpaceShuttle
lines.text: Space Shuttle$

lines.label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
lines.text: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$

lines.label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketMtMoonImOnPhone
lines.text: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!$

lines.label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Jigglypuff
lines.text: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu!$

lines.label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJiggylypuffSingsMonsGetDrowsy
lines.text: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…$

lines.label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingMyClefairyForPikachu
lines.text: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.$

lines.label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingPikachuWithKid
lines.text: I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro
lines.text:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIntro
lines.text:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the child that OAK's taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: Oh, my!\nYou're something special, child!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattle
lines.text: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro
lines.text:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchIntro
lines.text:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: Why?\nHow could I lose?$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle
lines.text: My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchIntro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou came back, {PLAYER}!
Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Victory
lines.text:
はーはッ！
かった！　かった！　かった！\p{PLAYER}に　まける　ような
おれさま　では　なーい！\pま！　ポケモンの
てんさい　{RIVAL}さま　あいてに\lここまで　よく　がんばった！\pほめて　つかわす！
はーッ！　はーはッはッ！$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattle
lines.text:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayer
lines.text: OAK: {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
lines.text:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDisappointedRival
lines.text:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayerComeWithMe
lines.text:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Text_OakCongratulations
lines.text:
OAK: Er-hem!
Congratulations, {PLAYER}!\pThis floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME.\pPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here.\pTheir POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME.\p{PLAYER}!\pYou have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro
lines.text:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_RematchIntro
lines.text:
Ah!
So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle
lines.text:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro
lines.text:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.\pNo one can best me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchIntro
lines.text:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: …Things shouldn't be this way!$

lines.label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBattle
lines.text: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro
lines.text: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedDefeat
lines.text: Ouch!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle
lines.text: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonIntro
lines.text: W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonDefeat
lines.text: Tch!\nI can't get any wins.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
lines.text: I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\pI ought to go soon.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitch
lines.text: A secret switch!\pPress it?$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_Text_WhoWouldnt
lines.text: Who wouldn't?$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_Text_NotQuiteYet
lines.text: Not quite yet!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro
lines.text: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no!\nMy bag of loot!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle
lines.text: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_NewMonDiscoveredInGuyanaJungle
lines.text: Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\pA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscoveredMonMew
lines.text: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitchJP
lines.text: ひみつの　スイッチが　ある！\pおして　みますか？$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_Text_LetsTryIt
lines.text: おしてみよう！　‥ポチッとな$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_Text_GaveUpOnPressingSwitch
lines.text: おすのは　あきらめた$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonIntro
lines.text: This place is, like, huge!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonDefeat
lines.text: Ayah!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle
lines.text: I wonder where my partner went.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonIntro
lines.text: My mentor once lived here.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonDefeat
lines.text: Whew!\nOverwhelming!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle
lines.text: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMewtwo
lines.text: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisIntro
lines.text: Uh-oh…\nWhere am I now?$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisDefeat
lines.text: Awooh!$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle
lines.text: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro
lines.text: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanDefeat
lines.text: What was that for?$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle
lines.text: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.$

lines.label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_MewtwoIsFarTooPowerful
lines.text: Diary: Sept. 1\nMEWTWO is far too powerful.\pWe have failed to curb its vicious\ntendencies…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDeadMons
lines.text: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSon
lines.text: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGirl
lines.text: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepartedClefairy
lines.text: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_GrowlitheWhyDidYouDie
lines.text: My GROWLITHE…\nWhy did you die?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMischief
lines.text: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro
lines.text: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat
lines.text: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalVictory
lines.text: {RIVAL}“あーあ‥！\nほんとに　くたばっちまったぞ！\lよわいなー！\lもっと　ちゃんと　そだてて　やれよ$

lines.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalPostBattle
lines.text:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_SilphScopeCouldUnmaskGhosts
lines.text: Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopeIntro
lines.text: Urrg… Awaa…\nHuhu… Graa…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopeDefeat
lines.text: Hwa!\nI'm saved!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle
lines.text: The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyIntro
lines.text: Kekeke…\nKwaaah!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyDefeat
lines.text: Hmm?\nWhat am I doing?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyPostBattle
lines.text: Sorry!\nI was possessed!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaIntro
lines.text: Be gone!\nMalevolent spirit!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaDefeat
lines.text: Whew!\nThe spirit left!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
lines.text: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaIntro
lines.text: Ghost! No!\nKwaaah!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaDefeat
lines.text: Where is the ghost?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaPostBattle
lines.text: I must have been dreaming…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelIntro
lines.text: Be cursed with me!\nKwaaah!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelDefeat
lines.text: What!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelPostBattle
lines.text: We can't determine the identity of\nthe ghosts…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyIntro
lines.text: Huhuhu…\nBeat me not!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyDefeat
lines.text: Huh?\nWho? What?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle
lines.text: May the departed POKéMON rest in\npeace…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RestHereInPurifiedSpace
lines.text: Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\lYou can rest here.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyIntro
lines.text: Give…me…\nyour…all…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyDefeat
lines.text: Gasp!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyPostBattle
lines.text: I was under possession.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthIntro
lines.text: You…shall…\njoin…us…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthDefeat
lines.text: What a nightmare!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthPostBattle
lines.text: I was possessed.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaIntro
lines.text: Zombies!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaDefeat
lines.text: Ha?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaPostBattle
lines.text: I regained my senses.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeIntro
lines.text: Urgah…\nUrff…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeDefeat
lines.text: Whoo!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle
lines.text: I fell to evil spirits despite my\ntraining in the mountains…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_PurifiedZoneMonsFullyHealed
lines.text: Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaIntro
lines.text: Give…me…\nblood…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaDefeat
lines.text: Groan!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
lines.text: I feel anemic and weak…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaIntro
lines.text: Urff…\nKwaah!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaDefeat
lines.text: Something fell out!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle
lines.text: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferIntro
lines.text: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferDefeat
lines.text: Keee!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferPostBattle
lines.text: What's going on here?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_BeGoneIntruders
lines.text: Be gone…\nIntruders…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_GhostWasCubonesMother
lines.text: The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCalmed
lines.text: The mother's spirit was calmed.\pIt departed to the afterlife…$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: I give up!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: I'm not going to forget this!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Please!\nNo more!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: You're not saving anyone, kid!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: Don't fight us ROCKETS!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: You're not getting away with this!$

lines.label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollowMe
lines.text:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Oww!\nBeaten!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Boom!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: Intruder alert!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: I can't do it!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: Why did you come here?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: This won't do!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
lines.text: Are you lost, you little mouse?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
lines.text: Why…?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
lines.text: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: I surrender!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle
lines.text: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Oof!\nTaken down!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: What?\nI lost? No!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro
lines.text:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
lines.text: WHAT!\nThis can't be!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
lines.text: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Burned again!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: Ayaya!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: BOSS!\nI'm sorry I failed you!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: No!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!$

lines.label: RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNeedAKey
lines.text: It appears to need a key.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro
lines.text: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyDefeat
lines.text: Doh!\nYou win!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle
lines.text: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro
lines.text: Hmm.\nMaybe I'm lost in here…$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat
lines.text: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle
lines.text: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro
lines.text: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasDefeat
lines.text: I give!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasPostBattle
lines.text: You're talented enough to hike!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonIntro
lines.text: POKéMON fight!\nReady, go!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonDefeat
lines.text: Game over!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle
lines.text: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro
lines.text: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahDefeat
lines.text: It was too dark…$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle
lines.text: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro
lines.text: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaDefeat
lines.text: I'm out of POKéMON!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle
lines.text: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaIntro
lines.text: You have POKéMON!\nLet's start!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaDefeat
lines.text: You play hard!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaPostBattle
lines.text: Whew!\nI'm all sweaty now.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROCK TUNNEL\nCERULEAN CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro
lines.text: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaDefeat
lines.text: Ohhh!\nI did my best!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaPostBattle
lines.text: I want to go home!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyIntro
lines.text: Hahaha!\nCan you beat my power?$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyDefeat
lines.text: Oops!\nOutmuscled!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle
lines.text: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro
lines.text: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperDefeat
lines.text: Shoot!\nI am so jealous!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle
lines.text: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro
lines.text: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveDefeat
lines.text: Well, that's that.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenDefeat
lines.text: I give!\nYou're a better technician!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle
lines.text: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro
lines.text: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nI lost!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle
lines.text: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro
lines.text: Hit me with your best shot!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricDefeat
lines.text: Fired away!$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle
lines.text: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro
lines.text: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonDefeat
lines.text: Whew…\nI'm exhausted…$

lines.label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle
lines.text: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.$

lines.label: Route1_Text_WorkAtPokeMartTakeSample
lines.text:
Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.\pIt's part of a convenient chain
selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.
Here you go!$

lines.label: Route1_Text_ComeSeeUsIfYouNeedPokeBalls
lines.text: Please come see us if you need\nPOKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route1_Text_PutPotionAway
lines.text: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in\nthe BAG's ITEMS POCKET.$

lines.label: Route1_Text_CanJumpFromLedges
lines.text: See those ledges along the road?\pIt's a bit scary, but you can jump\nfrom them.\pYou can get back to PALLET TOWN\nquicker that way.$

lines.label: Route1_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 1\nPALLET TOWN - VIRIDIAN CITY$

lines.label: Route10_Text_MarkIntro
lines.text: Wow, you came all the way here?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?$

lines.label: Route10_Text_MarkDefeat
lines.text: Humph.\nI'm not angry!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle
lines.text: I have more rare POKéMON at home!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_ClarkIntro
lines.text: Ha-hahah-ah-ha!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_ClarkDefeat
lines.text: Ha-haha!\nNot laughing!\lHa-hay fever! Haha-ha-choo!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_ClarkPostBattle
lines.text: Haha-ha-choo!\nHa-choo!\lSnort! Snivel!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HermanIntro
lines.text: Hi, kid!\nWant to see my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HermanDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no!\nMy POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle
lines.text: I don't like you.\nI don't like anyone better than me!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HeidiIntro
lines.text: I've been out at a POKéMON GYM\na few times.\p…But I always lose.$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HeidiDefeat
lines.text: Ohh!\nAfter all my training!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HeidiPostBattle
lines.text: I noticed some POKéMANIACS\nprowling around.\pCan you imagine? Them?\nUp here in the mountains?$

lines.label: Route10_Text_TrentIntro
lines.text: Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_TrentDefeat
lines.text: That cleared my head!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle
lines.text: I feel bloated on mountain air!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_CarolIntro
lines.text: I'm feeling a bit faint.\nI haven't hiked in some time.$

lines.label: Route10_Text_CarolDefeat
lines.text: I'm too tired.\nI wasn't up for it.$

lines.label: Route10_Text_CarolPostBattle
lines.text: The POKéMON here in the mountains\nare so chunky…\pI wish there were pink POKéMON\nwith a floral pattern!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_RockTunnelDetourToLavender
lines.text: ROCK TUNNEL\nDetour to LAVENDER TOWN$

lines.label: Route10_Text_RockTunnel
lines.text: ROCK TUNNEL$

lines.label: Route10_Text_PowerPlant
lines.text: POWER PLANT$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeStrongerThanOthers
lines.text: The types of POKéMON match up\ndifferently with each other.\pEvery type is stronger than some\ntypes and weaker than others.$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUselessSoldFor5000
lines.text: A NUGGET is totally useless.\nSo I sold it for ¥5000.$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhostsHauntLavender
lines.text: I heard that ghosts haunt\nLAVENDER TOWN.$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverstoneIfCaught20Mons
lines.text:
Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!\pIt's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward from PROF. OAK.\pHe entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
lines.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedEverstoneFromAide
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the EVERSTONE\nfrom the AIDE.$

lines.label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEverstone
lines.text:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.\pHowever, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.\pIn that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.\pIt will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_HugoIntro
lines.text: Win, lose, or draw!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_HugoDefeat
lines.text: Atcha!\nDidn't go my way!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_HugoPostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON is life!\nAnd to live is to play games!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_JasperIntro
lines.text: Competition!\nI can't get enough!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_JasperDefeat
lines.text: I had a chance!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_JasperPostBattle
lines.text: You can't be a coward in the world\nof POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_EddieIntro
lines.text: Let's go, but don't cheat!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_EddieDefeat
lines.text: Huh?\nThat's not right!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_EddiePostBattle
lines.text: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BraxtonIntro
lines.text: Careful!\nI'm laying down some cables!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BraxtonDefeat
lines.text: That was electric!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
lines.text: Spread the word to save energy!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DillonIntro
lines.text: I just became a TRAINER.\nBut, I think I can win.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DillonDefeat
lines.text: My POKéMON couldn't win…\nHaven't they grown enough?$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DillonPostBattle
lines.text: What now?\nLeave me alone!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DirkIntro
lines.text: Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DirkDefeat
lines.text: My first loss!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DirkPostBattle
lines.text: You were just lucky, that's all.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DarianIntro
lines.text: I have never won before…$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DarianDefeat
lines.text: I saw this coming…$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DarianPostBattle
lines.text: I was unlucky, as always.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_YasuIntro
lines.text: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_YasuDefeat
lines.text: Darn!\nMy POKéMON need to be stronger!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_YasuPostBattle
lines.text: There's a fat POKéMON that comes\ndown from the mountains.\pI bet it'd be strong if you can\ncatch it.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BernieIntro
lines.text: Watch out for live wires!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BernieDefeat
lines.text: Whoa!\nYou spark plug!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BerniePostBattle
lines.text: Well, better get back to work.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DaveIntro
lines.text: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DaveDefeat
lines.text: Bye-bye!\nThank you, and good-bye!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DavePostBattle
lines.text: Tch…\nI better go find stronger ones!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DiglettsCave
lines.text: DIGLETT'S CAVE$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_BagIsFull
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}の　バッグ\nいっぱい　みたい　だね$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavenderRatesNames
lines.text:
Don't you think it's hard to think
up good names for POKéMON?\pEspecially if you've caught a
whole bunch?\pIn LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelToReachLavender
lines.text: If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER\nTOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.\pYou can get to ROCK TUNNEL from\nCERULEAN CITY.$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemfinderIfCaught30
lines.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
lines.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedItemfinderFromAide
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the AIDE.$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainItemfinder
lines.text:
There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.\pUse the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.\pThe machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.\pWhat it does is show the direction
where the item is.\pUse it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_BigMonAsleepOnRoad
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA big POKéMON is asleep on a road!$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_WhatABreathtakingView
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pWhat a breathtaking view!$

lines.label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_RockTunnelGoodRouteToLavender
lines.text:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…\pTo get to LAVENDER TOWN from
CERULEAN CITY…\pROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good
route to take.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
lines.text: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$

lines.label: Text_SnorlaxWokeUp
lines.text: SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!$

lines.label: Text_SnorlaxReturnedToMountains
lines.text: SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.$

lines.label: Text_WantToUsePokeFlute
lines.text: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?$

lines.label: Text_PlayedPokeFlute
lines.text: {PLAYER} played the POKé FLUTE.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_NedIntro
lines.text: Yeah!\nI got a bite here!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_NedDefeat
lines.text: Tch!\nJust a small fry…$

lines.label: Route12_Text_NedPostBattle
lines.text: Hang on!\nMy line's snagged!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ChipIntro
lines.text: Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ChipDefeat
lines.text: That one got away!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle
lines.text: With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JustinIntro
lines.text: I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JustinDefeat
lines.text: Oww!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle
lines.text: I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_LucaIntro
lines.text: Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_LucaDefeat
lines.text: Unplugged!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle
lines.text: Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_HankIntro
lines.text: The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON\nKID!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_HankDefeat
lines.text: Touch too much!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_HankPostBattle
lines.text: I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ElliotIntro
lines.text: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ElliotDefeat
lines.text: It's not easy…$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle
lines.text: It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_AndrewIntro
lines.text: What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_AndrewDefeat
lines.text: Lost it!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle
lines.text: What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 12 \nNorth to LAVENDER$

lines.label: Route12_Text_SportfishingArea
lines.text: SPORTFISHING AREA$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JesIntro
lines.text: JES: If I win, I'm going to\npropose to GIA.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JesDefeat
lines.text: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you\nlet us win?$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JesPostBattle
lines.text: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,\nmy love!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JES: GIA and I, we'll be\ntogether forever.\pWe won't battle unless you have\ntwo POKéMON of your own.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_GiaIntro
lines.text: GIA: Hey, JES…\pIf we win, I'll marry you!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_GiaDefeat
lines.text: GIA: Oh, but why?$

lines.label: Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle
lines.text: GIA: JES, you silly!\nYou ruined this!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: GIA: I can't bear to battle\nwithout my JES!\pDon't you have one more POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
lines.text: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFish
lines.text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperRod
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigMagikarpShowMe
lines.text:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhThatsDisappointing
lines.text: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBringMeMagikarp
lines.text:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllowMeToSee
lines.text: Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXInchesTakeThis
lines.text:
… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2} inches!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToGreaterRecords
lines.text: I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXInchesSameSizeAsLast
lines.text: Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2} inches?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXInchesDoesntMeasureUp
lines.text: Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLikeMagikarp
lines.text: Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift
lines.text: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMagikarpXInches
lines.text: The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!$

lines.label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
lines.text: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpotUpstairs
lines.text: There's a lookout spot upstairs.\nThe view is magnificent.$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreMale
lines.text: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreFemale
lines.text: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedTM27FromLittleGirl
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM27\nfrom the little girl.$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM27
lines.text: TM27 is a move called RETURN…\pIf you treat your POKéMON good,\nit will return your love by working\lits hardest in battle.$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
lines.text: You don't have room for this.$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManFishing
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a man fishing!$

lines.label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemonTower
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's POKéMON TOWER!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SebastianIntro
lines.text: My bird POKéMON want to battle\nwith you!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SebastianDefeat
lines.text: My PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO combo\nlost?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle
lines.text: My POKéMON look happy even though\nthey lost.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SusieIntro
lines.text: I'm told I'm good for a kid.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SusieDefeat
lines.text: Ohh!\nI lost!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SusiePostBattle
lines.text: I want to become a good TRAINER.\nI'll train hard, just watch.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_ValerieIntro
lines.text: Wow!\nYour BADGES are too cool!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_ValerieDefeat
lines.text: Not enough!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_ValeriePostBattle
lines.text: You got those BADGES from GYM\nLEADERS. I know!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_GwenIntro
lines.text: My cute POKéMON wish to make your\nacquaintance.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_GwenDefeat
lines.text: Good going!\nYou totally won!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle
lines.text: You have to make POKéMON battle\nto toughen them up.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_AlmaIntro
lines.text: I found CARBOS in a cave once\nwhile I was spelunking.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, too bad!\nI just messed up!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle
lines.text: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_PerryIntro
lines.text: I'm not going to lose.\nNot when the wind's blowing my way!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_PerryDefeat
lines.text: The wind turned!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle
lines.text: I'm beat.\nI guess I'll FLY home.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_LolaIntro
lines.text: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_LolaDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nYou little beast!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle
lines.text: I wonder which is stronger, male or\nfemale POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SheilaIntro
lines.text: Do you want to battle some\nPOKéMON with me?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SheilaDefeat
lines.text: It's over already?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle
lines.text: I don't know anything about\nPOKéMON actually.\pThe ones I use… I picked them\nfor their looks!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_JaredIntro
lines.text: What're you lookin' at?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_JaredDefeat
lines.text: Dang!\nStripped gears!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_JaredPostBattle
lines.text: Get lost!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_RobertIntro
lines.text: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_RobertDefeat
lines.text: Out of power!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle
lines.text: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and\nPIDGEOTTO…$

lines.label: Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pLook, look!\nLook to the left of that post!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SelectToSwitchItems
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pUse SELECT to switch items in the\nITEMS window.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 13\nNorth to SILENCE BRIDGE$

lines.label: Route14_Text_CarterIntro
lines.text: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_CarterDefeat
lines.text: Not good enough quite yet.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle
lines.text: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MitchIntro
lines.text: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MitchDefeat
lines.text: Not ready yet!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MitchPostBattle
lines.text: My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BeckIntro
lines.text: They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BeckDefeat
lines.text: Aww, bummer!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BeckPostBattle
lines.text: Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MarlonIntro
lines.text: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MarlonDefeat
lines.text: Shot down in flames!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MarlonPostBattle
lines.text: Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_DonaldIntro
lines.text: Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_DonaldDefeat
lines.text: Why?\nWhy'd I lose?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle
lines.text: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BennyIntro
lines.text: I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BennyDefeat
lines.text: I knew it!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BennyPostBattle
lines.text: Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_LukasIntro
lines.text: C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_LukasDefeat
lines.text: Arrg!\nLost! Get lost!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_LukasPostBattle
lines.text: What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_IsaacIntro
lines.text: I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_IsaacDefeat
lines.text: What?\nYou!?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle
lines.text: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_GeraldIntro
lines.text: We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_GeraldDefeat
lines.text: Wipeout!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle
lines.text: It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MalikIntro
lines.text: POKéMON battle?\nCool! Rumble!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MalikDefeat
lines.text: Blown away!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MalikPostBattle
lines.text: You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 14\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY$

lines.label: Route14_Text_KiriIntro
lines.text: KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_KiriDefeat
lines.text: KIRI: Whimper…\nWe lost, didn't we?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_KiriPostBattle
lines.text: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_KiriNotEnoughMons
lines.text: KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_JanIntro
lines.text: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_JanDefeat
lines.text: JAN: Eeeeh!\nNo fair!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_JanPostBattle
lines.text: JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_JanNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_KindraIntro
lines.text: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_KindraDefeat
lines.text: Not good enough!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle
lines.text: You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_BeckyIntro
lines.text: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_BeckyDefeat
lines.text: No, wrong!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_BeckyPostBattle
lines.text: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_EdwinIntro
lines.text: When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_EdwinDefeat
lines.text: Ow!\nThat's tragic!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle
lines.text: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ChesterIntro
lines.text: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ChesterDefeat
lines.text: Just as I thought!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle
lines.text: This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_GraceIntro
lines.text: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_GraceDefeat
lines.text: You looked so cute, too!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_GracePostBattle
lines.text: I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_OliviaIntro
lines.text: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat
lines.text: POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle
lines.text: I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ErnestIntro
lines.text: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ErnestDefeat
lines.text: Why not?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ErnestPostBattle
lines.text: Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_AlexIntro
lines.text: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_AlexDefeat
lines.text: That can't be true!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle
lines.text: I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_CeliaIntro
lines.text: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_CeliaDefeat
lines.text: I said trade!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_CeliaPostBattle
lines.text: I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_YazminIntro
lines.text: Want to play with my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_YazminDefeat
lines.text: I was too impatient!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_YazminPostBattle
lines.text: I'll go train with weaker people.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 15\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY$

lines.label: Route15_Text_MyaIntro
lines.text: MYA: You're perfect.\nHelp me train my little brother?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_MyaDefeat
lines.text: MYA: RON, you have to focus!\nConcentrate on what you're doing!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle
lines.text: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_RonIntro
lines.text: RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_RonDefeat
lines.text: RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_RonPostBattle
lines.text: RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…$

lines.label: Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons
lines.text: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_1F_Text_OaksAideCameByHere
lines.text: Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfCaughtEnough
lines.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
lines.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedItemFromAide
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the AIDE.$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpShare
lines.text: EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShiningBird
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.$

lines.label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIslandOnHorizon
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LaoIntro
lines.text: What do you want?$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LaoDefeat
lines.text: Don't you dare laugh!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LaoPostBattle
lines.text: We like just hanging here.\nWhat's it to you?$

lines.label: Route16_Text_KojiIntro
lines.text: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_KojiDefeat
lines.text: Knockout!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_KojiPostBattle
lines.text: Forget it, who needs your BIKE!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LukeIntro
lines.text: Come out and play, little mouse!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LukeDefeat
lines.text: You little rat!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LukePostBattle
lines.text: I hate losing!\nGet out of my face!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_HideoIntro
lines.text: Hey, you just bumped me!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_HideoDefeat
lines.text: Kaboom!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_HideoPostBattle
lines.text: We'll always be hanging around here\neven if you don't like it.\pYou can detour to VERMILION from\nFUCHSIA going along the coast.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_CamronIntro
lines.text: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI need a punching bag!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_CamronDefeat
lines.text: Bad, bad, bad!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_CamronPostBattle
lines.text: If I'm going to have POKéMON, they\nmay as well be ferocious.\pI'd use them to leave my enemies\nin tatters.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_RubenIntro
lines.text: Hey, there!\nLet's have ourselves a good time!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_RubenDefeat
lines.text: Don't make me mad!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_RubenPostBattle
lines.text: I get my kicks by harassing people\nwith my stinking POKéMON.\pThey're great for startling people.\nAnd, they bite, too.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
lines.text: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_CyclingRoadSign
lines.text: Enjoy the slope!\nCYCLING ROAD$

lines.label: Route16_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 16\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY$

lines.label: Route16_Text_JedIntro
lines.text: JED: Our love knows no bounds.\nWe're in love and we show it!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_JedDefeat
lines.text: JED: Oh, no!\nMy love has seen me as a loser!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_JedPostBattle
lines.text: JED: Listen, LEA.\nYou need to focus less on me.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JED: You have just one POKéMON?\nIs there no love in your heart?$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LeaIntro
lines.text: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LeaDefeat
lines.text: LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool\neven in a loss!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LeaPostBattle
lines.text: LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry.\nJED is so cool.$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LEA: Oh, you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you?\pDoesn't it feel lonely for you or\nyour POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route16_House_Text_FoundMySecretRetreat
lines.text: Oh, dear.\nYou've found my secret retreat.\pPlease don't tell anyone I'm here.\nI'll make it up to you with this!$

lines.label: Route16_House_Text_ReceivedHM02FromGirl
lines.text: {PLAYER} received HM02\nfrom the girl.$

lines.label: Route16_House_Text_ExplainHM02
lines.text: HM02 is FLY.\nIt's a wonderfully convenient move.\pPlease, put it to good use.$

lines.label: Route16_House_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForThis
lines.text: You don't have any room for this.$

lines.label: Route16_House_Text_Fearow
lines.text: FEAROW: Kyueen!$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_NoPedestriansOnCyclingRoad
lines.text: No pedestrians are allowed on\nCYCLING ROAD!$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoadIsDownhillCourse
lines.text: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course\nby the sea. It's a great ride.$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_ExcuseMeWaitUp
lines.text: Excuse me!\nWait up, please!$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_HowdYouGetInGoodEffort
lines.text: How'd you get in?\nGood effort!$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_OnBikeRideWithGirlfriend
lines.text: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new\nbike with my girlfriend.$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_RidingTogetherOnNewBikes
lines.text: We're going riding together on our\nnew bikes.$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsCeladonDeptStore
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_LongPathOverWater
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a long path over water far\naway.$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GiveAmuletCoinIfCaught40
lines.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
lines.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedAmuletCoinFromAide
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN\nfrom the AIDE.$

lines.label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainAmuletCoin
lines.text: An AMULET COIN is an item to be\nheld by a POKéMON.\pIf the POKéMON appears in a winning\nbattle, you will earn more money.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_RaulIntro
lines.text: There's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_RaulDefeat
lines.text: Burned out!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_RaulPostBattle
lines.text: You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling them.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahIntro
lines.text: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahDefeat
lines.text: Whoo!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
lines.text: I could belly-bump you outta\nhere!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_VirgilIntro
lines.text: You heading to FUCHSIA?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_VirgilDefeat
lines.text: Crash and burn!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_VirgilPostBattle
lines.text: I love racing downhill!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_BillyIntro
lines.text: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_BillyDefeat
lines.text: Smoked!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_BillyPostBattle
lines.text: Are you looking for adventure?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_NikolasIntro
lines.text: Let VOLTORB electrify you!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_NikolasDefeat
lines.text: Grounded out!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle
lines.text: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_ZeekIntro
lines.text: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_ZeekDefeat
lines.text: Why, you!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_ZeekPostBattle
lines.text: Maybe some POKéMON need element\nSTONES to evolve.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JamalIntro
lines.text: I need a little exercise!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JamalDefeat
lines.text: Whew!\nGood workout!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JamalPostBattle
lines.text: I'm sure I lost weight there!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_CoreyIntro
lines.text: Be a rebel!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_CoreyDefeat
lines.text: Aaaargh!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_CoreyPostBattle
lines.text: Be ready to fight for your beliefs!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JaxonIntro
lines.text: Nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JaxonDefeat
lines.text: Shoot!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JaxonPostBattle
lines.text: The slope makes it hard to steer.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_WilliamIntro
lines.text: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_WilliamDefeat
lines.text: Are you satisfied?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_WilliamPostBattle
lines.text: I need to catch a few z's!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_WatchOutForDiscardedItems
lines.text: It's a notice.\pWatch out for discarded items.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_SameSpeciesGrowDifferentRates
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON are unique.\pEven POKéMON of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_PressBToStayInPlace
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pPress the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 17\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY$

lines.label: Route17_Text_DontThrowGameThrowBalls
lines.text: It's a notice!\pDon't throw the game, throw POKé\nBALLS instead!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_CyclingRoadSign
lines.text: CYCLING ROAD\nSlope ends here!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_WiltonIntro
lines.text: I always check every grassy area\nfor new POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route18_Text_WiltonDefeat
lines.text: Tch!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_WiltonPostBattle
lines.text: I wish I had a BIKE!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_RamiroIntro
lines.text: Kurukkoo!\nHow do you like my birdcall?$

lines.label: Route18_Text_RamiroDefeat
lines.text: I had to bug you!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_RamiroPostBattle
lines.text: I collect sea POKéMON on weekends\nbecause the sea is so close.$

lines.label: Route18_Text_JacobIntro
lines.text: This is my turf!\nGet out of here!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_JacobDefeat
lines.text: Darn!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_JacobPostBattle
lines.text: This is my fave area for catching\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: Route18_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 18\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY$

lines.label: Route18_Text_CyclingRoadSign
lines.text: CYCLING ROAD\nNo pedestrians permitted!$

lines.label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_NeedBicycleForCyclingRoad
lines.text: You need a BICYCLE to go out on\nCYCLING ROAD!$

lines.label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoadAllUphillFromHere
lines.text: CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from\nhere.$

lines.label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ExcuseMe
lines.text: Excuse me!$

lines.label: Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PalletTownInWest
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pPALLET TOWN is in the west.$

lines.label: Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PeopleSwimming
lines.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere are people swimming.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_RichardIntro
lines.text: I have to exercise and warm up\nbefore going out for a swim.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_RichardDefeat
lines.text: All warmed up!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_RichardPostBattle
lines.text: Thanks, kid!\nI'm ready for a swim.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ReeceIntro
lines.text: Wait! Slow down!\nYou'll have a heart attack!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ReeceDefeat
lines.text: Ooh!\nThat's chilly!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ReecePostBattle
lines.text: Watch out for TENTACOOL.\nThey sting so painfully.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_MatthewIntro
lines.text: I love swimming!\nWhat about you?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_MatthewDefeat
lines.text: Belly flop!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_MatthewPostBattle
lines.text: I can beat even marine POKéMON\nat swimming.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DouglasIntro
lines.text: What's beyond the horizon?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DouglasDefeat
lines.text: Glub!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DouglasPostBattle
lines.text: I see a couple of islands over\nyonder!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DavidIntro
lines.text: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it\nwas a no-go.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DavidDefeat
lines.text: Help!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DavidPostBattle
lines.text: I guess you have to fish for sea\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_TonyIntro
lines.text: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_TonyDefeat
lines.text: Ooh!\nTraumatic!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_TonyPostBattle
lines.text: I'm looking at the sea to forget\nthe bad thing that happened!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AnyaIntro
lines.text: Oh, I just love your ride!\nCan I have it if I win?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AnyaDefeat
lines.text: Oh! I lost!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AnyaPostBattle
lines.text: It's still a long way to go to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS…\pI want to go back to FUCHSIA…$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AliceIntro
lines.text: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AliceDefeat
lines.text: Shocker!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AlicePostBattle
lines.text: My boyfriend wanted to swim to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AxleIntro
lines.text: Ahoy, there!\nThese waters are treacherous!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AxleDefeat
lines.text: Ooh!\nDangerous!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AxlePostBattle
lines.text: M-my legs! They cramped up!\nGlub, glub…$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ConnieIntro
lines.text: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ConnieDefeat
lines.text: I'm exhausted…$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ConniePostBattle
lines.text: If I were to ride a POKéMON on\nthe sea, I'd like a LAPRAS.\pLAPRAS is so big, I bet it\nwould keep me dry on water.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: SEA ROUTE 19\nFUCHSIA CITY - SEAFOAM ISLANDS$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LiaIntro
lines.text: LIA: I'm looking after my brother.\nHe just became a TRAINER.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LiaDefeat
lines.text: LIA: That's no way to treat my\nlittle brother!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LiaPostBattle
lines.text: LIA: Do you have a younger\nbrother?\pI hope you're teaching him all\nsorts of things.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LiaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LIA: I want to battle together\nwith my little brother.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LucIntro
lines.text: LUC: My big sis taught me how\nto swim and train POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LucDefeat
lines.text: LUC: Oh, wow!\nSomeone tougher than my big sis!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LucPostBattle
lines.text: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice.\nI think she's awesome!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LucNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LUC: I don't want to if I can't\nbattle you with my big sis.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route2_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 2\nVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$

lines.label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCave
lines.text: DIGLETT'S CAVE$

lines.label: Route20_Text_BarryIntro
lines.text: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_BarryDefeat
lines.text: Splash!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_BarryPostBattle
lines.text: I wish I could ride my POKéMON.\nI bet you're not tired.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyIntro
lines.text: SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway.\nI'm vacationing here.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyDefeat
lines.text: Quit it!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
lines.text: There's a huge cavern underneath\nthis island.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_TiffanyIntro
lines.text: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_TiffanyDefeat
lines.text: Yowch!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
lines.text: Want to float with me?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_IreneIntro
lines.text: Are you on vacation, too?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_IreneDefeat
lines.text: No mercy at all!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_IrenePostBattle
lines.text: SEAFOAM used to be a single island\nin the distant past.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DeanIntro
lines.text: Check out my buff physique!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DeanDefeat
lines.text: Wimpy!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DeanPostBattle
lines.text: I should've been buffing up my\nPOKéMON, not me!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DarrinIntro
lines.text: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nCan't you swim?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DarrinDefeat
lines.text: Ouch!\nTorpedoed!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DarrinPostBattle
lines.text: Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_RogerIntro
lines.text: I rode my bird POKéMON here.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_RogerDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no!\nNow what am I to do?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_RogerPostBattle
lines.text: My birds are exhausted.\nThey can't FLY me back!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_NoraIntro
lines.text: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_NoraDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no!\nMy pearls were in them!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_NoraPostBattle
lines.text: Will my pearls grow bigger inside\nCLOYSTER?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MissyIntro
lines.text: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, I tell you.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MissyDefeat
lines.text: I'm so disappointed!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MissyPostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON have taken over an\nabandoned mansion on CINNABAR.\pThey call it the POKéMON MANSION\nnow.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MelissaIntro
lines.text: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MelissaDefeat
lines.text: Wait!\nYou're supposed to wait!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MelissaPostBattle
lines.text: CINNABAR is a volcanic island.\pI heard it rose out of the sea\nwhen a volcano erupted.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_SeafoamIslands
lines.text: SEAFOAM ISLANDS$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MistyTrainsHere
lines.text: Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro
lines.text: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldDefeat
lines.text: Dang!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle
lines.text: I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro
lines.text: I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat
lines.text: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle
lines.text: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro
lines.text: The sea cleanses my body and soul!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerDefeat
lines.text: Ayah!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle
lines.text: The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallIntro
lines.text: おれだって　たまには\nおよぎに　くるぜ！$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallDefeat
lines.text: ぐわわ！$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallPostBattle
lines.text: うきやすそう　だと？\nうるせー　おおきな　おせわだッ！$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JackIntro
lines.text: I caught my POKéMON at sea.$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JackDefeat
lines.text: Diver!!\nDown!!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JackPostBattle
lines.text: Where'd you catch your POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro
lines.text: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeDefeat
lines.text: Pant…\nPant… Pant…$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle
lines.text: I'm beat! But, I still have the\nbike race and marathon left!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro
lines.text: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandDefeat
lines.text: Yow!\nI lost!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandPostBattle
lines.text: I'm sunburnt to a crisp!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro
lines.text: Hey, don't scare away the fish!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat
lines.text: Sorry! I'm just so frustrated from\nnot catching anything.$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle
lines.text: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing.\nCould this place actually be a\lgiant pool or something?$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro
lines.text: Keep me company till I get a hit.$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanDefeat
lines.text: That burned some time.$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle
lines.text: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_LilIntro
lines.text: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_LilDefeat
lines.text: LIL: Oh, see?\nWe lost. Happy now?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_LilPostBattle
lines.text: LIL: I'm tired.\nCan't we go home already?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_LilNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nI can't be bothered to do it alone.\lBring two POKéMON, won't you?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_IanIntro
lines.text: IAN: My sis doesn't get enough\nexercise, so I made her come.$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_IanDefeat
lines.text: IAN: Awww, Sis!\nGet it together!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_IanPostBattle
lines.text: IAN: Come on, Sis!\pYou're not going to lose weight\nlike this!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
lines.text: IAN: We want a two-on-two battle.\nSo can you bring two POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalIntro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!\pYou're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!\pYou probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?\pThe guard won't let you through
without them.\pBy the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?$

lines.label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalDefeat
lines.text: Awww!\nYou just lucked out!$

lines.label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalPostBattle
lines.text:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.\pI have to figure out how to get
past them.\pYou should quit dawdling and get a
move on!$

lines.label: Route22_Text_RivalShouldCatchSomeMons
lines.text: {RIVAL}“なんだ？\nポケモン　2ひきも\lもってるの　なぜか　だって？\pおまえも\nつかまえれば　いい　じゃん！$

lines.label: Route22_Text_LateRivalIntro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}!
What a surprise to see you here!\pSo you're going to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pYou collected all the BADGES, too?
That's cool!\pThen I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a
warm-up for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pCome on!$

lines.label: Route22_Text_LateRivalDefeat
lines.text: What!?\pI was just careless, you!$

lines.label: Route22_Text_LateRivalPostBattle
lines.text: That loosened me up.\nI'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\p{PLAYER}, you need more practice.\pBut hey, you know that!\nI'm out of here. Smell ya!$

lines.label: Route22_Text_LateRivalVictory
lines.text: {RIVAL}“ひゃははッ　{PLAYER}ー！\nそれで　がんばってるのかよ！\lおれの　さいのうに　くらべりゃ\l{PLAYER}は　まだまだ　だな！\pもっと　れんしゅう　こいよ！\nあははーッ！$

lines.label: Route22_Text_LeagueGateSign
lines.text: POKéMON LEAGUE\nFront Gate$

lines.label: Route23_Text_VictoryRoadGateSign
lines.text: VICTORY ROAD GATE -\nPOKéMON LEAGUE$

lines.label: Route24_Text_JustEarnedFabulousPrize
lines.text: Congratulations! You beat our\nfive contest TRAINERS!\pYou just earned a fabulous prize!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ReceivedNuggetFromMysteryTrainer
