lines.text: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET\nfrom the mystery TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_YouDontHaveAnyRoom
lines.text: You don't have any room!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_JoinTeamRocket
lines.text:
By the way, how would you like to
join TEAM ROCKET?\pWe're a group of professional
criminals specializing in POKéMON!\pWant to join?\pAre you sure?\pCome on, join us!\pI'm telling you to join!\p…Okay, you need convincing!\pI'll make you an offer you can't
refuse!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_RocketDefeat
lines.text: Arrgh!\nYou are good!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_YoudBecomeTopRocketLeader
lines.text: With your ability, you'd become\na top leader in TEAM ROCKET.\pCome on, think of the opportunity!\nDon't let this chance go to waste.$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ShaneIntro
lines.text: I saw your feat from the grass!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ShaneDefeat
lines.text: I thought not!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ShanePostBattle
lines.text: I hid because the people on the\nbridge frightened me.$

lines.label: Route24_Text_EthanIntro
lines.text: Okay! I'm No. 5!\nI'll stomp you!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_EthanDefeat
lines.text: Whoa!\nToo much!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_EthanPostBattle
lines.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ReliIntro
lines.text: I'm No. 4!\nGetting tired?$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ReliDefeat
lines.text: I lost, too!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ReliPostBattle
lines.text: I did my best, so I've no regrets!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_TimmyIntro
lines.text: Here's No. 3!\nI won't be easy!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_TimmyDefeat
lines.text: Ow!\nStomped flat!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_TimmyPostBattle
lines.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_AliIntro
lines.text: I'm second!\nNow it's serious!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_AliDefeat
lines.text: How could I lose?$

lines.label: Route24_Text_AliPostBattle
lines.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_CaleIntro
lines.text: People call this the NUGGET\nBRIDGE!\pBeat us five TRAINERS and win\na fabulous prize!\pThink you got what it takes?$

lines.label: Route24_Text_CaleDefeat
lines.text: Whoo!\nGood stuff!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_CalePostBattle
lines.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_JoeyIntro
lines.text: Local TRAINERS come here to\npractice.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_JoeyDefeat
lines.text: You're decent.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle
lines.text: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_DanIntro
lines.text: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_DanDefeat
lines.text: I'm not mad!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_DanPostBattle
lines.text: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FlintIntro
lines.text: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FlintDefeat
lines.text: Aww, darn…$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_KelseyIntro
lines.text: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_KelseyDefeat
lines.text: My conditioning isn't the best…$

lines.label: Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle
lines.text: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_ChadIntro
lines.text: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_ChadDefeat
lines.text: I knew I'd lose, too!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle
lines.text: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_HaleyIntro
lines.text: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_HaleyDefeat
lines.text: I'm not so jealous!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle
lines.text: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FranklinIntro
lines.text: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FranklinDefeat
lines.text: You worked hard!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle
lines.text: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_NobIntro
lines.text: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_NobDefeat
lines.text: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_NobPostBattle
lines.text: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_WayneIntro
lines.text: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_WayneDefeat
lines.text: You're something.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle
lines.text: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_SeaCottageSign
lines.text: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL lives here!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlace
lines.text: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone
lines.text: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutPal
lines.text:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutLady
lines.text:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparationOnPC
lines.text: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief
lines.text:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseBeautiful
lines.text:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThis
lines.text:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeThis
lines.text:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ReceivedSSTicketFromBill
lines.text: {PLAYER} received an S.S. TICKET\nfrom BILL.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_YouveGotTooMuchStuff
lines.text: You've got too much stuff!$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGoInstead
lines.text:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMonsOnPC
lines.text: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisplayed
lines.text: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_InitiatedTeleportersCellSeparator
lines.text: {PLAYER} initiated the TELEPORTER's\nCell Separator.$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_BillsFavoriteMonList
lines.text: BILL's favorite POKéMON list!$

lines.label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON do you want to see?$

lines.label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen10Mons
lines.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo
lines.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

lines.label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ReceivedHM05FromAide
lines.text: {PLAYER} received HM05\nfrom the AIDE.$

lines.label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05
lines.text: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.$

lines.label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRockTunnel
lines.text: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.$

lines.label: Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseFieldMoves
lines.text: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.$

lines.label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_ManyMonsOnlyInForests
lines.text: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.$

lines.label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCutSkinnyTrees
lines.text: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.$

lines.label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCancelEvolution
lines.text:
Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.$

lines.label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_ForestIsMaze
lines.text: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.$

lines.label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_RattataHasWickedBite
lines.text: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?$

lines.label: Route3_Text_TunnelFromCeruleanTiring
lines.text: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_ColtonIntro
lines.text: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_ColtonDefeat
lines.text: You beat me again!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle
lines.text: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_BenIntro
lines.text: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_BenDefeat
lines.text: I don't believe it!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_BenPostBattle
lines.text: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JaniceIntro
lines.text: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JaniceDefeat
lines.text: You're mean!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle
lines.text: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_GregIntro
lines.text: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_GregDefeat
lines.text: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_GregPostBattle
lines.text: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_SallyIntro
lines.text: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_SallyDefeat
lines.text: Be nice!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle
lines.text: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_CalvinIntro
lines.text: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?$

lines.label: Route3_Text_CalvinDefeat
lines.text: Lost!\nLost! Lost!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle
lines.text: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JamesIntro
lines.text: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JamesDefeat
lines.text: Done like dinner!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle
lines.text: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_RobinIntro
lines.text: Eek!\nDid you touch me?$

lines.label: Route3_Text_RobinDefeat
lines.text: That's it?$

lines.label: Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle
lines.text: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 3\nMT. MOON AHEAD$

lines.label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
lines.text: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!$

lines.label: Route4_Text_CrissyIntro
lines.text: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat
lines.text: After all I did to catch them!$

lines.label: Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle
lines.text: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.$

lines.label: Route4_Text_MtMoonEntrance
lines.text: MT. MOON\nTunnel Entrance$

lines.label: Route4_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 4\nMT. MOON - CERULEAN CITY$

lines.label: Text_MegaPunchTeach
lines.text: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!$

lines.label: Text_MegaPunchDeclined
lines.text: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.$

lines.label: Text_MegaPunchWhichMon
lines.text: Fine!\nWhich POKéMON will learn it?$

lines.label: Text_MegaPunchTaught
lines.text: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.$

lines.label: Text_MegaKickTeach
lines.text: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!$

lines.label: Text_MegaKickDeclined
lines.text: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.$

lines.label: Text_MegaKickWhichMon
lines.text: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?$

lines.label: Text_MegaKickTaught
lines.text: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.$

lines.label: Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock
lines.text:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixMonsWithYou
lines.text: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketAttacksCerulean
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMagikarpForJust500
lines.text: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyMagikarpForJust500
lines.text: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrageouslyForMagikarp
lines.text: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingThisAsFavorToYou
lines.text: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMorePokemon
lines.text: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMoreMoney
lines.text: You'll need more money than that!$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRefunds
lines.text: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStoreMonsUsingPC
lines.text: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.$

lines.label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ItsANewspaper
lines.text: It's a newspaper.$

lines.label: Route5_Text_UndergroundPathSign
lines.text: UNDERGROUND PATH\nCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaiseMon
lines.text: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAgain
lines.text: Come again.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldIRaise
lines.text: Which POKéMON should I raise?$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAnytimeYouLike
lines.text: Fine.\nCome anytime you like.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonForAWhile
lines.text: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAWhile
lines.text: Come see me in a while.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpendMoreTime
lines.text: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMonsReturn
lines.text: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ThankYouHeresMon
lines.text: Thank you!\nHere's your POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_PlayerGotMonBack
lines.text: {PLAYER} got {STR_VAR_1} back\nfrom the DAY-CARE MAN.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMonWithYou
lines.text: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
lines.text: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownByXLevels
lines.text: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoomForIt
lines.text: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
lines.text: You don't have enough money.$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToTakeALookAtYours
lines.text: きみの\nみてみるかね？$

lines.label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_CantAcceptMonWithHM
lines.text: わるいけど　ひでんのわざを　もった\nポケモンは　あずかれないなぁ$

lines.label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
lines.text: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$

lines.label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
lines.text: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$

lines.label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
lines.text: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$

lines.label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_HiHowsItGoing
lines.text: Hi, how's it going?$

lines.label: Route6_Text_RickyIntro
lines.text: Who's there?\nQuit listening in on us!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_RickyDefeat
lines.text: I just can't win!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_RickyPostBattle
lines.text: Whisper…\nWhisper…$

lines.label: Route6_Text_NancyIntro
lines.text: Excuse me!\nThis is a private conversation!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_NancyDefeat
lines.text: Ugh!\nI hate losing.$

lines.label: Route6_Text_NancyPostBattle
lines.text: Whisper…\nWhisper…$

lines.label: Route6_Text_KeigoIntro
lines.text: There aren't many bugs out here.$

lines.label: Route6_Text_KeigoDefeat
lines.text: No!\nYou're kidding!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_KeigoPostBattle
lines.text: I like bugs, so I'm going back to\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.$

lines.label: Route6_Text_JeffIntro
lines.text: Huh?\nYou want to talk to me?$

lines.label: Route6_Text_JeffDefeat
lines.text: This stinks…\nI couldn't beat your challenge…$

lines.label: Route6_Text_JeffPostBattle
lines.text: I should bring more POKéMON with\nme. I'll feel safer that way.$

lines.label: Route6_Text_IsabelleIntro
lines.text: Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_IsabelleDefeat
lines.text: Things just didn't work…$

lines.label: Route6_Text_IsabellePostBattle
lines.text: I want to get stronger.\nWhat's your secret?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_PaigePostBattle
lines.text: When POKéMON grow up, they get\nugly! They shouldn't evolve.$

lines.label: Route8_Text_LeslieDefeat

lines.label: Route8_Text_LesliePostBattle
lines.text: I was planning on getting some\nfresh air for a change, but…\pWe're stuck here because of the\ngates at SAFFRON.$

lines.text: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow,\nmeow!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_AndreaDefeat
lines.text: Meeeeyow!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_AndreaPostBattle

lines.label: Route8_Text_MeganIntro
lines.text: We must look silly standing here\nlike this.$

lines.label: Route8_Text_MeganDefeat

lines.label: Route8_Text_MeganPostBattle

lines.label: Route8_Text_RichPostBattle

lines.text: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_JuliaDefeat
lines.text: Stop!\pDon't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_JuliaPostBattle
lines.text: I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when\nit's exposed to a MOON STONE.\pI read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL.\nI wonder if it's true?$

lines.text: Clear the way, or I'll run you\ndown!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_JarenDefeat
lines.text: You for real, kid?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle
lines.text: Don't think you're all special and\nall just because of this.$

lines.label: Route9_Text_DrewDefeat
lines.text: Can't measure up…$

lines.label: Route9_Text_DrewPostBattle

lines.text: Don't you dare patronize me!$

lines.text: No!\nYou're too much.$

lines.label: Route9_Text_JeremyIntro
lines.text: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored, eh!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_JeremyDefeat

lines.label: Route9_Text_JeremyPostBattle

lines.text: Hahaha!\nAren't you a little toughie!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_BriceDefeat
lines.text: What's that?$

lines.label: Route9_Text_BricePostBattle
lines.text: Hahaha!\nKids should be tough!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_BrentPostBattle
lines.text: I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…$

lines.label: Route9_Text_AlanIntro
lines.text: Hahahaha!\nBring it on!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_AlanDefeat
lines.text: Hahahaha!\nYou beat me fair!$

lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.$

lines.text: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.$

lines.text: Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!$

lines.label: SafariZone_East_Text_MyEeveeEvolvedIntoFlareon
lines.text: My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?$

lines.label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_CongratsYouveWon
lines.text:
Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!$

lines.label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ReceivedHM03FromAttendant
lines.text: {PLAYER} received HM03\nfrom the attendant!$

lines.label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ExplainSurf
lines.text:
HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!$

you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.$

lines.text: SAFFRON belongs to TEAM ROCKET!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_WatchWhereYoureWalking

lines.text: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket
lines.text: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain
lines.text: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffron
lines.text: People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot
lines.text: I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_Pidgeot
lines.text: PIDGEOT: Bi bibii!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping
lines.text: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard
lines.text: I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!$

lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.$

He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_YouWantHitmonlee
lines.text: You want the hard-kicking\nHITMONLEE?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKarateMaster
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the KARATE MASTER.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_YouWantHitmonchan
lines.text: You want the piston-punching\nHITMONCHAN?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKarateMaster2
lines.text: {PLAYER}は　カラテ　だいおう　から\n{STR_VAR_1}を　もらった！$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_BetterNotGetGreedy
lines.text: Better not get greedy…$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_EnemiesOnEverySide
lines.text: Enemies on every side!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_GoesAroundComesAround
lines.text: What goes around comes around.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_FightingDojo
lines.text: FIGHTING DOJO$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
lines.text:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat
lines.text:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
lines.text: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM04FromSabrina
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM04 from\nSABRINA.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04
lines.text: TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems
lines.text: Your BAG is full of other items.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro
lines.text: SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaDefeat
lines.text: Not good enough!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle
lines.text: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro
lines.text: Does our unseen power scare you?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanDefeat
lines.text: I never foresaw this!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle
lines.text: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro
lines.text: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyDefeat
lines.text: I knew it!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle
lines.text: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro
lines.text: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronDefeat
lines.text: I don't believe this!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle
lines.text: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro
lines.text: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaDefeat
lines.text: I lost after all!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle
lines.text: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro
lines.text: SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronDefeat
lines.text: Ow!\nDown and out!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle
lines.text:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
lines.text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
lines.text: Arrrgh!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
lines.text: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
lines.text: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: SaffronCity_House_Text_DontLookAtMyLetter
lines.text: …Thank you for writing.\nI hope to see you soon!\p…Hey!\nDon't look at my letter!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_House_Text_Pidgey
lines.text: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_House_Text_GettingCopycatPokeDoll
lines.text: The COPYCAT is cute!\nI'm getting her a POKé DOLL.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_House_Text_ExplainPPUp
lines.text: I was given a PP UP as a gift.\pIt's used to increase the PP of\na POKéMON's move.\pI should use it on a powerful move\nwith only a few PP.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffectiveThanSuper
lines.text: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly
lines.text: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouWantedThis
lines.text: …Wait! Don't say a word!\pYou wanted this!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ReceivedTM29FromMrPsychic
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM29\nfrom MR. PSYCHIC.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ExplainTM29
lines.text: You already know, don't you?\nTM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt's an attack that may also lower\nthe target's special stats.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouveNoRoom
lines.text: Where do you plan to put this?\nYou've no room.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GrowthRatesDifferBySpecies
lines.text: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphCoVictimOfFame
lines.text: SILPH CO. is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ROCKET.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatIfEliteFourCameBeatRockets
lines.text: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ROCKET?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketTookOff
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HuhYou
lines.text: Huh?\nYou…$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePlayerWereYourFansNow
lines.text:
Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
lines.text: I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_IllAlwaysBelieveInYou
lines.text: I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WasYourFanNotAnymore
lines.text:
I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryonesYourFanButICantBe
lines.text:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersCoolWhenBattling
lines.text: I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanYouAutographShorts
lines.text:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CountingOnYou
lines.text:
However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksMyHero
lines.text:
BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksFanToBitterEnd
lines.text: …  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksLastWordOnCool
lines.text: BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HadPleasureOfWatchingYouBattle
lines.text:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverSeenTrainerOfYourMagnificence
lines.text:
I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HmmAndYouAre
lines.text: Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveStillAWaysToGo
lines.text:
Ah, so you are the much-
talked-about {PLAYER}.\pYou certainly do have the look of
a winner.\pBut for me to accept you as
a true POKéMON great…\p… …\pYou've still a ways to go!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoullBeTalkedAboutIfYouKeepWinning
lines.text:
All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeYouOneDay
lines.text: It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneButMeStoppedBeingYourFan
lines.text:
Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s
fan…\pBut that means I can have {PLAYER}
all to myself!\pYay! Go for it!
My one and only {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeSabrina
lines.text: Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingSabrinasFan
lines.text:
Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanIBecomeCoolTrainerOneDay
lines.text: I wonder if I can become a cool\nTRAINER one day?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TheWayYouBattleIsCool
lines.text:
Oh, man, oh, man!
Cool! Too cool!\p…Huh?
No, not you.\pJust the way you battle.
That's cool.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImOnlyOneLeftOfYourFans
lines.text: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLooks like I'm the only one left\nout of your fans.\pBut, you know, I like being an only\nfan… It's less stressful.\pKeep up and at it!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LoveWayTrainerTalks
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh?\nI love the way he talks.\pI'd really relish a chance to meet\nhim in person once.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImLoneTrainerFan
lines.text:
Huh, can you believe it?
Everyone turned into your fans.\pSo after all we've been through,
I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?\pEh, being the one and only
{STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AdoreWayYouBattle
lines.text:
Oh, my goodness!
Is it really you, {PLAYER}?\pI have to tell you, I adore the
way you battle.\pI hope you'll keep at it.
I'll be your number one fan!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourNumberOneFan
lines.text:
Oh, my goodness!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pIt's so disappointing… I realized
I'm your number-one-and-only fan!\pWell, it can't be helped!
Let me cheer you on, at least!\pHurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerHasBeenOnFire
lines.text: Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on\nfire.\pThe way he battles… It's just \nthe way that I like it!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneTalksAboutYou
lines.text:
Oh, hello!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pLately, all everyone talks about
is you.\pI'm feeling lonesome because I
prefer {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouReallyAreAmazing
lines.text: Amazing!\n{PLAYER}, you really are amazing!\pInstead of just watching, maybe\nI should become a TRAINER, too.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourOnlyFan
lines.text: I'm your only fan…\nSigh… This is lonely…\pCan't you try harder and make the\nothers take notice of you?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WhyCantOthersSeeMastersDignity
lines.text: Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified…\nHe is so my type.\pWhy can't the others see the\ndignity he simply oozes?$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BelieveInMasterWithAllMyHeart
lines.text:
I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1}
with all my heart.\pEven if I am the only one to
believe in him.\pI won't ever feel lonesome, though.\pNot if I keep thinking about Master
{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourBattleStyleIsEducational
lines.text: Hiyah!\pYour battling style is most\neducational.\pI hope that you will keep plugging\naway at success, hiyah!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingYourFan
lines.text:
Instead of just watching others
battle, battle yourself!\p…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out
like that…\pBut I won't let that stop me from
being your fan!\pI can't stop being your fan!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyMasterHasMyRespect
lines.text:
Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER
who has my respect.\pAnd that is none other than my
MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.\pYou should become a fan of my
MASTER like me! Hiyah!$

lines.label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverBeFanOfAnyoneButMaster
lines.text:
Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the
FIGHTING DOJO.\pI will never become a fan of
anyone other than my MASTER!\pI will even sneak out of the DOJO
to spread word of his greatness.\pHiyah!$

lines.label: Text_RockSlideTeach
lines.text:
When you're up on a rocky mountain
like this, rockslides are a threat.\pCan you imagine?
Boulders tumbling down on you?\pThat'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah!
Total terror!\pYou don't seem to be scared.
Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?$

lines.label: Text_RockSlideDeclined
lines.text: Oh, so you are scared after all.$

lines.label: Text_RockSlideWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nROCK SLIDE?$

lines.label: Text_RockSlideTaught
lines.text: It might be scary to use it in this\ntunnel…$

lines.label: SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_BouldersMightChangeWaterFlow
lines.text: Hint: Boulders might change the\nflow of water.$

lines.label: SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_DangerFastCurrent
lines.text: DANGER\nFast current!$

lines.label: Text_SwordsDanceTeach
lines.text: Not many people come out here.\pIf I train here, I'm convinced that\nI'll get stronger and stronger.\pYep, stronger and stronger…\pHow would you like to learn a move\nlike that? It's SWORDS DANCE.$

lines.label: Text_SwordsDanceDeclined
lines.text: Well, that's fine, too.$

lines.label: Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon
lines.text: All right, pick which POKéMON\nI should teach it to.$

lines.label: Text_SwordsDanceTaught
lines.text: If only we could keep getting\nstronger and stronger, eh?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: SEVEN ISLAND\nQuest Island of Infinity$

lines.label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays
lines.text:
These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.\p…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.\pThe truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to\lhave been made in seven days.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouched
lines.text: This island has been left virtually\nuntouched in its natural state.\pIt could be a little difficult to\nhike around because of that.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoymentWatchingBattles
lines.text:
I may not look like much now,
but when I was younger…\pI flew everywhere, challenging
TRAINERS wherever I found them.\pNow, my only source of enjoyment
is reminiscing about the past while\lwatching battles.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreezeAroundBox
lines.text: There is a slight breeze blowing\naround the box.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
lines.text:
Ah!
Welcome, my friend!\pLet me tell you something. There's
a hidden room in the basement.\pA TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
waiting there now.\pTell me, you did come to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}, am I right?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBattle
lines.text:
Oh…
You won't battle…\pI see, I see.
… …\pWell, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeMonsPerSide
lines.text:
Ah!
You will battle for me?\pIt was worth my time moving the
box aside, then.\p… …
But there is one slight problem.\pThis hidden room is not built very
sturdy.\pCan I get you to limit it to
battles of three POKéMON per side?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
lines.text: Fine! Before your battle, would\nyou like to save your game?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DontHoldAnythingBack
lines.text: All right.\nDon't hold anything back!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_1
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room2_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
lines.text: The match ended up a draw.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DrawWasIt
lines.text: A draw, was it?\pHowever, let me say that it was\na worthy spectacle.\pI'd say it was a wonderful battle\nwith a real sense of depth!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_2
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_AstoundingBattle
lines.text:
Bravo!\pBravo, indeed!
What an astounding battle!\pIt was so astounding, why, it keeps
filling my eyes with tears!\pThe thrust and parry of expertly
used techniques!\pThe clash of power upon power!\pYes!
It was sheer magnificence!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_3
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}$

lines.label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_FeelYourDisappointment
lines.text:
Too bad!
I feel your disappointment.\pHowever, that disappointment is
what will make you better.\pUse it, learn from it, and make it
motivate you to seek greatness.\pForget not this disappointment
and redouble your training!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonalitiesOfTheirOwn
lines.text: POKéMON have personalities of their\nown, just like people.\pMy PIKACHU has a HASTY nature,\nso it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsCompleteForRuins
lines.text: Okay, preparations are complete\nfor me to explore the RUINS.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenIsland
lines.text: I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.\pThat will complete my fishing tour\nof the SEVII ISLANDS.\pI'd better stock up on some\nPOKé BALLS first, though.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EventsDependingOnConnections
lines.text: On this island, different events\noccur depending on connections.\pWhat are those connections?\pThey are for you to discover on\nyour own.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYouRideSeagallopHere
lines.text:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry
to get here?\pThere are at least ten of those
high-speed ships.\pI don't know where they all go,
though.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckOutTrainerTower
lines.text: If you're confident, you should\ncheck out TRAINER TOWER.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyIntro
lines.text: My conditioning's in top form!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyDefeat
lines.text: Huh?\nSomething's not right…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPostBattle
lines.text: The way I am now, I may have to\nhold off on TRAINER TOWER…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro
lines.text: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanDefeat
lines.text: You're a master at this.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostBattle
lines.text: You see them every so often,\nTRAINERS with awesome POKéMON\lwho have no idea what to do.\pBefore training POKéMON, TRAINERS\nthemselves need to grow up.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIntro
lines.text: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDefeat
lines.text: Whoa! You're tough!\nHow about protecting me?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPostBattle
lines.text: From far out among the stars, our\nplanet is just a drop of water.\pBut we want to protect that drop\nof water for everyone.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIntro
lines.text: Those shoes you have are pretty\nsnazzy.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDefeat
lines.text: You're hot stuff in spite of your\ncute looks.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPostBattle
lines.text: Your mom bought those snazzy\nRUNNING SHOES for you?\pShe must adore you.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntro
lines.text: You look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefeat
lines.text: I knew it!\nYou're as tough as I thought!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPostBattle
lines.text: The way you battle has given me\na lot of useful data.\pThanks so much!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleIntro
lines.text: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI don't want to lose to anyone!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleDefeat
lines.text: Thank you. I feel like I've been\nset free by losing to you.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichellePostBattle
lines.text: For some reason, I get furious\nover the slightest thing.\pI'll calm myself by breathing\ndeeply.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro
lines.text: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe could win!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat
lines.text: LEX: I seem to have been too\ncareless…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBattle
lines.text: LEX: I think it was a good\nexperience for NYA.\pYou have my gratitude.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LEX: May I ask you to battle the\nboth of us at the same time?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro
lines.text: NYA: I'll do my best so I won't\ndrag down my mentor, LEX!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat
lines.text: NYA: Oh, no…\nI'm so sorry, I…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBattle
lines.text: NYA: I think I'm going to need\nmuch more seasoning and tutoring\lunder LEX…\p…So, LEX, please, may I stay with\nyou like this?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle\nin two-on-two style?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: SEVAULT CANYON\nTANOBY RUINS AHEAD$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrainedWithBrawly
lines.text:
Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.\pBut it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.\pEven BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahIntro
lines.text: Kyahaha!\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahDefeat
lines.text: Tch!\nToo strong for me!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahPostBattle
lines.text: What's that?\nI don't act the way I look?\pHeh, that's a part of my strategy!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonIntro
lines.text: Howdy!\nAre you a member of my fan club?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonDefeat
lines.text: Oh, so you're not a fan…\pWell, I can change that.\nLet me sing for you!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonPostBattle
lines.text: Lalalah…\nMy POKéMON, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasIntro
lines.text: This island is too spread out…\nIt's not easy patrolling the place.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasDefeat
lines.text: Uh-huh…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasPostBattle
lines.text: TRAINERS like you from cities,\nthey sure are tough.\pYou'll be headed for the TOWER,\nwon't you?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineIntro
lines.text: I punish people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineDefeat
lines.text: You don't seem to be a problem\nTRAINER.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelinePostBattle
lines.text: If you treat your POKéMON with\nkindness, they'll understand.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveIntro
lines.text: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveDefeat
lines.text: EVE: Me and JON, we lost.\nEhehe.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EvePostBattle
lines.text: EVE: I'm going to work harder with\nJON.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveNotEnoughMons
lines.text: EVE: I want to team up with JON\nwhen I battle you.\pCome back with two POKéMON, okay?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonIntro
lines.text: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonDefeat
lines.text: JON: When I'm with EVE,\nit doesn't feel like I've lost!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonPostBattle
lines.text: JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel\ngiddy whether I win or lose.\pIt's magical!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be\nhappy to battle with you.\pSo, I'd like to make it a\ntwo-on-two battle, if I may.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE\pTRAINERS are asked to refrain from\ndamaging plants in the CANYON.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ChanseyDanceJoinIn
lines.text: Dance, dance!\nCHANSEY Dance!\pYou join in, too!\nDance, dance!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_WouldYouLikeToDance
lines.text: Would you like to dance?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ComeOnDance
lines.text: Come on, dance!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_DancedChanseyDance
lines.text: {PLAYER} danced the CHANSEY Dance!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_YoureAllChipperNow
lines.text: Ahahahaha!\pThere, you're all chipper now!\nLucky!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_Chansey
lines.text: CHANSEY: Chansi! Chansi!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_TanobyKey_Text_MysteriousRumbleFarAway
lines.text: A mysterious rumble echoed\nsomewhere far away.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntro
lines.text: Do you know anything about this\nstone chamber?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefeat
lines.text: That was uncalled for.\nYou didn't have to be so rough.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPostBattle
lines.text: The TANOBY RUINS date back at\nleast 1,500 years.\pBut it's a baffling mystery as to\nwhy it was built in the first place.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminIntro
lines.text: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDefeat
lines.text: I'm not much good in battle.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
lines.text: I hear there are other ruins like\nthe one here.\pMight they be the resting places\nof other mystic POKéMON?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro
lines.text: CLIFFORD is teaching me how to\npaint.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat
lines.text: We might get in trouble for being\nnoisy here.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBattle
lines.text: I said that I wanted to paint an\nold building.\pSo CLIFFORD brought me here.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordIntro
lines.text: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordDefeat
lines.text: My, how extraordinary.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPostBattle
lines.text: Ah, so you are studying POKéMON\non your own…\pYes, you certainly are quite the\nextraordinary person, indeed.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioIntro
lines.text: I sensed your approach.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioDefeat
lines.text: Give up…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostBattle
lines.text: In your future, I sense that you\nwill meet many others.\pI think you will be linked to each\nother by a strange power.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteIntro
lines.text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteDefeat
lines.text: What an amazing TRAINER!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePostBattle
lines.text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerSign
lines.text: TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE\nRise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerAhead
lines.text: TRAINER TOWER AHEAD$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_LooksLikeTrainerTowerIsClosed
lines.text: トレーナータワーには\nいまは　はいれない　みたい‥$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerIsOpenLetsGoIn
lines.text: トレーナータワーが　あいてる！\nさっそく　はいってみよう！$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: I'm stunned!$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle
lines.text: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisIntro
lines.text: Enough of your silly games!$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisDefeat
lines.text: No continues left!$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle
lines.text: Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_WaaaImScared
lines.text: Waaaaa!\nI'm scared!$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret
lines.text: About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.$

lines.label: SilphCo_10F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n10F$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBoy
lines.text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearGirl
lines.text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ObtainedMasterBallFromPresident
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype
lines.text:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt will catch any POKéMON without
fail!\pYou should be quiet about using it,
though.$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
lines.text: You have no room for this.$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForRescuingUs
lines.text: SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\pWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro
lines.text:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
So we meet again!\pThe PRESIDENT and I are discussing
a vital business proposition.\pKeep your nose out of grown-up
matters…\pOr, experience a world of pain!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
lines.text: Arrgh!!\nI lost again!?$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
lines.text: Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\pBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\p{PLAYER}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\pI must go, but I shall return!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Stop right there!\nDon't you move!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Don't…\nPlease!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: So, you want to see my BOSS?$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Gaah!\nDemolished!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_MonitorHasMonsOnIt
lines.text: The monitor has POKéMON on it!$

lines.label: SilphCo_11F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n11F$

lines.label: SilphCo_1F_Text_WelcomePresidentInBoardroom
lines.text: Welcome.\pThe PRESIDENT is in the boardroom\non 11F.$

lines.label: SilphCo_1F_Text_DestroyedWontBeFixedForWhile
lines.text: めちゃめちゃに　こわされてる\nとうぶん　なおりそうに　ない‥$

lines.label: SilphCo_1F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n1F$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorIntro
lines.text: Help!\nI'm a SILPH employee.$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorDefeat
lines.text: How did you know\nI was a ROCKET?$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorPostBattle
lines.text: I work for both SILPH and TEAM\nROCKET.$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryIntro
lines.text: It's off-limits here!\nGo home!$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryDefeat
lines.text: You're good.$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryPostBattle
lines.text: Can you solve the maze in here?\nIt's not easy, I tell you!$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: No kids are allowed in here!$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Tough!$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\pThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: I goofed!$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

lines.label: Text_ThunderWaveTeach
lines.text:
Eeek!
No! Stop! Help!\pOh, you're not with TEAM ROCKET.
I'm sorry, I thought…\pWill you forgive me if I teach
you the THUNDER WAVE technique?$

lines.label: Text_ThunderWaveDeclined
lines.text: Oh…\nBut THUNDER WAVE is convenient…$

lines.label: Text_ThunderWaveWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nTHUNDER WAVE?$

lines.label: Text_ThunderWaveTaught
lines.text:
THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in
the target POKéMON.\pA paralyzed POKéMON may be unable
to move in battle.\pIt's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it
won't work on some POKéMON.$

lines.label: SilphCo_2F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n2F$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_WhatAmIToDo
lines.text: I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_YouAndYourMonsSavedUs
lines.text: {PLAYER}!\nYou and your POKéMON saved us!$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text: Quit messing with us, kid!$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: I give up!$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle
lines.text: A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseIntro
lines.text: I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseDefeat
lines.text: You really got me!$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JosePostBattle
lines.text: Humph…\pTEAM ROCKET said that if I helped\nthem, they'd let me study POKéMON.$

lines.label: SilphCo_3F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n3F$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_CantYouSeeImHiding
lines.text: Sssh!\nCan't you see I'm hiding?$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_TeamRocketIsGone
lines.text: Huh?\nTEAM ROCKET is gone?$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Arrgh!$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyDefeat
lines.text: Darn!\nYou weak POKéMON!$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle
lines.text: The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Intruder spotted!$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Who are you?$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!$

lines.label: SilphCo_4F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n4F$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntruder
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\pThat's you, right?$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: I heard a kid was wandering\naround.$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Boom!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro
lines.text: We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauDefeat
lines.text: Dang!\nBlast it!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle
lines.text: We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonIntro
lines.text: Whaaat?\pThere shouldn't be any children\nhere!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonDefeat
lines.text: Oh, goodness!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle
lines.text: You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Cough…\nCough…$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon
lines.text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirmed
lines.text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded
lines.text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n5F$

lines.label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStrongMons
lines.text:
Those thugs that took over our
building…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for
strong POKéMON.\pI hope our PRESIDENT managed to
avoid trouble…$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTookOverBuilding
lines.text: The ROCKETS came and took over\nthe building!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_BetterGetBackToWork
lines.text: Well, better get back to work.$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_HelpMePlease
lines.text: Oh dear, oh dear.\nHelp me, please!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_WeGotEngaged
lines.text: We got engaged.\nHeheh!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ThatManIsSuchACoward
lines.text: That man next to me…\nHe's such a coward!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_NeedsMeToLookAfterHim
lines.text: He's so helpless, he needed\nsomeone like me to look after him.$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTryingToConquerWorld
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer\nthe world with POKéMON.$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsRanAwayBecauseOfYou
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET ran away, and it's all\nbecause of you!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TargetedSilphForOurMonProducts
lines.text: They must have targeted SILPH for\nour POKéMON products.$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ComeWorkForSilphWhenYoureOlder
lines.text: Come work for SILPH when you\nget older.$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Flame out!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: No matter!\nMy brothers will avenge me!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorIntro
lines.text: That rotten PRESIDENT!\pServes him right for shipping me\noff to the TIKSI BRANCH!\pThat's why TEAM ROCKET came after\nus, I'm sure of it!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorDefeat
lines.text: Shoot!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorPostBattle
lines.text: TIKSI BRANCH?\nIt's in Russian no-man's-land!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: You dare betray TEAM ROCKET?$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: You traitor!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: If you stand for justice, you\nbetray us bad guys!$

lines.label: SilphCo_6F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n6F$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_HaveMonForSavingUs
lines.text: Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\lWhy, thank you!\pI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ObtainedLaprasFromEmployee
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ExplainLapras
lines.text:
It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON.\pWe kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\pI think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS!\pIt's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketBossWentToBoardroom
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\pIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_OhNo
lines.text: あ‥　もう　もてないぞ$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_SavedAtLast
lines.text: たすかったよ　ありがと！$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketsAfterMasterBall
lines.text: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_CanceledMasterBallProject
lines.text: We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_BadIfTeamRocketTookOver
lines.text: It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_WowYouChasedOffTeamRocket
lines.text: Wow!\pYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ReallyDangerousHere
lines.text: You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\pYou came to save me?\nYou can't!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ThankYouSoMuch
lines.text: Thank you so much!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: Uh-oh!\nI smell a little mouse!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: Lights out!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaIntro
lines.text: Heheh!\pYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaDefeat
lines.text: I'm done!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
lines.text: Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Aack!\nBrothers, I lost!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: A child intruder?\nThat must be you!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Fine!\nI lost!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalWhatKeptYou
lines.text: {RIVAL}: What kept you, {PLAYER}?$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here!\pI guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care!\pI saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat
lines.text: Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\lROCKET!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalVictory
lines.text: {RIVAL}“おまえなあ‥\pこんな　うでまえじゃ\nまだまだ‥\lいちにんまえ　とは　いえないぜ$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle
lines.text:
Well, {PLAYER}!
I'm moving on up and ahead!\pBy checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\lhow they evolve!\pAm I a genius or what?\pI'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR.\pI'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER!\p{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\lSmell ya!$

lines.label: SilphCo_7F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n7F$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished
lines.text: I wonder if SILPH is finished…$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ThanksForSavingUs
lines.text: Thanks for saving us!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: That's as far as you'll go!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Not enough grit!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: If you don't turn back…\nI'll call for backup!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerIntro
lines.text: You're causing us problems!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerDefeat
lines.text: Huh?\nI lost?$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle
lines.text: So, what do you think of SILPH\nBUILDING's maze?$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Whoo!\nOh, Brothers!$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: I'll leave you up to my brothers.$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n8F$

lines.label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools
lines.text:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly
cruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to
be used.\pWhat will happen if that tyrant
takes over our company…$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickNap
lines.text: You look tired.\nYou should take a quick nap.$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_DontGiveUp
lines.text: Don't give up!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_ThankYouSoMuch
lines.text: Thank you so much.$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: Your POKéMON seem to adore you,\nkid!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Ghaaah!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: If I had started as a TRAINER at\nyour age…$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdIntro
lines.text: Your POKéMON have weak points!\nI can nail them!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdDefeat
lines.text: You hammered me!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdPostBattle
lines.text: Exploiting weak spots does work.\nThink about type advantages.$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Warg!\nBrothers, I lost!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: My brothers will avenge me!$

lines.label: SilphCo_9F_Text_FloorSign
lines.text: SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n9F$

lines.label: SixIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: SIX ISLAND\nFortune Island of Aged Wisdom$

lines.label: SixIsland_Text_ThatWayToWaterPathRuinValley
lines.text: Keep going this way and you'll get\nto the WATER PATH.\pStay on that and you'll get to\nthe RUIN VALLEY.$

lines.label: SixIsland_Text_SkyAtNightIsFantastic
lines.text: When you're this far away from the\ncity, the sky at night is fantastic.$

lines.label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_FoundSapphire
lines.text: {PLAYER} found a SAPPHIRE!$

lines.label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_IWasRightInTailingYou
lines.text: Fufu… Fufufufu…\nI guessed right.\pI was right in tailing you!$

lines.label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_SellToTeamRocketTellPassword
lines.text:
I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE
here, so it belongs to me!\pI'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.\p…D-don't glare at me like that!\pIf you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?\pI'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's\lWAREHOUSE.\pThe WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\pI'm done.
Don't think badly of me!$

lines.label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynIntro
lines.text: …Huh?\pI was envisioning my house, but\nthis is where I TELEPORT?$

lines.label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynDefeat
lines.text: Big boo-boo!$

lines.label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynPostBattle
lines.text: I am so scatterbrained!\pI need to focus so I can TELEPORT\nproperly to my house!$

lines.label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_LeftRouteSign
lines.text: GREEN PATH\nPATTERN BUSH AHEAD$

lines.label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_RightRouteSign
lines.text: GREEN PATH\nThink Green, Keep Nature Clean!$

lines.label: SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureAndHistory
lines.text: There's nothing that young people'd\nfind exciting here on this island.\pBut, this is a good place in terms\nof nature and history.\pRelax and enjoy your stay.$

lines.label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverEliteFourMember
lines.text: Play with POKéMON lots and live\na long life!\pTake AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.\pShe spurs me to do bigger things.$

lines.label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWriteLetter
lines.text: I should buy some MAIL and write\nhim a letter…$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro
lines.text: There're no rare POKéMON around\nthese parts! Not a one!\pThat burns me up, man.\nI'll take it out on you!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketDefeat
lines.text: …Huh?$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostBattle
lines.text: So listen, you haven't seen any\nrare POKéMON, have you?$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro
lines.text: I'm having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorDefeat
lines.text: Nope, no luck at all…$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBattle
lines.text: I can't very well go home without\ncatching something, though.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro
lines.text: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLE PORT\nin one go.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoDefeat
lines.text: Gasp…\nGasp…$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBattle
lines.text: I'm only at the halfway point…\nI'm beat…$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro
lines.text: It's not so easy sending POKéMON\nout while swimming, you know?$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefeat
lines.text: I didn't lose to you at swimming.\nThis doesn't bother me.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostBattle
lines.text: Are you headed for the island up\npast here?\pI didn't see anything interesting\nthere.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro
lines.text: AVA: Let's have a two-on-two\nmarine battle!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat
lines.text: AVA: Oh, you're amazing!\nEven better, you're on your own!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBattle
lines.text: AVA: You know, I do prefer the\nsea over any pool.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: AVA: You're challenging us to\na battle?\pYou'll need at least two POKéMON\nif you want to do that.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro
lines.text: GEB: Big Sister, help!\nPlease battle with me!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat
lines.text: GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's\nreally good!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBattle
lines.text: GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister\nbecause I can't touch the bottom.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoughMons
lines.text: GEB: Please battle against me and\nmy sister!\p…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro
lines.text: I'm curious, how do you raise your\nPOKéMON?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat
lines.text: You raise your POKéMON with a\nwhole lot of love!$
