lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBattle
lines.text: In the same way your mother raised\nyou full of love, you should raise\lyour POKéMON.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro
lines.text: I'm working to preserve the natural\necology of POKéMON here.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat
lines.text: Oh, for someone so young, you are\ntremendous!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBattle
lines.text: I'm not saying that you shouldn't\ncatch POKéMON.\pI just want people to raise their\nPOKéMON responsibly.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro
lines.text: I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives\nonly around here!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretDefeat
lines.text: Heheh…\nIsn't my POKéMON awesome?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBattle
lines.text: There's a girl near the BUSH who\nmeasures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro
lines.text: You know, it just doesn't feel right\nif I don't use BUG POKéMON.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat
lines.text: It's okay, losing is a fun part of\nPOKéMON's appeal, too.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBattle
lines.text: By the way, “appeal” is a weird\nword, if you think about it.\pLike, is it like an orange peel?\nOr like a ringing bell?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah!\nLook at all the BUG POKéMON!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat
lines.text: I got beat while I was still busy\ncelebrating!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to bring my little brother\nhere next time.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro
lines.text: Look, look! There are funny\npatterns on the ground.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashDefeat
lines.text: Super awesome!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattle
lines.text: The funny patterns on the ground…\pThey look like the patterns on my\ngrandpa's clothes.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro
lines.text: I bet you think I'm just some guy,\ndon't you, eh?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat
lines.text: I bet you think I'm weak,\ndon't you, eh?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBattle
lines.text: Ayup, you townies come around all\nso dandy with a hat that flashy…\pHow about giving me that?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro
lines.text: Take a deep breath.\nIsn't the air delicious?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat
lines.text: If you'd like, I can teach you how\nto breathe properly.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBattle
lines.text: First, exhale.\nBlow everything out.\pWhen you can't exhale anymore,\ninhale the clean air!\pIsn't it refreshing?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro
lines.text: I love BUG POKéMON.\nThat's why I'm here all the time.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat
lines.text: I lost, but I'm still laughing.\nAm I the only girl like that?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to keep on collecting\nBUG POKéMON.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro
lines.text: This is a good spot.\nI'll pitch my tent here.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyDefeat
lines.text: Wimped out…$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to observe the night sky\nhere.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro
lines.text: Oh, yuck!\nI think a bug stung me!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat
lines.text: It wasn't a bug.\nI cut my shin on some grass.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBattle
lines.text: A little cut like that…\nA little spit's enough to cure it!$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro
lines.text: Have you noticed something odd\nabout these parts?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat
lines.text: Have you taken a good look around\nyour feet?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBattle
lines.text: There are places here in PATTERN\nBUSH where grass won't grow.\pWhat could be the cause of such\na phenomenon?$

lines.label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomethingHiddenOnThisIsland
lines.text: For ten years, I've searched for\nRUINS.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pI get this feeling that there's\nsomething hidden on this island.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveByTradingWithHeldItem
lines.text:
You know of POKéMON that evolve
only upon trading, yes?\pBut did you know that there are
still others?\pSome POKéMON evolve only when
traded while holding specific items.$

lines.label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RivalImpossibleToGetAllMonsAroundHere
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's your POKéDEX filling up?\pIt looks like it's impossible to get
all the POKéMON by hanging around\ljust these parts.\pMaybe there are POKéMON we don't
know about somewhere far away…\p… … …  … … …  … … …\pWell, if I can't do it, there's no
way for you to get it done.\pI'm not going to get all desperate
over this.\pI'll keep collecting POKéMON at my
own pace while I train them.\pThat's what I'll do.
So there's no point staying here.\lI may as well leave for home.\pThat's that, then!
Smell ya later!$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutHowToGetInside
lines.text: I can't figure out how I'm supposed\nto get inside.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlace
lines.text: Let me tell you, I found this\nplace.\pDon't look so envious, will you?$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreThoroughly
lines.text: The door doesn't budge at all.\nCheck it more thoroughly?$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LeftDoorAlone
lines.text: {PLAYER} left the door alone.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnTheDoor
lines.text: On closer inspection, there are\nseveral dots on the door…$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DoorIsOpen
lines.text: The door is open.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro
lines.text: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyDefeat
lines.text: Hmm…$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBattle
lines.text: I suggest to you that you, too,\ngive a thought to the secrets and\lmysteries of our world once a day.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro
lines.text: I'm curious, what compelled you to\ncome here?$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat
lines.text: It's been so long since I battled,\nmy instincts are off.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBattle
lines.text: There are several ruins on the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\pThe majority of them date back\na long way.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro
lines.text: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pI suspect it has something to do\nwith the ruins here.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryDefeat
lines.text: Oh, interesting.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattle
lines.text: Those ruins over there…\pI haven't had any luck in finding\nhow I can get inside.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro
lines.text: A battle with you, so high up!$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat
lines.text: Oh, the heartbreak of losing so\neasily to you!$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylPostBattle
lines.text: Experience the joy of climbing!$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro
lines.text: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat
lines.text: You don't need to be so pushy.\nI'll be happy to tell you.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBattle
lines.text: The door to the ruins…\nIt has these strange patterns\lengraved on the outside.\pI don't know what they mean,\nthough.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro
lines.text: I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat
lines.text: Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle
lines.text: I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro
lines.text: I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardDefeat
lines.text: Nobody saw me losing, right?$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattle
lines.text: As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro
lines.text: What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle
lines.text: I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro
lines.text: My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat
lines.text: Awww, I knew this would happen!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattle
lines.text: When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro
lines.text: Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat
lines.text: I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle
lines.text: Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro
lines.text: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuDefeat
lines.text: MIU: Oh, no!\nMommy!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle
lines.text: MIU: It makes me all sad inside\nwhen we lose…$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.\nWe want to battle together.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro
lines.text: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat
lines.text: MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaPostBattle
lines.text: MIA: Ohh…\nI'm sorry, my POKéMON…$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MIA: Oh, you only have one\nPOKéMON?\pDon't you feel lonesome?$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_WantedUltimateHorn
lines.text: Wanted!\nThe Ultimate Horn!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: WATER PATH\nLeads to RUIN VALLEY$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNeedItHeracross
lines.text: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeasureHeracross
lines.text: Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesDeserveReward
lines.text: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSeeBiggerOne
lines.text: I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesSameAsBefore
lines.text: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesYInchesWasBiggest
lines.text: Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWontDo
lines.text: Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagIsFull
lines.text: Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestHeracrossIsXInches
lines.text: The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
lines.text: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighborMeasuredMe
lines.text: My height is 67.0 inches on the\nbutton.\pI know it is this precisely because\nmy neighbor measured me.$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentType
lines.text:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!\pI will be happy to serve you
anything you please!\p… … …
Ah! Le strong silent type!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRestless
lines.text: The passengers are restless from\nthis long voyage.\pYou might be challenged by the\nmore bored ones!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgent
lines.text: Ssh…!\nI'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.\pI'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.\nThey're up to nothing good!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerIntro
lines.text: I love POKéMON!\nDo you?$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerDefeat
lines.text: Wow! \nYou're great!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle
lines.text: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro
lines.text: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle
lines.text: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld
lines.text: We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndCozy
lines.text: A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWigglytuff
lines.text: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_Wigglytuff
lines.text: WIGGLYTUFF: Puup pupuu!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlease
lines.text: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePlease
lines.text: Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro
lines.text: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat
lines.text: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle
lines.text: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest
lines.text: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefreshed
lines.text: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyBrother
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMySister
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro
lines.text: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasDefeat
lines.text: My, my friends…$

lines.label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle
lines.text: You should be nice to friends!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxuryLiner
lines.text: This ship, she is a luxury liner for\nTRAINERS of the world!\pAt every port, we hold parties with\ninvited TRAINERS.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour!
{PLAYER}!\pImagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?\pSo how's your POKéDEX coming?\pI already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.\pCrawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalDefeat
lines.text: Humph!\pAt least you're raising your\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory
lines.text: {PLAYER}‥！\nふなよい　してるのか！\pもっと　からだ\nきたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle
lines.text:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.\pBut he was just a seasick old man!\pCUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.\pYou should go see him, too.
Smell ya!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLikeThis
lines.text: I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\lany POKéMON sleep like this one!\pIt was something like this!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro
lines.text: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat
lines.text: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle
lines.text: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro
lines.text: Check out what I fished up!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleDefeat
lines.text: I'm all out!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle
lines.text: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople
lines.text: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDown
lines.text:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.\pOnce learned, it is not so easily
discarded.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro
lines.text: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarDefeat
lines.text: I must salute you!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle
lines.text: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro
lines.text: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnDefeat
lines.text: Take it easy!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafariZone
lines.text: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\pThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIsAwesome
lines.text: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\lI wish we could go there again.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySick
lines.text: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.$

lines.label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasick
lines.text: I hear many people get seasick.$

lines.label: SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCutToMons
lines.text: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\pThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro
lines.text: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipDefeat
lines.text: Argh!\nBeaten by a kid!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle
lines.text: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro
lines.text: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat
lines.text: Darn!\nI let that one get away!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle
lines.text: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro
lines.text: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyDefeat
lines.text: Okay, you're not bad.$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle
lines.text: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro
lines.text: I like feisty kids like you!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanDefeat
lines.text: Argh!\nLost it!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle
lines.text: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro
lines.text: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardDefeat
lines.text: Right!\nGood battle, mate!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle
lines.text: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro
lines.text: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanDefeat
lines.text: Your spirit sank me!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle
lines.text: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrengthToMoveRocks
lines.text: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!$

lines.label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_Machoke
lines.text: MACHOKE: Gwoh! Goggoh!$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_CaptainIFeelSeasick
lines.text: CAPTAIN: Ooargh…\nI feel hideous…\lUrrp! Seasick…$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_RubbedCaptainsBack
lines.text: {PLAYER} rubbed the CAPTAIN's\nback!\pRub-rub…\nRub-rub…$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveHMForCut
lines.text:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ObtainedHM01FromCaptain
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained HM01\nfrom the CAPTAIN!$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut
lines.text: Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSetSailSoon
lines.text: CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
lines.text: Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YuckShouldntHaveLooked
lines.text: Yuck!\nShouldn't have looked!$

lines.label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerSeasickness
lines.text: How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon
lines.text: The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ScrubbingDecksHardWork
lines.text: Whew!\nScrubbing decks is hard work!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick
lines.text: Urf… I feel ill…\pI got seasick, so I stepped out to\nget some air…$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro
lines.text: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondDefeat
lines.text: You're impressive!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle
lines.text: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorIntro
lines.text: Ahoy, there!\nAre you seasick?$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorDefeat
lines.text: I was just careless!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle
lines.text: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay
lines.text: You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\lOut of the way!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SawOddBerryInTrash
lines.text: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SoBusyImDizzy
lines.text: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PeelSpudsEveryDay
lines.text: Hum-de-hum-de-ho…\pI peel spuds every day!\nHum-hum…$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsAGlutton
lines.text: Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\pNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions
lines.text: Snivel… Sniff…\pI only get to peel onions…\nSnivel…$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseIs
lines.text: Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\pLe main course is$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SalmonDuSalad
lines.text: Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue
lines.text: Eels au Barbecue!\pLes guests will mutiny, I fear.$

lines.label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PrimeBeefsteak
lines.text: Prime Beefsteak!\pBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: THREE ISLAND\nKin Island of Family Bonding$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs
lines.text: Hyahoo!\pFrom this day on, this island\nbelongs to us!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto
lines.text: We don't need you people bringing\nyour noise and trouble here!\pWe're asking you to go back to\nKANTO!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay
lines.text: Hey, go cry somewhere else.\nOur boss is on his way.\pWhen he gets here, we'll give you\na k-rad motorbike show you won't\lsoon forget!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow
lines.text: W-what!? Not on your life!\nGet off the island now!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhosGonnaMakeMe
lines.text: Who's gonna make me?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_AreYouBossGoBackToKanto
lines.text: Are you the boss?\nGo back to KANTO right now!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_JustGotHerePal
lines.text: Hah?\pI just got here, pal.\pWhat's with the hostile attitude?\nIt's mighty cold of you!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_FollowersRaisingHavoc
lines.text: Your gang of followers have been\nraising havoc on their bikes.\pDo you have any idea how much\ntrouble they've caused us on the\lisland?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_OughtToBeThankingUs
lines.text:
No, man, I don't get it at all.\pLook at this place.
What do you do for entertainment?\pYou ought to be thanking us for
livening up this sleepy village.\pBut hey, if you insist, you can try
making us leave.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouCowardsToughInPack
lines.text: Grr… You cowards…\nSo tough in a pack…$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_WannaMakeSomethingOfYourStaring
lines.text: You, what are you staring at?\nDon't you know it's not polite?\pYou wanna make something of it\nor what?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThatsSmart
lines.text: That's smart.\nKeep your nose out of this.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Intro
lines.text: Heh, I like your guts.\nYou'll be losing money to me, but…$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Defeat
lines.text: Wha…\nWhat is this kid?!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1PostBattle
lines.text: Aww, man…\nDon't you dare laugh!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Intro
lines.text: Aren't you from KANTO?\nYou should be on our side!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Defeat
lines.text: Stop fooling around!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle
lines.text: What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3Intro
lines.text: We invited the boss out here,\nbut you had to mess it up!\pYou embarrassed us, man!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3PostBattle
lines.text: Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta\ndo something about this kid!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonIntro
lines.text:
I've been watching you, and I'd say
you've done enough.\pWhat are you, their friend or
something?\pThen I guess you'll be battling me
in their place.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonDefeat
lines.text: All right, enough!\nWe'll leave like you wanted!\pWe'll be happy to see the last of\nthis boring island!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
lines.text: Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging\naround with these hayseeds!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHurt
lines.text: Thank you! Those goons were\nnothing but bad trouble.\pOh, look, your POKéMON got hurt\non my account.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_GivenFullRestore
lines.text: {PLAYER} was given\na FULL RESTORE.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_OhYourBagIsFull
lines.text: Oh?\nYour BAG is full.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons
lines.text: You've got seriously impressive\nPOKéMON with you.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsBondBridge
lines.text:
It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.\pI hope you'll at least stay here
a while.\p…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?\pLOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersHereAgain
lines.text: THREE ISLAND is actually the most\npopulous of the islands here.\pStill, it could be less sleepy.\pBut I wouldn't want to see goons\nlike those BIKERS here again.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingToPlayGame
lines.text: I'm going to train my DODUO in the\nBERRY FOREST.\pWhen it evolves, I'm going to play\na game on TWO ISLAND.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Text_Doduo
lines.text: DODUO: Gigiih!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPokemon
lines.text:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComesAgain
lines.text: Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHaveThis
lines.text: Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome
lines.text: What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchIsFull
lines.text: Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBerryForest
lines.text: Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BewareWildBerryLovingMons
lines.text: Beware of wild, BERRY-loving\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro
lines.text: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiDefeat
lines.text: …Sniff, sniff…\nSomething smells unpleasant…$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBattle
lines.text: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro
lines.text: Where are you off to in such\na hurry?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletDefeat
lines.text: You're raising some wonderful\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBattle
lines.text: If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro
lines.text: My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraDefeat
lines.text: Waaah!\nWaaah!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBattle
lines.text: This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisIntro
lines.text: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisDefeat
lines.text: What happens now?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBattle
lines.text: Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro
lines.text: Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat
lines.text: Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBattle
lines.text: A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro
lines.text: JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyDefeat
lines.text: JOY: Ohh…\nMEG!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattle
lines.text: JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro
lines.text: MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegDefeat
lines.text: MEG: Ohh…\nJOY!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegPostBattle
lines.text: MEG: JOY, wasn't that fun?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BerryForestAhead
lines.text: BERRY FOREST AHEAD$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSign
lines.text: BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ProspectingForGold
lines.text:
Hey, there!
How's it going?\pWhat am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!\pWhen I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckGoldThisIsForYou
lines.text:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!\pYou remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?\pYou can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.\pSo, I'll show you!
This is for you!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsANugget
lines.text: That's a NUGGET!\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsBagCrammedFull
lines.text: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!\nI'll give this to you later.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCool
lines.text: LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nYou're always so cool!\pI'll make lunch for you, too, one\nday, {PLAYER}.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDisplayed
lines.text: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoonBend
lines.text:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh…
Kwaaaaah!\p…It's useless! I can't make this
spoon bend with my mind.\pMaybe I really don't have any
psychic powers.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina
lines.text:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?\pI admire her, I really do.\pI've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSomewhereQuiet
lines.text: I bought this house because I\nwanted to live somewhere quiet.\pToday, I think I'll go out fishing.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryForest
lines.text: You must never, ever go out to\nthe BERRY FOREST alone.\pWhy?\nThere are ghosts there.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingToMe
lines.text: Papa keeps lying to me, and won't\nlet me go out and play!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle
lines.text:
Me?
I'm not LOSTELLE.\pShe's probably gone to the
BERRY FOREST, I think.\pShe picks BERRIES there for making
lunch.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLostelle
lines.text: I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE\ntoday.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDeptStoreBigger
lines.text: Is it true?\pCELADON DEPT. STORE is several\ntimes bigger than this shop?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerriesFromForest
lines.text: I sometimes buy medicine here.\pBut a lot of people heal POKéMON\nwith BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.\pAfter all, BERRIES are free and\nthey never run out.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToTrashMart
lines.text: Those BIKERS were about to trash\nthis POKéMON MART.\pAm I glad they decided to leave!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetworkCanLinkWithKanto
lines.text: Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ImpossibleToSurfBetweenIslands
lines.text: It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBerriesInBerryForest
lines.text: Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFederation
lines.text: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney
lines.text: Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice
lines.text: Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBikersGone
lines.text: Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOutForBest
lines.text: Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WelcomeToTrainerTower
lines.text: Hello!\pWelcome to TRAINER TOWER where\nTRAINERS gather from all over!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpToFloorNum
lines.text: TRAINERS from all over the world\ngather here to battle.\pLet me see…\pRight now, there are TRAINERS only\nup to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpEighthFloor
lines.text: TRAINERS are awaiting your\nchallenge up to the eighth floor.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
lines.text: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StartClockGetSetGo
lines.text: Okay, I'll get the clock started,\nso give it everything you have.\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
lines.text: Please do visit us again!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TooBadComeBackTryAgain
lines.text: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest
lines.text: I hope you give it your best.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_MoveCounterHereWhenTrainersSwitch
lines.text: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPerfectly
lines.text: Hello…\pI am the owner of this TOWER…\pHow the sky soars above this\nrooftop…\pThe caress of the winds up here…\pIt's all so perfect…\pThe way you battled…\nIt, too, was perfection…$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ThisIsForYou
lines.text: This is for you…$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_DoneItInRecordTime
lines.text:
Oh!
Stupendous!\pIt's marvelous how you've come up
here so quickly.\pThe fact is, you've done it in
record time…\pI'll have your record posted at
the reception counter.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_TookSweetTimeGettingHere
lines.text: You seem to have taken your sweet\ntime getting here…$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetterTime
lines.text: What I would like to see is a\nbetter time out of you…\pI'm counting on you.\pUntil then, farewell…$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Text_XMinYZSec
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_HereAreTheResults
lines.text: せいせきひょうです$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDouble
lines.text: This is a two-on-two battle.\pYou may not battle unless you have\nat least two POKéMON.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ExplainTrainerTower
lines.text:
Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an
event called TIME ATTACK.\pYou will be timed on how quickly
you can get from the reception\lcounter to the OWNER on the roof.\pThe best times will be recorded on
the Time Board.\pTry competing with friends to see
who can beat it the fastest.\pYou will not earn any EXP. Points
or money by beating TRAINERS here.$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ThanksForCompeting
lines.text: Thank you for competing!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsOfTrainers
lines.text: I'm here to see how good I am.\pI wonder what kinds of TRAINERS\nare waiting for me?\pIt's nerve-racking!$

lines.label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherThanAnyBattle
lines.text: Gasp, gasp…\nGasp…\pNever mind battling! These stairs…\nThey're tougher than any battle…$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_IslandSign
lines.text: TWO ISLAND\nBoon Island for Two$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_JoyfulGameCornerSign
lines.text: Skip & Chomp!\nJoyful GAME CORNER$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent
lines.text: DANGER! FAST CURRENT!\nFishing and surfing prohibited!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseLimited
lines.text: Oh!\nHello, welcome to my shop!\pWe've only opened up recently.\pOur merchandise is limited, but I\nhope we can serve your needs.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostelle
lines.text:
I can't tell you how grateful I am
for your rescue of LOSTELLE.\pThanks to your feat, the people of
THREE ISLAND have changed their\lattitudes about KANTO people.\pAnd, I'm from KANTO, you see.\pThe people of THREE ISLAND
helped me add to my merchandise.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
lines.text: Hi! I'm giving it my best here.\nI hope you do too, {PLAYER}.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantLands
lines.text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
Welcome!\pI've started bringing in items from
distant lands.\pI've got some rare items in, too.
Please have a look!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCity
lines.text:
That fellow there, he moved here
from CELADON CITY.\pHe started up a shop with his
younger brother.\pYou have to wonder if he knew what
he was getting into.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGameCorner
lines.text: The shopkeeper's brother took\na job at the GAME CORNER.\pHe's trying to pull together money\nso they can buy more merchandise.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBack
lines.text:
Listen, listen.
Did you know?\pA famous TRAINER came to the
ISLAND a little while back.\pHe's one of the ELITE FOUR.
His name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he
found out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere
lines.text: The discerning TRAINER knows to\nbuy rare items here!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape
lines.text: There's an old woman who lives in\na cottage out on the cape.\pShe gives the eye to POKéMON.\nIt's a bit unnerving.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame
lines.text:
Boing! Boing!
Have you tried the jumping game?\pThe POKéMON you can enter…
Boing!\pSome go boing!\pAnd some go boooooooing!\pDid you know that?
Boing!$

lines.label: Text_UltimateMoveThatMon
lines.text:
I perfected the ultimate move of
its type…\pBut will no one take it for
future use?\p…Hm? Hmmm!\pY-you…
Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…$

lines.label: Text_JustMistaken
lines.text: …No…\nI was just mistaken.$

lines.label: Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove
lines.text:
Oh! This is the one!
This is the POKéMON!\pThis {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of
learning my ultimate move!\pWill you allow it?\pWill you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to
learn my {STR_VAR_2}?$

lines.label: Text_YouRejectIt
lines.text: Gaah! You reject it?\nNo, I won't be dissuaded!$

lines.label: Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove
lines.text: You will allow it?\pThen, let me confer my ultimate\n{STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pGgggrah-awooo!$

lines.label: Text_TaughtMove
lines.text: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI didn't think I could teach that\nmove while I still lived…$

lines.label: Text_MakeBestUseOfMove
lines.text: I implore you to make the best\nuse of that move and gain power!$

lines.label: Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow
lines.text: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI have no regrets now.\nI've passed on everything I know.\pNow I can live out my life knowing\nmy work is done.$

lines.label: Text_FeelRejuvenated
lines.text: After I passed on my knowledge to\nyou, I felt so much relief.\pIn fact, I feel rejuvenated,\nas if I were younger again!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMushroom
lines.text:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove
lines.text: Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TutorWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachWhichMove
lines.text: Which move should I teach?$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThatMon
lines.text: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTwo
lines.text: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverTwoTinyMushrooms
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed over two\nTINYMUSHROOMS in exchange.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMushroom
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoToLearnMove
lines.text: If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg
lines.text: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_WhereHasLostelleGottenTo
lines.text: Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseHelpFindLostelle
lines.text:
Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IsThisOnlyThreeIsland
lines.text:
Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsTwoIslandMoveIt
lines.text: Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_TheseIslandsAreConfusing
lines.text: Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PunkScuffedUpMyFloor
lines.text: Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseGoToThreeIsland
lines.text:
Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotRunningAnyGamesToday
lines.text: I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGamesGoingSoon
lines.text: We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_YouRescuedLostelle
lines.text: So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_LostelleItsOkayDaddy
lines.text: LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsForMe
lines.text:
Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_HandedMeteoriteToLostellesDaddy
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed the METEORITE\nto LOSTELLE's daddy.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_OhThisIsFromBill
lines.text: Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ReceivedMoonStoneFromLostellesDaddy
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotGoingToFitInBag
lines.text: Your BAG's not going to fit another\nthing…$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IllGetGameCornerRunning
lines.text: All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER\nrunning right away.\pYou have to come visit with a\nfriend.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseShowMeYouBeingCool
lines.text: Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!$

lines.label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouVisitedGameCorner
lines.text: Have you visited the GAME CORNER\nalready?\pIt's no good to go alone.\nYou have to take a friend along.$

lines.label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OldLadyLivesOutOnCape
lines.text:
Not many people live on
TWO ISLAND.\pThere is this old lady who lives
out on the cape.\pShe's been there since I don't know
when.$

lines.label: UndergroundPath_EastEntrance_Text_DoYouGoToCeladonDeptStore
lines.text: The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON\nhas a great selection.\pDo you go there very often?$

lines.label: UndergroundPath_SouthEntrance_Text_PeopleLoseThingsInTheDarkness
lines.text: People often lose things in the\ndarkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.$

lines.label: UndergroundPath_WestEntrance_Text_SleepyMonNearCeladon
lines.text: I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared\nout near CELADON CITY, too.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSludge
lines.text: We're careful about pollution here.\pWe've heard GRIMER multiplies in\ntoxic sludge.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarbor
lines.text: Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored\nin the harbor?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForYear
lines.text: So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?\pShe'll be back in VERMILION about\nthis time next year.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand
lines.text: I'm putting up a building on this\nplot of land. I own it all.\pMy POKéMON is tamping the land\nto lay the foundation.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_Machop
lines.text: MACHOP: Guoh! Gogogoh!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFlat
lines.text: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear
lines.text: The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury\ncruise ship.\pIt visits VERMILION once a year.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: VERMILION CITY\nThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute12
lines.text: NOTICE!\pROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a\nsleeping POKéMON.\pDetour through ROCK TUNNEL to\nLAVENDER TOWN.\pVERMILION POLICE$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
lines.text: POKéMON FAN CLUB\nAll POKéMON fans welcome!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_VermilionHarbor
lines.text: VERMILION HARBOR$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_WelcomeToTheSSAnne
lines.text: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket
lines.text: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!\pExcuse me, do you have a ticket?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_FlashedSSTicket
lines.text: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} flashed the S.S. TICKET!\p{FONT_MALE}Great!\nWelcome to the S.S. ANNE!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicket
lines.text: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed\nS.S. TICKET.\p{FONT_MALE}Sorry!\pYou need a ticket to get aboard.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_TheShipSetSail
lines.text: The ship set sail.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass
lines.text: Ah, you have a TRI-PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing
lines.text: Okay, everything's in order.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbowPass
lines.text: Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYouToNavelRock
lines.text: Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nNAVEL ROCK anytime.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYouToBirthIsland
lines.text: Oh! That's an AURORATICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nBIRTH ISLAND anytime.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry
lines.text: Would you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing
lines.text: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing
lines.text: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageForYou
lines.text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
How are you doing?\pIt's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pDid you meet the other AIDE?\pHe had a package from PROF. OAK
for you, {PLAYER}.\pHe said he'd look for you around
ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.\pIf you're in the ROUTE 2 area,
please look for him.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
lines.text:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're
doing here?\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
lines.text: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your
POKéMON's SPEED!\pIt also lets your POKéMON FLY
lightning-quick anytime, kid!\pYou're special, kid!
Take this!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM34FromLtSurge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM34\nfrom LT. SURGE.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM34
lines.text: TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag
lines.text: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
lines.text: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro
lines.text: When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerDefeat
lines.text: Stop!\nYou're very good!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle
lines.text: It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro
lines.text: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyDefeat
lines.text: Fried!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle
lines.text: Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro
lines.text: This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\nSurprised me!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle
lines.text:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
lines.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pBIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
lines.text: Whew!\nThat match was electric!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
lines.text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_NopeOnlyTrashHere
lines.text: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashFirstLockOpened
lines.text: Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_AnotherSwitchInTrash
lines.text: ガサゴソ‥！\nおっと！　ゴミばこの　そこに\lまた　スイッチが　あった！\lおして　みよう！　‥　ポチッとな$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened
lines.text: The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWereReset
lines.text: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruDoYouLikeToFish
lines.text: I'm the FISHING GURU!\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFish
lines.text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRodFromFishingGuru
lines.text: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayOfLife
lines.text: Fishing is a way of life!\nIt is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out\nand land the big one, my friend.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_OhThatsSoDisappointing
lines.text: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
lines.text: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceGift
lines.text: Oh, no!\pI had a nice gift for you, but you\nhave no room for it!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMyMon
lines.text: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThatsTooBad
lines.text: That's too bad.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThisIsNoMon
lines.text: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, please trade it\nto me!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThankYou
lines.text: Thank you!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_HowIsMyOldMon
lines.text: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\pMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_PidgeyFlyLetterToSaffron
lines.text: I'm getting my PIDGEY to fly a\nletter to SAFFRON in the north.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_Pidgey
lines.text: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_DearPippiLetter
lines.text: Dear PIPPI,\nI hope to see you soon.\pI heard SAFFRON has problems with\nTEAM ROCKET.\pVERMILION appears to be safe.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_SendMyPidgeyToUnionRoom
lines.text: I want to exchange MAIL with all\nsorts of people.\pI send my PIDGEY to a UNION ROOM\nto exchange MAIL for me.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_TeamRocketAreWickedPeople
lines.text:
There are wicked people who will
use POKéMON for criminal acts.\pTEAM ROCKET traffics in rare
POKéMON, for example.\pThey also abandon POKéMON that
they consider unpopular or useless.\pThat's the sort of horrid people
they are, TEAM ROCKET.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_MonsGoodOrBadDependingOnTrainer
lines.text: I think POKéMON can be good or\nbad. It depends on the TRAINER.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainerMonsStrongerThanWild
lines.text: Even if they are the same level,\nPOKéMON can have very different\lstats and abilities.\pA POKéMON raised by a TRAINER is\nstronger than one in the wild.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PoisonedMonFaintedWhileWalking
lines.text: My POKéMON was poisoned!\nIt fainted while we were walking!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AllMonWeakToSpecificTypes
lines.text:
It is true that a higher-level
POKéMON will be more powerful…\pBut, all POKéMON will have weak
points against specific types.\pSo, there appears to be no
universally strong POKéMON.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UrgeToBattleSomeoneAgain
lines.text:
The urge to battle with someone
you've tangled with before…\pHave you ever had that urge?
I'm sure you have.\pI wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.\pSo, I've been giving these away.
Please, take one!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UseDeviceForRematches
lines.text: Use that device and you'll find\nTRAINERS looking for a rematch.\pYou have to charge its battery to\nuse it, though.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainVSSeeker
lines.text:
How do you use the VS SEEKER?
There's nothing to it.\pUse it like beep-beep-beep, and
TRAINERS around you will notice.\pIf any TRAINER wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.\pCharge its battery and use it
while you're on a road.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdmirePikachusTail
lines.text: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's\nadorable tail?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PikachuTwiceAsCute
lines.text: Humph!\pMy PIKACHU is twice as cute as\nthat one!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdoreMySeel
lines.text: I just adore my SEEL!\nIt's so lovable!\pIt squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I\nhug it!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFarMoreAttractive
lines.text: Oh, dear!\pMy SEEL is far more attractive.\nBy double, I would say.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pikachu
lines.text: PIKACHU: Chu! Pikachu!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Seel
lines.text: SEEL: Kyuoo!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYouComeToHearAboutMyMons
lines.text:
I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!\pSo…\pDid you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmansStory
lines.text:
Good!
Then listen up!\pMy favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt's…cute…lovely…smart… 
plus…amazing…you think so?…\loh yes…it's…stunning…\lkindly…love it!\pHug it…when…sleeping…warm
and cuddly…spectacular…\lravishing…\l…Oops! Look at the time!\lI kept you too long!\pThanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ReceivedBikeVoucherFromChairman
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER\nfrom the CHAIRMAN.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBikeVoucher
lines.text:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.\pExchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!\pDon't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.\pSo, I have no need for a BICYCLE.\pI hope you like cycling!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBackToHearStory
lines.text: Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntComeToSeeAboutMonsAgain
lines.text: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo?\nToo bad!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MakeRoomForThis
lines.text: Make room for this!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanVeryVocalAboutPokemon
lines.text: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ListenPolitelyToOtherTrainers
lines.text: Let's all listen politely to other\nTRAINERS!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SomeoneBragsBragBack
lines.text: If someone brags, brag right back!$

lines.label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanReallyAdoresHisMons
lines.text: Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his\nPOKéMON.\pBut the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro
lines.text: I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiDefeat
lines.text: I lost out…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle
lines.text: I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro
lines.text: I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoDefeat
lines.text: I had a chance…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle
lines.text: Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro
lines.text: If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonDefeat
lines.text: No!\nUnbelievable!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle
lines.text: I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro
lines.text: This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeDefeat
lines.text: Atcho!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle
lines.text: If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro
lines.text: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonDefeat
lines.text: You got me!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonPostBattle
lines.text: {RIVAL} also came through here.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentIntro
lines.text: Come on!\nI'll whip you!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentDefeat
lines.text: I got whipped!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle
lines.text: You earned the right to be on\nVICTORY ROAD…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryIntro
lines.text: Is VICTORY ROAD too tough?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryDefeat
lines.text: Well done!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle
lines.text: Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_Gyaoo
lines.text: ギヤーオ！$

lines.label: Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
lines.text:
You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\lVICTORY ROAD so courageously.\pIn recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.\pWould you like me to teach that
technique?$

lines.label: Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
lines.text: I'll teach you the technique\nanytime.$

lines.label: Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$

lines.label: Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
lines.text: Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\pTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro
lines.text: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeDefeat
lines.text: The rumors were true!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle
lines.text: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaIntro
lines.text: TRAINERS live to seek stronger\nopponents.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nSo strong!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle
lines.text: By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro
lines.text: I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineDefeat
lines.text: I'm furious!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
lines.text: You showed me just how good\nI was…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro
lines.text: Only the chosen can pass here!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyDefeat
lines.text: I don't believe it!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle
lines.text: All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro
lines.text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayDefeat
lines.text: RAY: Ludicrous!\nThis can't be!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle
lines.text: RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons
lines.text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro
lines.text: TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraDefeat
lines.text: TYRA: Oh, but…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle
lines.text: TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
lines.text: TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere
lines.text: Those POKé BALLS at your waist!\nYou have POKéMON, don't you?\pIt's great that you can carry and\nuse POKéMON anytime, anywhere.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLeaderIs
lines.text: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.\pI wonder who the LEADER is?$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_ViridiansGymLeaderReturned
lines.text: VIRIDIAN GYM's LEADER returned!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpillarMons
lines.text: You want to know about the two\nkinds of caterpillar POKéMON?$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_OhOkayThen
lines.text: Oh, okay then!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle
lines.text: CATERPIE has no poison,\nbut WEEDLE does.\pWatch that your POKéMON aren't\nstabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeYet
lines.text: Oh, Grandpa!\nDon't be so mean!\pI'm so sorry.\nHe hasn't had his coffee yet.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOccasionally
lines.text: I go shopping in PEWTER CITY\noccasionally.\pI have to take the winding trail in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty
lines.text: I absolutely forbid you from\ngoing through here!\pThis is private property!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons
lines.text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pHm?
What is that red box you have?\pAh, so you're working on your
POKéDEX.\pThen let me give you a word of
advice.\pWhenever you catch a POKéMON,
the POKéDEX automatically updates\lits data.\p…You don't know how to catch
a POKéMON?\pI suppose I had better show you
then!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTakeThis
lines.text: There! Now tell me, that was\neducational, was it not?\pAnd here, take this, too.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics
lines.text: If there's something you don't\nunderstand, watch that.\pIt will teach you about the basics\nof being a POKéMON TRAINER.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch
lines.text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, are you filling your
POKéDEX?\pAt first, focus on weakening the
POKéMON before trying to catch it.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping
lines.text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, is my old TEACHY TV
helping you?$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow
lines.text: Wahaha!\nIt's my grandson on the show!\pSince he's the one doing the\nteaching, you're bound to learn.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV
lines.text: Hm… You're too busy to not even\nhave the time for TEACHY TV…\pTime is money, and neither should\nbe ill spent…$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: VIRIDIAN CITY \nThe Eternally Green Paradise$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBattles
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pCatch POKéMON and expand your\ncollection.\pThe more you have, the easier it\nis to battle.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe battle moves of POKéMON are\nlimited by their POWER POINTS, PP.\pTo replenish PP, rest your tired\nPOKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: VIRIDIAN CITY POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Text_GymDoorsAreLocked
lines.text: VIRIDIAN GYM's doors are locked…$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro
lines.text:
Fwahahaha!
Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.\pBut, you have found me again.
So be it.\lThis time, I'm not holding back!\pOnce more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
lines.text:
Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.\lI have betrayed their trust.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!\pAs for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.\pLet us meet again someday!
Farewell!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.\pIt is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pAlso, take this TM.\pConsider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM26FromGiovanni
lines.text: {PLAYER} received TM26\nfrom GIOVANNI.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26
lines.text: TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.\pIt is a powerful attack that causes\na massive tremor.\pI made it when I ran the GYM here,\nfar too long ago… $

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace
lines.text: You do not have space for this!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro
lines.text: Heh!\nYou must be running out of steam\lby now!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiDefeat
lines.text: I ran out of gas!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle
lines.text: You'll need power to keep up with\nour GYM LEADER.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro
lines.text: Rrrroar!\nI'm working myself into a rage!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiDefeat
lines.text: Wargh!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
lines.text: I'm still not worthy!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro
lines.text: POKéMON and I, we make wonderful\nmusic together!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonDefeat
lines.text: You are in perfect harmony!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle
lines.text: Do you know the identity of our\nGYM LEADER?$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro
lines.text: Karate is the ultimate form of\nmartial arts!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoDefeat
lines.text: Aiyah!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle
lines.text: If my POKéMON were as good at\nkarate as I…$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro
lines.text: The truly talented win with style.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenDefeat
lines.text: I lost my grip!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle
lines.text: The LEADER will scold me for\nlosing this way…$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro
lines.text: I'm the KARATE KING!\nYour fate rests with me!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiDefeat
lines.text: Ayah!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle
lines.text: The POKéMON LEAGUE?\nYou? Don't get cocky!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro
lines.text: Your POKéMON will cower at the\ncrack of my whip!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeDefeat
lines.text: Yowch!\nWhiplash!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColePostBattle
lines.text: Wait!\nI was just careless!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro
lines.text: VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a\nlong time.\pBut now, our LEADER is back!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelDefeat
lines.text: I was beaten?$

lines.label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle

This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPage
lines.text:
Let's check out the notebook.\pFirst page…\pPOKé BALLS are used to catch
POKéMON.\pUp to six POKéMON can be carried
in your party.\pPeople who raise and battle
with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondPage
lines.text: Second page…\pA healthy POKéMON may be hard to\ncatch, so weaken it first.\pPoison, burn, or cause another\nstatus problem to weaken it.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPage
lines.text:
Third page…\pPOKéMON TRAINERS seek others to
engage in POKéMON battles.\pTo TRAINERS, the taste of victory
is sweet, indeed.\pBattles are constantly waged at
POKéMON GYMS everywhere.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthPage
lines.text:
Fourth page…\pThe ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.\pIt is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.\pDo so to earn the right to face…\pThe ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep
lines.text:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.\pPOKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.\pUse AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn
lines.text: A burn reduces ATTACK power.\nIt also causes ongoing HP loss.\pA burn remains after a battle.\nUse BURN HEAL to cure a burn.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison
lines.text: When poisoned, a POKéMON's health\nsteadily drops.\pPoison lingers after battles.\nUse an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze
lines.text:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.\pIt stays frozen even after the
battle ends.\pUse ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.$

lines.label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysis
lines.text: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may\nprevent the POKéMON from moving.\pParalysis remains after battles.\nUse PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.$

lines.label: CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes
lines.text:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\pMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.$
