lines.label: CableClub_Text_UnionRoomInfo
lines.text:
The TRAINERS in the UNION ROOM
will be those players around you\lwho have also entered the ROOM.\pYou may do all sorts of things
here, such as exchanging greetings.\pYou may enter two POKéMON up to
Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.\pYou may take part in a chat with
two to five people.\pOr, you may register a POKéMON for
trade.\pWould you like to enter the ROOM?$

lines.label: CableClub_Text_EnjoyUnionRoom

lines.label: CableClub_Text_FirstTimeRightThisWay
lines.text:
Hello!
My name is TEALA.\pThis must be your first time
up here.\pI'll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.\pFirst, I need to show you this
floor of our POKéMON CENTER.\pRight this way, please.$

lines.label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClubFirstTime
lines.text:
On the top floor, there are two
rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

lines.label: CableClub_Text_AskAboutLinking
lines.text: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pIt's me, TEALA, the POKéMON\nCENTER 2F attendant.\pIs there something you needed to\nask me about linking?$

lines.label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
lines.text:
Let me explain how the POKéMON
WIRELESS CLUB works.\pOn this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pSometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM\lor the DIRECT CORNER.\pIn that case, please move closer
to your friends.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

Why don't you try it?$

lines.text: What's your profile?$

lines.label: Text_DontBeLikeThat
lines.text: Aww… Don't be like that.\nYou can tell me your profile.$

lines.label: Text_DecidedNotTo
lines.text: Oh, you've decided not to?\nYou're fickle, aren't you?$

lines.label: Text_HiWeMeetAgain
lines.text: Hi!\nWe meet again!$

lines.label: Text_ChangeYourProfile
lines.text: Would you like to change your\nprofile?$

lines.label: Text_WhatAreYouLikeNow
lines.text: What are you like now?\nI'd really like to know.$

lines.label: Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
lines.text: Okay, you like your profile the\nway it is.\pI think so, too.$

lines.label: Text_ProfileSaysSomethingAboutYou
lines.text: Hmhm…\pYour profile really says something\nabout who you are.\pNow that I know you better, it \nmakes us better friends than ever!$

lines.label: Text_HeardThatBefore
lines.text: Oh, I've heard that before…\pMy cousin, who lives far away,\nalways used to say that, I think.$

lines.label: Text_TellMoreNextTime
lines.text: Please tell me more about\nyourself next time!$

lines.label: Text_RepelWoreOff
lines.text: REPEL's effect wore off…$

lines.label: Test_Text_WelcomeToWorldOfPokemon
lines.text: テストよう　メッセージです！\nポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！$

lines.label: Test_Text_ThisIsASignpost
lines.text: テストよう　メッセージです！\nかんばん　です$

lines.label: Test_Text_ThisIsACoordEvent
lines.text: テストよう　メッセージです！\nざひょう　チェックの　イベントです$

lines.label: Aide_Text_HaventCaughtEnoughMonsForItem
lines.text: Let's see…\nUh-oh! You have caught only\l{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pYou need {STR_VAR_1} kinds\nif you want the {STR_VAR_2}.$

lines.label: Aide_Text_GetEnoughMonsComeBackForItem
lines.text: …Oh. I see.\pWhen you get {STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON,\ncome back for the {STR_VAR_2}.$

lines.label: Aide_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForItem
lines.text: Oh! I see you don't have any\nroom for the {STR_VAR_2}.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
lines.text: パパ“やあ　{PLAYER}！\pめずらしい　きのみを　てに　いれたから\nプレゼント　するよ！$

lines.label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
lines.text: ふかふかの　つちに　はえている　きのみは\nじゆうに　とっても　よいのじゃが‥\p1つだけ　きのみを　おなじ　ばしょに　うめる\nそれが　れいぎと　いうものじゃ\pほれ　これを　わけてやろう$

lines.label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
lines.text: あんた　みたところ　トレーナーじゃろ？\pトレーナーは　よく　きのみを　ポケモンに\nもたせとるわい\pふやすも　つかうも　あんた　しだいじゃ$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
lines.text: いつも　みずを　あげてたら\nたくさん　はなが　さいたんだ\pそしたら　きのみも　たくさん　できた！\pはい！\nこれ　あげる$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TryToMakeRedPokeblock
lines.text: がんばって　あかいポロック　つくるんだ！\n{STR_VAR_1}も　がんばってね！$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
lines.text: きょうは　なにいろの　きのみを\nさがそっかなー$

lines.label: Route114_Text_GatheringBerriesForContest
lines.text: ポケモンコンテストの　ゆうしょうを　めざして\nきのみを　あつめているんだ\pよかったら　きみにも　わけて　あげるよ！$

lines.label: Route114_Text_GoodLuckToYouToo
lines.text: きみも　がんばれ！$

lines.label: Route114_Text_WhatBerriesShouldIPlantToday
lines.text: きょうは　どの　きのみを　うめるか‥\nそして　なにいろの　ポロックを　つくるか‥\pなやむのも　また　たのしいよ$

lines.label: Route120_Text_PokeblocksExpressionOfLove
lines.text: ケースを　ふると　でてくる　ポロック‥\pそして　それを　キャッチして\nたべてくれる　ポケモン‥\pこれって　あい　だよね？$

lines.label: Route120_Text_YouUnderstandTakeThis
lines.text: うん　うん！\nやっぱ　わかるひとには　わかるよね\pこれ　あげる$

lines.label: Route120_Text_OwnImpressionsImportantTakeThis
lines.text: そっか‥‥\nでも　ちがうと　かんじることも　たいせつだね\pこれ　あげる$

lines.label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
lines.text: その　きのみは　めずらしいもの　らしいから\nたいせつに　そだててね！$

lines.label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
lines.text: また　きのみめいじんに　もらって　こようっと$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
lines.text: やっぱり\pわたしに　スーツが　にあうように\nうみには　しおかぜが　にあうな\lそして　きみには　きのみが　にあいそうだ‥‥\pなんでだろうね？$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
lines.text: やっぱり　それは‥‥‥‥\pきみが　トレーナーだからだ！$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
lines.text: やっぱり\pわたしに　シンプルさが　にあうように\nポケモンには　ポロックが　にあうな$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
lines.text: わしは　きのみめいじんと　よばれておる\pわしは　せかいじゅうを　うつくしい　はなで\nうめつくそうと　きのみを　そだてて\lそして　くばり　まくって　おるのじゃ\pきみにも　きのみを　わけて　あげよう！$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
lines.text: ほれ　えんりょ　せずに　もう　ひとつ！$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
lines.text: カナズミの　ちかくにある　サン·トウカという\nフラワーショップも　よろしくの\pせかいに　はなを　さかせましょう！$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
lines.text: きょうは　もう　おしまいじゃ\nまた　おいで\pせかいに　はなを　さかせましょう！$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
lines.text: じいさんの　きのみの　そだてかたは\nそりゃあ　せかいいちじゃ\pわしも　はなが　たかいわい\pところで　あんた\nいい　ことばを　きいたことが　ないかい？$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
lines.text: おお！　とても　よい　ことばじゃ！\nかんどう　したわい\pほれ　これを　もっていきなされ$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
lines.text: おお！　なかなか　よい　ことばじゃ\nあんたも　たいしたもんじゃ\pほれ　これを　もっていきなされ$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
lines.text: まごたち　4にんも　じいさんを　しのぐ\nおおものに　なるじゃろうて\pじんせい　たのしいことが　つきんのう！$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
lines.text: ほう‥‥$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
lines.text: こんにちは！\pはなを　せかいに　ひろめる\nフラワーショップ　サン·トウカです！$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}　きのみの　こと　しりたい？$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
lines.text: あなたの　なまえは‥‥\p{PLAYER}{KUN}ね！\nとっても　いい　なまえだね！\l{PLAYER}{KUN}　きのみのこと　しりたい？$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
lines.text:
きのみはね　くろい　ふかふかの　つちの
ところで　たまに　とれるの\lでね‥‥\pとったら　その1つを　また　うめるの！\pそうすると　その　きのみ　から
めがでて　みきが　できて　はながさいて\lまた　きのみ　が　できるの\pそうやって　はなを　ふやして
せかいじゅうを　はなに　するのが\lわたしの　ゆめ　なんだ！\pだから　{PLAYER}{KUN}も　きのみを　うめて
せかいに　はなを　ふやしてね！$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
lines.text: おはなって　とっても　しあわせな　きぶんに\nしてくれるよね$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
lines.text: こんにちは！\pおはなは　せわを　すれば　するほど\nたくさん　きれいに　さいて　くれるの\pあなたも　せわを　したく　なった　でしょ？\nこれ　あげるわ$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
lines.text:
きのみが　そだつ　たびに
じょうろで　みずを　あげてね！\pあとね\pきのみは　ずっと　ずっと　ほうっておくと
じめんに　おちてしまうの\lでもね　そこから　また　めがでて　くるの！\pすごいよね！
いきものの　ちからを　かんじるよね$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
lines.text: おねーちゃんたちを　みならって\nがんばって　おはなを　そだててるの\pはい！　これあげる！$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
lines.text: きのみは　うめて　おおきく　したり\nポケモンに　もたせたり　できるの\pでも　さいきん　きのみを　いくつか　まぜると\nポケモンの　おかしになる　きかいが\lある　らしいんだ\pあたしも　おかし　ほしー$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}　なまえ　なんていうの？\p‥‥‥　‥‥‥　‥‥‥\nへー　いいねー\pわたしは　キリ　っていう　なまえなの\pパパと　ママが　すくすくと　そだって\nこころの　あたたかい　おんなのこに　なって\lほしいっていう　ねがいを　こめたんだって！\p{STR_VAR_1}にも　これ　あげる$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
lines.text: あと　{STR_VAR_1}には　キリの　だいすきな\nこの　きのみも　あげちゃう！$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}の　なまえには\nどんな　ねがいが　こめられてるの？$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
lines.text: はる　なつ　あき　ふゆ\nはるに　うまれると　はるが　すきで\lなつに　うまれると　なつが　すきなのかな？$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
lines.text: じゃあ　キリは　あきに　うまれたから\nあきが　だいすき！\p{STR_VAR_1}は　いつが　すき？$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
lines.text: そっか‥\nかんけいないのか‥\pしりたいことって　たくさんあるなー$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_PleaseShowMeBigMon
lines.text: わしは　おおきな　{STR_VAR_1}に\nとても　きょうみが　ある！\pん？　きみ　{STR_VAR_1}　もってるの？\nちょ　ちょ　ちょっと···\lおじさんに　みせて　おくれ！$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GrandMonThanksForShowingMe
lines.text: おお！　こいつは　でかい！\nとても　すばらしい　{STR_VAR_1}だ！\pみせて　くれて　ありがとう\nおれいに　これを　もって　いきなさい$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ReceivedOneItem
lines.text: {PLAYER}は\n{STR_VAR_2}を　もらった！$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_HuhBagIsCrammedFull
lines.text: ありゃ？\nきみ　もちもの　いっぱいだね$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_IveSeenBiggerMonThanThisOne
lines.text: ううむ　わしは　これより　おおきい\n{STR_VAR_1}を　みたこと　あるな···$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_QuiteSomethingButNotMon
lines.text: おお　こいつは　なかなか···って\nこれ　{STR_VAR_1}じゃ　ないよ！$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_TooBadDontHaveBigMon
lines.text: おおきい　{STR_VAR_1}　もってないの？\lそれは　ざんねん···\nこんど　おおきい　{STR_VAR_1}　みせてね$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_BiggestMonPlayersXCmColossus
lines.text: しじょう　さいだいの　{STR_VAR_1}！\n{STR_VAR_2}の　{STR_VAR_3}cmのやつ！$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_ImDaycareManSpeakToMyWife
lines.text: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your\nPOKéMON, have a word with my wife.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_DoYouWantEgg
lines.text: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON, and\nmy goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine
lines.text: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_IllKeepIt
lines.text: Well then, I'll keep it.\nThanks!$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt
lines.text: You have no room for it…\nCome back when you've made room.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_ReceivedEgg
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the EGG from\nthe DAY-CARE MAN.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
lines.text: Take good care of it.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_SeeWifeIfYouWantToPickUpMon
lines.text: ポケモンを　ひきとりたい　ときは\nばさんに　いって　おくれ$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine
lines.text: Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt
lines.text: I really will keep it.\nYou do want this, yes?$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseMon
lines.text: I'm the DAY-CARE LADY.\pWe can raise POKéMON for you.\pWould you like us to raise one?$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldWeRaise
lines.text: Which POKéMON should we raise for\nyou?$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon

lines.label: DayCare_Text_WeCanRaiseOneMore
lines.text: We can raise two of your POKéMON.\pWould you like us to raise one\nmore POKéMON for you?$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_HusbandWasLookingForYou
lines.text: My husband was looking for you.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_FineThenComeAgain
lines.text: Oh, fine, then.\nCome again.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_NotEnoughMoney
lines.text: You don't have enough money…$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_TakeOtherOneBackToo
lines.text: Will you take back the other one,\ntoo?$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_ComeAgain
lines.text: Fine.\nCome again.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYou
lines.text: Ah, it's you!\nGood to see you.\pYour POKéMON can only be doing\ngood!$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_YourMonHasGrownXLevels

lines.label: DayCare_Text_YourPartyIsFull

lines.label: DayCare_Text_TakeBackWhichMon

lines.label: DayCare_Text_ItWillCostX

lines.label: DayCare_Text_HeresYourMon
lines.text: Perfect!\nHere's your POKéMON.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_TookBackMon

lines.label: DayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon
lines.text: Oh? But you have just one\nPOKéMON.\pCome back another time.$

lines.label: DayCare_Text_TakeYourMonBack

lines.label: DayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PEWTER GYM\nLEADER BROCK!\pBROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CERULEAN GYM\nLEADER MISTY!\pMISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurge
lines.text:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!\pLT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated
by POKéMON to power his plane.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CELADON GYM\nLEADER ERIKA!\pRumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga
lines.text:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!\pKOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrina
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: SAFFRON GYM\nLEADER SABRINA!\pPeople say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBlaine
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CINNABAR GYM\nLEADER BLAINE!\pBLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorelei
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LORELEI!\pKnown for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's BRUNO!\pBRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's AGATHA!\pIn her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LANCE!\pLANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOak
lines.text: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PROF. OAK,\nthe POKéMON Researcher!\pPROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyOak
lines.text:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…\pPOKéMON JOURNAL
CONTEST Special!\pThe Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!$

lines.label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji
lines.text:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!\pEditor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerPlayingForFirstTime
lines.text: You become the main character,\nexploring the world of POKéMON.\lBy talking to people and solving\lmysteries, new paths will open to you.\lStrive for the goal together with your\lwonderful POKéMON.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatShouldIBeDoing
lines.text: When you come across another person,\ngo up to them and press the A Button.\lThat will get them to talk and interact\lwith your character. You may also\lexamine various items and objects in\lthe same way. Talk to people and check\lthings often to obtain information.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerCantGetOutOfRoom
lines.text: On the stairs or the exits of a\nbuilding is a red mat. Move your\lcharacter to stand on top of the\lred mat. Press the {PLUS} Control Pad \ltoward the stairs or the exit to\ladvance.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerCantFindPersonIWant
lines.text: This isn't something you should worry\nabout too much.\lTalk to other people, check signs,\lcheck things, and so on.\lSometimes, you may need to just move\lto a new town or place.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerTalkedToEveryoneNowWhat
lines.text: Try moving on to a new road, town, or\nplace.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerSomeoneBlockingMyWay
lines.text: There could be something in the town\nor inside a building that is the cause.\lTry talking to the people in the area\lagain. If there is a problem that they\lneed solved, you may have to help.\lAfterwards, try talking to the person\lblocking your way again.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerICantGoOn
lines.text: Try talking to people by going up to\nthem and pressing the A Button.\lAlso, try checking things like odd trees\land strange rocks with the A Button.\lPress the {PLUS} Control Pad and try going\lto places that look impassable, too.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerOutOfThingsToDo
lines.text: Try going to places where you \nhaven't visited yet.\lAlso, check everything that looks\lsuspicious by pressing the A Button.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatHappenedToItemIGot
lines.text: Any item that you are given by another\ncharacter goes in your BAG.\lThe item is automatically sorted and\lplaced in one of three pockets.\lFor instructions on the BAG's use,\lplease refer to the HELP System's\l“How do I do this?” heading.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreMyAdventureBasics
lines.text: If POKéMON are hurt in battle,\ntake them to a POKéMON CENTER and\lhave them healed by the staff.\lGet in the habit of saving your\lgame and recording your progress.\lStock up on healing items at\lPOKéMON MARTS before traveling far.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerHowAreRoadsForestsDifferent
lines.text: Forests are basically the same as\nroads but they can be like mazes.\lAll forests have a way out, so don't\lgive up if you get lost.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerHowAreCavesDifferent
lines.text: Caves are dark and dangerous. Wild\nPOKéMON can appear anywhere in them.\lIf there is an emergency, rush to a\lPOKéMON CENTER or use items.\lNew towns await discovery beyond some\lcaves, so don't give up.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIProgress
lines.text: The object of the game is to train\nyour POKéMON and move forward.\lYou must collect info and solve\lproblems. For example, what do you\lneed to get around an obstacle?\lWhat would get that impeding\lperson out of the way?$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhenCanIUseItem
lines.text: There are several kinds of items.\nSome can be used only on the field.\lSome are only for use during battle.\lSome can be used anytime.\lTry using an item - if it can't be used,\lyou will be alerted.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsABattle
lines.text: In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce\none another's vitality, expressed as\lHP. If a POKéMON's HP falls to zero,\lit faints, and the other POKéMON\lwins. By winning a battle, POKéMON\learn EXP. Points, which help them\llevel up (grow stronger).$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIPrepareForBattle
lines.text: First, fully heal the POKéMON in your\nparty (the POKéMON with you) at any\lPOKéMON CENTER.\lYou should also buy healing items for\lemergencies at a POKéMON MART.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsAMonsVitality
lines.text: A POKéMON's vitality is expressed in HP.\nIf a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is\lsubtracted. If its HP drops to zero,\lthe POKéMON faints.\lHeal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a\lPOKéMON CENTER or by using items.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerMyMonsAreHurt
lines.text: A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for\nPOKéMON. It will fully heal POKéMON of\lany status problems and fully restore\ltheir HP using a special machine.\lThis service is free, so get in the\lhabit of healing your POKéMON often.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsStatusProblem
lines.text: A status problem refers to an ailment\nthat is inflicted on a POKéMON by its\lfoe's attack. These include burns,\lparalysis, poisoning, sleep, and\lfreezing. These can be healed by\lvisiting a POKéMON CENTER or using\lthe appropriate item.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatHappensIfAllMyMonsFaint
lines.text: If all the POKéMON in your party\n(all the POKéMON with you) faint, you\llose some MONEY, and you are\lreturned home or to a POKéMON\lCENTER. To reduce that chance, visit\lPOKéMON CENTERS often. Also, get\lin the habit of saving often.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerCantCatchMons
lines.text: If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé\nBALL, it's obviously still feisty.\lTry reducing its HP some more, and\ltry to weaken it with paralysis or sleep\lbefore trying to catch it.\lIf the POKé BALL rocks for a while,\lthe quarry is close to being caught!$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerRanOutOfPotions
lines.text: There are shops, known as POKéMON\nMARTS, that sell items.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on needed items while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerCanIBuyPokeBalls
lines.text: You may buy POKé BALLS at any\nPOKéMON MART in any town.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on POKé BALLS while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsATrainer
lines.text: A TRAINER is a person who raises\nPOKéMON through battling.\lTRAINERS will challenge you \lwherever they are - it could be on\la road, in forests, caves, anywhere.\lIf your eyes meet, you have to accept\ltheir challenge. So be careful!$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIWinAgainstTrainer
lines.text: To beat a TRAINER in battle, use\nPOKéMON that have type advantages\lover the foe's POKéMON. You may also\luse highly trained POKéMON with\loverwhelming power. Outnumbering the\lfoe's POKéMON is another obvious\ltactic.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhereDoMonsAppear
lines.text: Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass,\non roads, and in forests. They will\lappear anywhere in dark caves.\lThere are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS\lin towns, so they are safe places.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreMoves
lines.text: POKéMON may learn up to four different\ntechniques, or moves. There is a great\lvariety of moves including attacks and\lthose with special effects. The kinds\lof moves that can be learned vary\lfor each POKéMON. Some moves\lcan be learned from machines.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreHiddenMoves
lines.text: HIDDEN moves are those that are\nespecially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatMovesShouldIUse
lines.text: Select “FIGHT,” and the MENU of moves\nwill appear. Consider the type\lmatchups, and use the most effective\lmoves. You can check the effects of\lmoves by opening “POKéMON,”\lpicking a POKéMON, opening “SUMMARY,”\lthen opening “POKéMON SKILLS.”$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToAddMoreMoves
lines.text: The most a POKéMON can learn is four\nmoves. They are learned as the\lPOKéMON levels up. It can also be\ltaught a move using a TM (Technical\lMachine) or HM (Hidden Machine).\lThere are also people who teach moves.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToMakeMonStronger
lines.text: The key to making your POKéMON\nstrong is to battle and win often.\lThe EXP. (Experience) Points earned\lby winning battles accumulate to\llevel up POKéMON that participated in\lthem. Battle wild POKéMON often to\llevel up your party.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerFoeMonsTooStrong
lines.text: If your foes are too strong, try\nleveling up your POKéMON some more.\lGo back the way you came and battle\lwild POKéMON to level up your party.\lYou may also battle TRAINERS whom you\lhave not battled before.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoIDoInCave
lines.text: Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON\ncan appear anywhere in caves.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt in a cave,\lrush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items\lto heal them right away. It is very\ldangerous to force your luck in caves.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerNothingIWantToKnow
lines.text: Trust your own knowledge and power.\nBelieve in yourself and find your way!$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsPokemonCenter
lines.text: A POKéMON CENTER is identified by its\nred roof and a “P.C” sign. Every\lPOKéMON CENTER offers such services as\lfully healing POKéMON and free PC use,\lmaking it essential for your travels.\lOn the upper floor are facilities for\llinking with friends and others.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsPokemonMart
lines.text: A POKéMON MART is identified by its\nblue roof and a “MART” sign.\lItems can be bought and sold at any\lPOKéMON MART. Some MARTS carry items\lthat are available only in their towns.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToEndGame
lines.text: You can safely end your game by\nselecting “SAVE” on the MENU.\lOnce you have saved, the game can be\lsafely turned off. When the game is\lturned back on, you can resume from\lwhere you last saved.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsAMon
lines.text: POKéMON are living beings about which\nmany mysteries still remain. You may\lsee them in grass, the sea, and caves.\lThey appear to obey the wishes of the\lTRAINERS that caught them.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsThatPersonLike
lines.text: Use the FAME CHECKER among the\nKEY ITEMS in your BAG.\lIt may give you a hint, so try it out.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoesHiddenMoveDo
lines.text: A HIDDEN move is taught to a POKéMON\nusing an HM (Hidden Machine).\lA HIDDEN move is important for helping\lyour adventure. For example, one is\lused to light up dark caves. Another\lcuts down small trees. There is one\lfor traveling on water, and so on.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoIDoInSafari
lines.text: Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing\nthe special SAFARI BALLS.\lYou may keep any item you find, too.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreSafariRules
lines.text: Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have\ntraveled a certain distance or thrown\lall your SAFARI BALLS.\lOpen the MENU to check the remaining\lnumber of steps and SAFARI BALLS.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToEndSafari
lines.text: If you would like to cut your SAFARI\nGAME short, open the MENU and select\l“RETIRE” at the top of the list.$

lines.label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsAGym
lines.text: POKéMON GYMS are operated by the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE and are training\lfacilities for TRAINERS. They are all\lacross the land in cities and towns.\lEach one is headed by a LEADER, who\lis a very skilled TRAINER. Beat the\lLEADER to collect a BADGE.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokedex
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéDEX” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Choose POKéMON using commands such
   as “POKéMON LIST,”
   “HABITATS OF POKéMON,” and
   “SEARCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON to obtain detailed
   information.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokemon
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Choose a POKéMON in your party.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “SUMMARY,” “SWITCH,”
   or “ITEM.”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseSummary
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the information:
   “POKéMON INFO”
   “POKéMON SKILLS”
   “KNOWN MOVES”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseSwitch
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Choose the POKéMON you want to
   switch around.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “SWITCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select the POKéMON to switch with
   the first one.
The POKéMON at the left of the screen
will be the first one out in a battle.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseItem
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select whether you want to “GIVE”
   an item to the POKéMON to hold,
   or “TAKE” an item it is holding.
A POKéMON can hold no more than one
item!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseBag
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the data headings:
   “ITEMS”
   “KEY ITEMS”
   “POKé BALLS”
   Press up or down to select an item.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseAnItem
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select the “ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select an item.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected
   item.
Some items may not be used depending
on the place and/or situation.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseKeyItem
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select a key item.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected
   key item.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokeBall
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} While battling a wild POKéMON,
   select the BAG's “POKé BALLS”
   POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select a POKé BALL.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to throw the selected
   POKé BALL.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePlayer
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Your TRAINER CARD is displayed face
   up with basic information. Press the
   A Button to turn the CARD over.
{CIRCLE_3} A variety of data can be found on
   the reverse side of the CARD.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseSave
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SAVE” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “YES” and your progress is
   recorded in the save file.
Once the game is saved, you may turn
off the game. Your game can be resumed
from where you saved.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseOption
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “OPTION” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select an optional item, then
   press left or right to alter the
   settings.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “CANCEL” or press the
   B Button after making changes.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePotion
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad and select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select “POTION” in the “ITEMS”
   POCKET.
{CIRCLE_4} Select “USE.”
{CIRCLE_5} Select the POKéMON to be healed.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseTownMap
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad and select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} Press left or right to open the
   “KEY ITEMS” POCKET, then press
   up or down to select “TOWN MAP.” 
{CIRCLE_4} Select “USE” to open the TOWN MAP.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseTM
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE.
{CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” a TM.
{CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn the
   move in the TM.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseHM
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE.
{CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” an HM.
{CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn it.
HMs are hard to remove, so be careful!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseMoveOutsideOfBattle
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON that knows an
   HM move. The usable HM move(s)
   will be shown in blue. Select and
   use the desired move to destroy an
   obstacle, fly, surf, etc.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToRideBicycle
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. Open the
   “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the “BAG”
   and select the “BICYCLE.”
{CIRCLE_2} The BICYCLE can be ridden by
   selecting “USE.” You may also
   “REGISTER” it for instant use by
   pressing SELECT.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToEnterName
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Move the cursor to the letter you
   want with the {PLUS} Control Pad, then
   press the A Button to enter it.
{CIRCLE_2} Press the B Button to back up.
{CIRCLE_3} Press SELECT to switch between
   uppercase and lowercase letters.
{CIRCLE_4} Press the A Button on “OK.”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePC
lines.text: {CIRCLE_1} Go to any POKéMON CENTER, go up\n   to the PC, then press the A Button.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseBillsPC
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{STR_VAR_1}'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select from one of the top three
   MENU items to access the POKéMON
   Storage System.
If you catch a POKéMON when you have
six in your party, the POKéMON is sent
automatically to a BOX in the System!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseWithdraw
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX
   with the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “WITHDRAW” to remove the
   POKéMON from the BOX and add it to
   your party.
You may not withdraw a POKéMON if you
already have six POKéMON with you!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseDeposit
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in your party with
   the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select the BOX, then press the
   A Button to store the POKéMON.
If you have only one POKéMON with you,
it may not be stored!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseMove
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX.
{CIRCLE_2} Pick up the POKéMON by selecting
   “MOVE” and move it anywhere with
   the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} Move the POKéMON to the BOX name
   and press left or right to move it
   to another BOX.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToMoveItems
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Faintly shown POKéMON can be made
   to hold an item by selecting it and
   pressing the A Button.
{CIRCLE_2} Clearly shown POKéMON can be made
   to give the item they are holding to
   another POKéMON, or return the item
   to the BAG with the A Button.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePlayersPC
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'s PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or
   “MAILBOX.”
You may store things in your own PC
if your BAG is full. You may also
withdraw items stored in your PC.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseWithdrawItem
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn.
{CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and
   placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
   It may also be directly given to a
   POKéMON to hold.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseDepositItem
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be
   deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} If there is more than one 
   item to be deposited, enter the
   quantity with the {PLUS} Control Pad,
   then press the A Button.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseMailbox
lines.text:
When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON,
it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has
no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used.
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “MAILBOX” to read MAIL or
   make a POKéMON hold MAIL.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseProfOaksPC
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “PROF. OAK'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} PROF. OAK will evaluate your
   POKéDEX.
His evaluations should give you hints
for catching more POKéMON!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToOpenMenu
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Press START.
{CIRCLE_2} The MENU will open on the right.
{CIRCLE_3} Depending on the situation, the MENU
   may feature different headings.
The MENU will not open in certain
situations such as when talking, doing
something, battling, etc.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseFight
lines.text: {CIRCLE_1} Select “FIGHT.”\n{CIRCLE_2} Select one of the moves shown,\nand that move will be used!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokemon2
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the POKéMON in your party
   that you want to use.
{CIRCLE_3} If you have two or more POKéMON
   with you, they may be switched by
   selecting “SHIFT.” Check POKéMON
   data by selecting “SUMMARY.”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseShift
lines.text:
This command switches the POKéMON in
battle with another one in your party.
{CIRCLE_1} Select the POKéMON to be sent out.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “SHIFT.”
{CIRCLE_3} The selected POKéMON will switch
   places with the POKéMON in battle!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseSummary2
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the information:
   “POKéMON INFO”
   “POKéMON SKILLS”
   “KNOWN MOVES”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseBag2
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the data headings:
   “ITEMS”
   “KEY ITEMS”
   “POKé BALLS”
   Press up or down to select an item.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToReadPokedex
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} POKéMON that you have caught are
   identified by a POKé BALL mark on
   the POKéDEX list.
{CIRCLE_2} A caught POKéMON will provide a
   large amount of data.

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseHomePC
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Go up to the PC at home, then press
   the A Button.
{CIRCLE_2} The PC will turn on.
{CIRCLE_3} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or
   “MAILBOX.”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseItemStorage
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM” to withdraw
   an item stored on your PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM” to put 
   an item from your BAG into your PC.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseWithdrawItem2
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn.
{CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and
   placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
   It may also be directly given to a
   POKéMON to hold.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseDepositItem2
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be
   deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} If there is nothing in the BAG, this
   command can't be used!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseMailbox2
lines.text:
When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON,
it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has
no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used.
{CIRCLE_1} Select MAIL by name to read it or
   make a POKéMON hold it.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseRun
lines.text:
You may not “RUN” from a TRAINER
battle!
{CIRCLE_1} You may “RUN” from a wild POKéMON.
{CIRCLE_2} Your chance of escape is improved
   if your POKéMON in battle is fast.$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToRegisterKeyItem
lines.text:
You may “REGISTER” a key item for
instant use by pressing SELECT!
{CIRCLE_1} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Select the key item, then select
   “REGISTER.”$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseBall
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select to throw the special POKé
   BALL used only in the SAFARI ZONE.
When wild POKéMON appear, throw lots
of SAFARI BALLS to catch them!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseBait
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select to throw the special food
   used only in the SAFARI ZONE.
It is POKéMON food rolled up into
a ball for easy eating. When BAIT is
thrown, the wild POKéMON may get
attracted by it, and may not flee!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseRock
lines.text:
{CIRCLE_1} Select to throw a rock lying on
   the ground in the SAFARI ZONE.
Throwing a rock at a POKéMON may 
make it run away, but it becomes easier
to catch!$

lines.label: Help_Text_HowToUseHallOfFame
lines.text: {CIRCLE_1} Select “HALL OF FAME” on the PC.\n{CIRCLE_2} The POKéMON that have entered the\n   HALL OF FAME can be examined.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineHP
lines.text: HP indicates a POKéMON's vitality.\nIf a POKéMON's HP drops to zero, it\lfaints and is unable to battle.\lSo, the key in battle is to try to\lreduce the foe's HP to zero.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt, restore their\lHP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineEXP
lines.text: EXP. Points stands for “Experience\nPoints.” POKéMON gain EXP. Points by\lparticipating in winning battles.\lWhen a POKéMON accumulates sufficient\lEXP. Points, it levels up. The EXP. Bar\lindicates accumulated EXP. Points.\lIt returns to zero upon leveling up.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineMoves
lines.text: POKéMON may learn up to four different\nmoves. There are many kinds of moves\lincluding attacks and those with\lspecial effects. The kinds of moves\lthat can be learned vary for each\lPOKéMON. Some moves can be learned\lfrom items.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineAttack
lines.text: ATTACK indicates the power of an\noffensive move. The higher this stat,\lthe more powerful the move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND,\lFLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST,\land STEEL.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineDefense
lines.text: DEFENSE indicates the resistance a\nPOKéMON has against physical attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's physical hit.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineSpAtk
lines.text: SP. ATK (Special Attack) indicates the\npower of a special attack move.\lThe higher this stat, the more powerful\lthe special attack move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS,\lICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineSpDef
lines.text: SP. DEF (Special Defense) indicates\nthe resistance a POKéMON has against\lspecial attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's special attack.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineSpeed
lines.text: SPEED indicates the agility of a\nPOKéMON. If this stat exceeds the foe's\lin battle, the POKéMON can make a move\lbefore its slower opponent.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineLevel
lines.text: Lv. (Level) indicates the growth and\nstrength of a POKéMON.\lIn general, when a POKéMON levels up,\lits stats such as HP, ATTACK, and\lDEFENSE rise, making it stronger.\lPOKéMON may learn a new move upon\lleveling up.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineType
lines.text: POKéMON and moves are classified by\ntype. Every type has advantageous and\ldisadvantageous matchups against\lother types. For example, like a rock-\lpaper-scissors game, the WATER type is\lstrong against the FIRE type and weak\lagainst the GRASS type.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineOT
lines.text: OT stands for “Original TRAINER,”\nthe first TRAINER to have caught the\lselected POKéMON.\lEven if the POKéMON is traded, the OT\lname will remain unchanged.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineItem
lines.text: All POKéMON can be made to hold one\nitem each. Some items will be used by\lthe POKéMON automatically in certain\lsituations. To make a POKéMON hold an\litem, select the item from the BAG and\l“GIVE” it to the POKéMON.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineAbility
lines.text: All POKéMON have a special ABILITY.\nThere are many different kinds of these\labilities, some used in battle, some\lelsewhere. The abilities differ from\lspecies to species. Some species may\lhave more than one kind of ability.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineMoney
lines.text: Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineMoveType
lines.text: Moves are also classified by types.\nIf a POKéMON of a certain type uses\la move of the same type, the move's\lpower is boosted. If the move's type\lhas a matchup advantage against the\ltarget, its effectiveness is also\lboosted.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineNature
lines.text: All POKéMON have a personality,\nor “NATURE.” The POKéMON's\lnature appears to affect how the\lPOKéMON will grow upon leveling up.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineIDNo
lines.text: The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefinePP
lines.text: PP stands for “Power Points.”\nIt indicates the number of times a\lcertain move can be used in battle.\lLike HP, PP can be restored by visiting\la POKéMON CENTER or using certain\litems.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefinePower
lines.text: POWER indicates the strength of an\nattack. The higher this number, the\lgreater the damage that can be\linflicted on the foe!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineAccuracy
lines.text: ACCURACY indicates the probability of\nthe move hitting the foe.\lThe higher this number, the more likely\lthe move will strike the target.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineFNT
lines.text: FNT stands for “fainted.”\nA POKéMON faints if its HP is reduced\lto zero. It becomes incapable of taking\lpart in battle.\lRestore a fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON\lCENTER, or use an item.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineItems
lines.text: Ordinary items bought at any POKéMON\nMART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET.\lItems may be used, given to a POKéMON\lto hold, or tossed out as garbage.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineKeyItems
lines.text: Important items that you find or \nreceive from people are placed in the\lKEY ITEMS POCKET.\lKey items may be used, or registered\lfor use instantly with SELECT. Once\lregistered, the item can be used\lwithout opening the MENU and BAG.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefinePokeBalls
lines.text: POKé BALLS, which are used for\ncatching wild POKéMON, are placed in\lthe POKé BALLS POCKET.\lPOKé BALLS may be bought at POKéMON\lMARTS. They may be used, given to a\lPOKéMON to hold, or tossed out as\lgarbage.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefinePokedex
lines.text: This indicates the number of species of\nPOKéMON you have caught and/or\levolved to fill the POKéDEX.\lTry hard to catch all sorts of\lPOKéMON!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefinePlayTime
lines.text: This is the total amount of time that\nyou have played this game.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineBadges
lines.text: The POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES that you\nhave won are registered and shown.\lEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\lin various cities and towns.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineTextSpeed
lines.text: You can adjust how quickly the text is\ndisplayed. Choose one: SLOW, MID,\lor FAST.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineBattleScene
lines.text: You can choose to turn the battle\nanimation ON or OFF.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineBattleStyle
lines.text: You can choose whether or not a\nTRAINER can switch a POKéMON after\lit has made its foe faint.\lSet to “SHIFT” if you would like the\lchance to switch a POKéMON after it\lhas made its foe faint.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineSound
lines.text: You can choose between MONO and\nSTEREO sound output.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineButtonMode
lines.text: Set to “HELP” to display help messages\nby pressing the L or R Button.\lSet to “LR” to enable the switching\lof the POKéDEX pages and BAG POCKETS\lusing the L and R Buttons.\lSet to “L=A” to make the L Button\lwork the same as the A Button.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineFrame
lines.text: You may choose the design of the frame\naround certain menus. Try them out and\lsee what you like.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineCancel2
lines.text: The settings will be changed to the\nselections shown in red, and you will\lreturn to the MENU.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineTM
lines.text: A TM (Technical Machine) is a device\nused to teach a move to a POKéMON.\lThere are many different kinds.\lMoves can be taught only to those\lPOKéMON capable of using them.\lA TM breaks after a single use.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineHM
lines.text: An HM (Hidden Machine) is a device used\nto teach a HIDDEN move to a POKéMON.\lA HIDDEN move can be taught only to\lthose POKéMON capable of using it.\lUnlike a TM, an HM can be used over\land over. A HIDDEN move can be tough\lfor a POKéMON to forget.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineHMMove
lines.text: HIDDEN moves are those that are\nespecially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineEvolution
lines.text: Among POKéMON, there are some that\nundergo major changes (evolution) upon\lgrowing to certain levels. Evolution\lcauses a POKéMON to alter form, change\lits name, and perhaps change the moves\lit may learn. Some POKéMON evolve\ldue to reasons other than leveling up.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineStatusProblem
lines.text: Status problems include:\nSleep: Can't use moves.\lPoison: Causes steady HP loss.\lParalysis: May prevent moves.\lBurn: HP loss and lowers ATTACK.\lFreeze: Can't use moves.\lThese can be healed with items, etc.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefinePokemon
lines.text: POKéMON is a name given to describe\nwondrous creatures that inhabit all\lcorners of this world.\lPeople raise POKéMON to be their pets,\luse them for battling, and so on.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineIDNo2
lines.text: The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineMoney2
lines.text: Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DefineBadges2
lines.text: This indicates the number of POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES that you have won.\lEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\lin various cities and towns.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescTheHelpSystem
lines.text: The help messages change depending on\nhow much you have progressed in the\lgame. They are designed to support you\lwhen you need them. If there is\lanything that you don't understand,\lplease look up the HELP System!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescTheGame
lines.text: You become the main character to\nexplore the world of POKéMON!\lBy talking to people and solving\lmysteries, new paths will open to you.\lStrive for the goal together with your\lwonderful POKéMON!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescWirelessAdapter
lines.text:
This game communicates over a wireless
link using the Wireless Adapter.\pGo wireless anywhere, anytime, and
with anybody!\pTry playing with the Wireless Adapter
always attached!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals1
lines.text: Visit every city and town, travel every\nroad, explore every cave, and face\levery challenge as you strive to\lbecome the greatest TRAINER of\lPOKéMON!$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals2
lines.text: On your adventure, you will be faced\nwith many obstacles. Every obstacle\lcan be overcome by doing something\lor by solving mysteries. Some obstacles\lare affected by something that happens\lfar away.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals3
lines.text: Some of the obstacles in your way can\nbe removed once your POKéMON learn\lspecific moves.$

lines.label: Help_Text_DescWhatArePokemon
lines.text: POKéMON are wondrous creatures that\nare shrouded in mystery. You may meet\lthem all over the world…in tall\lgrass, caves, the sea, and more.\lThey appear to grow obedient to the\lTRAINERS that caught them.$

lines.label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page1
lines.text:
In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero.

Speak to people and check things
wherever you go, be it towns, roads,
or caves. Gather information and
hints from every source.$

lines.label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page2
lines.text:
New paths will open to you by helping
people in need, overcoming challenges,
and solving mysteries.

At times, you will be challenged by
others and attacked by wild creatures.
Be brave and keep pushing on.$

lines.label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page3
lines.text:
Through your adventure, we hope
that you will interact with all sorts
of people and achieve personal growth.
That is our biggest objective.

Press the A Button, and let your
adventure begin!$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld
lines.text: Hello, there!\nGlad to meet you!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople affectionately refer to me\nas the POKéMON PROFESSOR.\p$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_ThisWorld
lines.text: This world…$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide
lines.text: …is inhabited far and wide by\ncreatures called POKéMON.\p$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon
lines.text: For some people, POKéMON are pets.\nOthers use them for battling.\pAs for myself…\pI study POKéMON as a profession.\p$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_TellMeALittleAboutYourself
lines.text: But first, tell me a little about\nyourself.\p$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourNameWhatIsIt
lines.text: Let's begin with your name.\nWhat is it?\p$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_SoYourNameIsPlayer
lines.text: Right…\nSo your name is {PLAYER}.$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_WhatWasHisName
lines.text: This is my grandson.\pHe's been your rival since you both\nwere babies.\p…Erm, what was his name now?$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourRivalsNameWhatWasIt
lines.text: Your rival's name, what was it now?$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_ConfirmRivalName
lines.text: …Er, was it {RIVAL}?$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_RememberRivalsName
lines.text: That's right! I remember now!\nHis name is {RIVAL}!\p$

lines.label: gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo
lines.text: {PLAYER}!\pYour very own POKéMON legend is\nabout to unfold!\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_HowIsPokedexComingAlong
lines.text: OAK: Good to see you!\nHow is your POKéDEX coming along?\pHere, let me take a look.$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_SeenXOwnedY
lines.text: The amount of progress you've made\non your POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.\p{FONT_NORMAL}PROF. OAK's rating:$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan10
lines.text: You still have lots to do.\pGo into every patch of grass you\nsee and look for POKéMON!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20
lines.text: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30
lines.text: Your POKéDEX could use a bit more\nvolume still!\pTry to catch other species of\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40
lines.text: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50
lines.text: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60
lines.text: Ah, you've finally topped 50\nspecies!\pI've given one of my AIDES an EXP.\nSHARE. Be sure to go get it!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan70
lines.text: Hoho! This is turning into quite the\nrespectable POKéDEX!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan80
lines.text: Very good!\pI think you'll collect even more\nPOKéMON by going fishing!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan90
lines.text: Wonderful! Let me guess… You\nlike to collect things, don't you?$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan100
lines.text: I'm impressed!\nIt must have been difficult to do!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan110
lines.text: You've finally hit 100 species!\nI can't believe how good you are!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120
lines.text: You even have the evolved forms\nof POKéMON! Super!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan130
lines.text: Excellent! Trade with friends to\nget some more!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140
lines.text: Outstanding!\nYou've become a real pro at this!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan150
lines.text: I have nothing left to say!\nYou're the POKéMON PROFESSOR now!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_Complete
lines.text: Your POKéDEX is entirely complete!\nCongratulations!!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_NationalDexSeenXOwnedY
lines.text: And your NATIONAL POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LookForwardToFilledNationalDex
lines.text: I'll be looking forward to seeing\nyou fill the NATIONAL POKéDEX!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_YouveCompletedDex
lines.text: Finally…\pYou've finally completed the\nPOKéDEX!\pIt's magnificent!\nTruly, this is a fantastic feat!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_Wroooaaarrr
lines.text: Wroooooooaaaaaarrrr!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_HaHa
lines.text: はあ はあ‥$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_ThankYouMadeDreamReality
lines.text: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nSincerely, thank you!\lYou've made my dream a reality!$

lines.label: PokedexRating_Text_LoveSeeingYourPokedex
lines.text: OAK: Ah, welcome!\pTell me, how is your POKéDEX\ncoming along?\pWahaha!\pActually, I know how it is, but I\nlove seeing it anyway!\pLet's see…$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_SpeedierBattlerGoesFirst
lines.text: POKé DUDE: The speedier of the\nbattlers gets to attack first.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_MyRattataFasterThanPidgey
lines.text: It looks like my RATTATA was\nfaster than the PIDGEY.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_BattlersTakeTurnsAttacking
lines.text: The battlers take turns attacking\nand reducing each other's HP.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_MyRattataWonGetsEXP
lines.text:
My RATTATA reduced the foe's HP
to zero, so it wins!\pThe POKéMON that took part in the
battle get EXP. Points.\pWhen a POKéMON collects enough
EXP. Points, it levels up.\pLeveling up makes your POKéMON
stronger than before.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_UhOhRattataPoisoned
lines.text: POKé DUDE: Uh-oh…\nMy RATTATA has been poisoned…\pIf a POKéMON is poisoned, it loses\nHP steadily.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_HealStatusRightAway
lines.text: If a POKéMON develops a status\nproblem, heal it right away.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_UsingItemTakesTurn
lines.text: Using an item on a POKéMON uses\nup one turn, though.\pNow, it's the opponent's turn!$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_YayWeManagedToWin
lines.text: Yay!\nWe managed to win!$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_WaterNotVeryEffectiveAgainstGrass
lines.text:
POKé DUDE: The move BUBBLE is
a WATER-type attack.\pThe targeted ODDISH is a
GRASS/POISON-type POKéMON.\pThe WATER-type attack is absorbed
by the GRASS-type POKéMON…\pAs a result, the move becomes not
very effective, and inflicts only\lhalf the usual damage.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_GrassEffectiveAgainstWater
lines.text: Uh-oh, this is not good!\pThe ABSORB attack you just saw\nis a GRASS-type move.\pPOLIWAG is a WATER-type POKéMON.\pSo, ABSORB becomes super\neffective, doubling the damage.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_LetsTryShiftingMons
lines.text: It's not going to be easy to win\nwith this matchup…\pLet's try shifting POKéMON!$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_ShiftingUsesTurn
lines.text: Shifting POKéMON in and out uses\nup one turn.\pNow, it's the opponent's turn.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_ButterfreeDoubleResistsGrass
lines.text:
BUTTERFREE is a BUG/FLYING-type
POKéMON.\pAgainst this POKéMON, a GRASS-
type attack…\p…inflicts only half the usual
damage on a BUG-type POKéMON…\p…And, it also causes only half the
damage on a FLYING-type POKéMON.\pTherefore, BUTTERFREE, being a
BUG/FLYING POKéMON, only takes\lone quarter of the usual damage.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_ButterfreeGoodAgainstOddish
lines.text:
ODDISH is a GRASS/POISON-type
POKéMON.\pA FLYING- or PSYCHIC-type attack
is super effective against it.\pOne of those types of attacks will
inflict double the usual damage.\pOkay, here we go!$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_YeahWeWon
lines.text: Yeah!\nWe won!$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_WeakenMonBeforeCatching
lines.text: POKé DUDE: When you're trying to\ncatch a POKéMON, don't throw any\lPOKé BALLS right away.\pFirst, you need to weaken it by\nreducing its HP.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_BestIfTargetStatused
lines.text: Okay, that should be good enough.\pBut, if it's possible, it would be\nbest if the target has a status\lproblem.\pFor instance, it would be easier\nto catch if it were asleep or\lparalyzed.$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_CantDoubleUpOnStatus
lines.text:
This will make the POKéMON a lot
easier to catch!\pOh, yes. If you paralyze a
POKéMON, you can't make it fall\lasleep on top of paralysis.\pIn other words, you can't double
up status problems, okay?$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_LetMeThrowBall
lines.text: Okay!\nLet me throw my POKé BALL!$

lines.label: Pokedude_Text_PickBestKindOfBall
lines.text: Before you throw a POKé BALL,\nconsider the condition and the\ltype of POKéMON, and pick the kind\lof BALL that would work best.$

lines.label: Text_MayIHelpYou
lines.text: Hi, there!\nMay I help you?$

lines.label: Text_FillOutQuestionnaire
lines.text: There is a questionnaire.\nWould you like to fill it out?$

lines.label: Text_QuestionnaireThankYou
lines.text: Thank you for taking the time to\nfill out our questionnaire.\pYour feedback will be used for\nfuture reference.$

lines.label: Text_YouKnowThoseWords
lines.text:
Oh, hello!
You know those words?\pThat means you must know about
the MYSTERY GIFT.\pFrom now on, you should be
receiving MYSTERY GIFTS!$

lines.label: Text_YouCanAccessMysteryGift
lines.text: Once you save your game, you can\naccess the MYSTERY GIFT.$

lines.label: Text_ThankYouForAccessingMysteryGift
lines.text: Thank you for accessing the\nMYSTERY GIFT System.$

lines.label: Text_OnlySkilledTrainersAllowedThrough
lines.text: Only truly skilled TRAINERS are\nallowed through.\pYou don't have the {STR_VAR_1}\nyet!$

lines.label: Text_CantLetYouPass
lines.text: Rules are rules.\nI can't let you pass.$

lines.label: Text_OhThatsBadgeGoRightAhead
lines.text: Oh! That is the {STR_VAR_1}!\nGo right ahead.$

lines.label: Text_OnlyPassWithBadgeDontHaveYet
lines.text:
You can pass here only if you have
the {STR_VAR_1}.\pYou don't have the {STR_VAR_1}
yet.\pYou have to have it to get to
the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_WouldYouLikeToExit
lines.text: Would you like to exit the SAFARI\nZONE right now?$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_TimesUp
lines.text: PA: Ding-dong!\pTime's up!\pPA: Your SAFARI GAME is over!$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_OutOfBalls
lines.text: PA: Ding-dong!\pYou are out of SAFARI BALLS!\pPA: Your SAFARI GAME is over!$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
lines.text:
サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\pここでは　ホウエンでは　なかなか
みることの　できない　ポケモンを\pしぜんの　すがたの　まま
めに　することが　できます\pまた　ポケモントレーナーの
ようぼうに　おこたえ　して\pポケモンを
つかまえる　ことも　できます！\pサファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_WelcomeFirstTime
lines.text: サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\nサファリゾーンは　はじめて　ですか？$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_ComeInAndEnjoy
lines.text: サファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_FirstTimeInfo
lines.text: サファリゾーンでは\n30この　サファリボールを　つかって\lポケモンを　つかまえる　ことが　できます\pサファリボールを　つかいきるか\n500ぽ　あるくと\pゲームは　しゅうりょう　です\pサファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
lines.text: サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\p500えんで　ポケモン　つかまえほうだい！\nサファリゲームに　さんか　しますか？$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_PlayAnotherTime
lines.text: そうですか\nこんど　ぜひ　さんか　してください！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_NotEnoughMoney
lines.text: おかねが　たりませんよ！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_ThatWillBe500Please
lines.text: それでは　500えん　いただきます$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_HereAreYourSafariBalls
lines.text: では　サファリボールを　どうぞ！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_Received30SafariBalls
lines.text: {PLAYER}は　サファリボールを\n30こ　うけとった！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
lines.text: じかんに　なりましたら\nこちらから　おしらせ　しますので\pぞんぶんに　おたのしみ　ください！\nでは　いってらっしゃい！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_ExcuseMeYourPCBoxIsFull
lines.text: Excuse me!\nYour PC BOX is full.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
lines.text:
あ！　おきゃくさん
ポロックケースを　おもちで　ないですね？\pサファリゾーンは　ポロックを　つかうと
より　おたのしみ　いただけますので\pぜひ　ポロックケースを
おもちに　なって　おこし　ください！$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
lines.text: まだ　じかんが　のこっていますが\nサファリゾーンを　やめますか？$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
lines.text: では　ひきつづき　おたのしみ　ください！$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
lines.text: わかりました\pそれでは　のこりの　サファリボールを\nおあずかり　します\pおつかれさまでした\nまた　ごりよう　ください$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
lines.text: それでは　いってらっしゃい！\lなにか　ありましたら\nわたしに　こえを　かけて　くださいね$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
lines.text: しってた？\pあの　しかくい　はこに　ポロックを　おくと\nポケモンが　あつまって　くるんだよ！$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
lines.text: この　さきに　いきたい　けど\nじてんしゃ　もって　くるの　わすれた‥‥\pおくに　めずらしい　ポケモンが\nいそうな　きが　するのに！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
lines.text: ポケモンに　ポロックを　なげても\nしらんぷり　される　ときが　あるのよ\pポケモンにも　すききらいが　あるのかしら？$

lines.label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
lines.text: ぜぇ‥‥　ぜぇ‥‥\nやっと　ここまで　きたけど‥‥\pつかれちゃって　ポケモン　つかまえる\nげんきも　のこって　ないよ‥‥$

lines.label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
lines.text: ホウエンに　いない　みずポケモンを\nさがしに　きたんだけど‥‥\pみずうみは　どこにあるのか\nきみ　しってるかい？$

lines.label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
lines.text: ここで　めずらしい　ポケモンを\nたくさん　つかまえて\lともだちと　こうかん　するんだ！$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
lines.text: ポロックおきばに　おいた　ポロックが\nいつのまにか　なくなっていた‥‥\pしらない　うちに\nポケモンが　たべちゃったのかな？$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
lines.text: サファリゾーンの　おとくな　じょうほう！\pであった　ポケモンに\nポロックを　なげると　にげにくく　なります！$

lines.label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
lines.text: あるき　つかれたら　ちょっと　ひといき！\n‘みんなの　きゅうけいじょ'$

lines.label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
lines.text: おれ　ポロック　もってないけど\nポケモン　たくさん　つかまえたよ\pちかづいて　ボールを　なげる　だけで\nけっこう　つかまえられる　もんだよ！$

lines.label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
lines.text: ポロックを　つかうと　いつもより\nちょっぴり　にげにくく　なるみたい\pだから　にげにくい　ポケモンに　つかっても\nあんまり　いみが　ないかもね$

lines.label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
lines.text: ポロックおきばに　ポロック　おいて\nポケモンを　つかまえると\pおなじ　ような　せいかくの　ポケモンが\nあつまる　きが　するなあ$

and overwrite the other save file?$
