lines.label: Route3_Text_ColtonRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_BenRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi! I like shorts!\nThey're comfy and easy to wear!\pYou should be wearing shorts, too!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JaniceRematchIntro
lines.text: Excuse me!\nYou keep looking at me, don't you?$

lines.label: Route3_Text_GregRematchIntro
lines.text: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\nLet's get with it right away!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_SallyRematchIntro
lines.text: That look you give me…\nIt intrigues me so!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey! What's wrong with you?\nYou're still not wearing shorts!$

lines.label: Route3_Text_JamesRematchIntro
lines.text: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI started raising.$

lines.label: Route3_Text_RobinRematchIntro
lines.text: Eek!\nDid you push me?$

lines.label: Route4_Text_CrissyRematchIntro
lines.text: I always catch mushroom POKéMON\non MT. MOON.$

lines.label: Route6_Text_RickyRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh! You're that nosy kid who\neavesdropped on us!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_NancyRematchIntro
lines.text: Excuse me! Didn't I tell you that\nthis is a private conversation?\pYou shouldn't be listening in,\nyou uncouth person!$

lines.label: Route6_Text_KeigoRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm trying to find something good\nthat's not a BUG POKéMON, but…$

lines.label: Route6_Text_JeffRematchIntro
lines.text: Huh?\nYou want to go with me again?$

lines.label: Route6_Text_IsabelleRematchIntro
lines.text: Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play this once.$

lines.label: Route6_Text_ElijahRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey, long time!\nHave you gotten better?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_AidanRematchIntro
lines.text: You are good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_StanRematchIntro
lines.text: All right!\nLet's play another game!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_GlennRematchIntro
lines.text: You need strategy to win at\nbattling.\pAre you following my advice?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_PaigeRematchIntro
lines.text: I've collected many NIDORAN.\nI don't want them to evolve, but…$

lines.label: Route8_Text_LeslieRematchIntro
lines.text: School is fun, but I still think\nPOKéMON are fun, too.$

lines.label: Route8_Text_AndreaRematchIntro
lines.text: MEOWTH and PERSIAN are so cute,\nmeow, meow, meow!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_MeganRematchIntro
lines.text: We may look silly standing here\nlike this, but I can still battle.$

lines.label: Route8_Text_RichRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm a rambling, gaming dude!\nI'm on a winning streak!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_JuliaRematchIntro
lines.text: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?\pYou already know, don't you?$

lines.label: Route8_Text_RicardoRematchIntro
lines.text: My bike's still acting up, man.$

lines.label: Route8_Text_JarenRematchIntro
lines.text: Okay, kid!\nDon't expect mercy this time!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_EliRematchIntro
lines.text: ELI: Our twin power became even\nbetter!$

lines.label: Route8_Text_AnneRematchIntro
lines.text: ANNE: Our twin power powered up!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_AliciaRematchIntro
lines.text: We're to battle again?\nThis time, you're mine!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_ChrisRematchIntro
lines.text: I haven't forgotten you were with\nthose good-looking POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route9_Text_DrewRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm taking ROCK TUNNEL to go to\nLAVENDER…\pBut I keep getting stopped by\neveryone along the way…$

lines.label: Route9_Text_CaitlinRematchIntro
lines.text: Don't you dare patronize me today!\nWe're playing for keeps!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_JeremyRematchIntro
lines.text: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored again, eh!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_BriceRematchIntro
lines.text: Hahaha!\nA little toughie, as always!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_BrentRematchIntro
lines.text: I got up early every day to train\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_AlanRematchIntro
lines.text: Hahahaha!\nI'll win this time!$

lines.label: Route9_Text_ConnerRematchIntro
lines.text: Go win, my super BUG POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_MarkRematchIntro
lines.text: Wow, you came here again?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?$

lines.label: Route10_Text_ClarkRematchIntro
lines.text: Ha-hahah-ah-ha!\nI can't stop sneezing!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HermanRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi, kid!\nDid I show you my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route10_Text_HeidiRematchIntro
lines.text: I went out to a POKéMON GYM again.\p…But I lost as usual.$

lines.label: Route10_Text_TrentRematchIntro
lines.text: Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!\lIt's so good, I can't leave!$

lines.label: Route10_Text_CarolRematchIntro
lines.text: My head is starting to spin.\nI've been hiking for too long…$

lines.label: Route11_Text_HugoRematchIntro
lines.text: Win, lose, or draw!\nNow for our rematch!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_JasperRematchIntro
lines.text: Competing is the ultimate thrill.\nI still can't get enough!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_EddieRematchIntro
lines.text: You know, right?\nLet's go, but don't cheat!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BraxtonRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi, there!\pBut be careful!\nI'm still laying down some cables!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DillonRematchIntro
lines.text: I became a TRAINER a while ago.\nBut, I think I can win.$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DirkRematchIntro
lines.text: Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!\p…And if I did, I've forgotten all\nabout it!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DarianRematchIntro
lines.text: I have never won before…\pPerhaps I am destined to remain\nthat way…$

lines.label: Route11_Text_YasuRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning and night!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_BernieRematchIntro
lines.text: Keep your eyes out for live wires!$

lines.label: Route11_Text_DaveRematchIntro
lines.text: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now.\lThis time, they should win, too.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_NedRematchIntro
lines.text: Yeah!\nI got a bite, here!\lTh-this might be the real thing!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ChipRematchIntro
lines.text: You're finally here.\nFishing is a waiting game.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JustinRematchIntro
lines.text: Still can't find a MOON STONE…\nHave you found one?$

lines.label: Route12_Text_LucaRematchIntro
lines.text: Electricity has always been my\nspecialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_HankRematchIntro
lines.text: The FISHING FOOL vs. POKéMON KID!\nAnother round, fight!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
lines.text: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\nBut, I wish I had more work…\l…It's hard to give up fishing!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_AndrewRematchIntro
lines.text: What's catching?\pYou'll never know unless you beat\nme!$

lines.label: Route12_Text_JesRematchIntro
lines.text: JES: I'll win here today and\npropose to my GIA.$

lines.label: Route12_Text_GiaRematchIntro
lines.text: GIA: Hey, JES…\nI've been waiting a long time now.\pIf we win today, I'll marry you!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SebastianRematchIntro
lines.text: My bird POKéMON remember you!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SusieRematchIntro
lines.text: I want to be the best TRAINER \nwhile I'm a kid!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
lines.text: Wow!\nYou got more cool BADGES!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_GwenRematchIntro
lines.text: My cutely grown POKéMON wish to\nbecome reacquainted with you.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_AlmaRematchIntro
lines.text: I cleaned out my savings and\nbought more CARBOS.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_PerryRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm not going to lose this time.\nThe wind's blowing my way!$

lines.label: Route13_Text_LolaRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, you're back?\pSure, I'll play again with you,\nsweetie.$

lines.label: Route13_Text_SheilaRematchIntro
lines.text: Can't you forget that you battled\nwith me?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_JaredRematchIntro
lines.text: What're you starin' at?$

lines.label: Route13_Text_RobertRematchIntro
lines.text: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
lines.text: I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MitchRematchIntro
lines.text: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle this time.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BeckRematchIntro
lines.text: Are you using TMs on POKéMON?\nJust holding them is useless.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MarlonRematchIntro
lines.text: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky! Give it a try.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_DonaldRematchIntro
lines.text: The legend of the winged mirages…\nYou've heard it, right?$

lines.label: Route14_Text_BennyRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm really not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_LukasRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey!\nI remember you!\pC'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
lines.text: You're here again, huh?\nShut up and battle.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro
lines.text: We've been riding here because of\nthe wide-open spaces.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_MalikRematchIntro
lines.text: POKéMON battle, right?\nCool! Rumble!$

lines.label: Route14_Text_KiriRematchIntro
lines.text: KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.$

lines.label: Route14_Text_JanRematchIntro
lines.text: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nLet's win for sure this time!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm going to keep battling with the\nPOKéMON I got in trades.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_BeckyRematchIntro
lines.text: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it one more go!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
lines.text: When I whistle, bird POKéMON\ngather around.\pThey're amazingly cute!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ChesterRematchIntro
lines.text: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nWait, aren't you that TRAINER…$

lines.label: Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!\lI remember you now!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_OliviaRematchIntro
lines.text: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.\pThat hasn't changed.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI got these off some loser!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro
lines.text: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

lines.label: Route15_Text_CeliaRematchIntro
lines.text: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON, of course.$

lines.label: Route15_Text_YazminRematchIntro
lines.text: Want to play with my POKéMON\nagain?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro
lines.text: MYA: Hi, we keep meeting,\ndon't we?\pHelp me train my little brother\nagain?$

lines.label: Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro
lines.text: RON: My sister's gotten more\npowerful…$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LaoRematchIntro
lines.text: What do you want?$

lines.label: Route16_Text_KojiRematchIntro
lines.text: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over quick!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LukeRematchIntro
lines.text: Come out and play, little mouse.\nI'll treat you right!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_HideoRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey, wait a second!\nDon't call me and then run away!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_CamronRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI really need a punching bag!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_RubenRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey, there!\nWe'll have ourselves a good time!$

lines.label: Route16_Text_JedRematchIntro
lines.text: JED: Are you here to see our\nlove, which knows no bounds?$

lines.label: Route16_Text_LeaRematchIntro
lines.text: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_RaulRematchIntro
lines.text: I told you, there's no getting rich\nquick in battling kids.$

lines.label: Route17_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_VirgilRematchIntro
lines.text: You out for a stroll?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_BillyRematchIntro
lines.text: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_NikolasRematchIntro
lines.text: VOLTORB's going to seriously\nelectrify you today!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_ZeekRematchIntro
lines.text: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nabsolutely won't evolve. Why?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JamalRematchIntro
lines.text: Gaah! I really need to exercise\nand seriously trim some flab!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_CoreyRematchIntro
lines.text: Be a rebel!$

lines.label: Route17_Text_JaxonRematchIntro
lines.text: Yep, that's a nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?$

lines.label: Route17_Text_WilliamRematchIntro
lines.text: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!$

lines.label: Route18_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
lines.text: I've been checking every grassy\narea for new POKéMON.\pBut it's not always easy…$

lines.label: Route18_Text_RamiroRematchIntro
lines.text: Koorukukukoo!\nIs my birdcall getting better?$

lines.label: Route18_Text_JacobRematchIntro
lines.text: I warned you before, this is my\nturf!\pI don't want you coming around.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm almost warmed up to go\nout for a swim.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ReeceRematchIntro
lines.text: Wait! Slow down!\nWhat if you have a heart attack?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro
lines.text: I love swimming!\nI guess you're the surfing type.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DouglasRematchIntro
lines.text: What's beyond the horizon?\nHave you seen?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_DavidRematchIntro
lines.text: I tried diving for POKéMON again,\nbut it was a no-go like before.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_TonyRematchIntro
lines.text: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.\p…Like losing to you the last time!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AnyaRematchIntro
lines.text: You always get to ride your\nPOKéMON…\pIt looks so relaxing.\nCan I have it if I win?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AliceRematchIntro
lines.text: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_AxleRematchIntro
lines.text: These waters are treacherous!\nYou shouldn't come back here!$

lines.label: Route19_Text_ConnieRematchIntro
lines.text: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…\lMust we really battle again?$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LiaRematchIntro
lines.text: LIA: You know my brother just\nbecame a TRAINER, right?\pI want to make him better, so I\nneed your help again.$

lines.label: Route19_Text_LucRematchIntro
lines.text: LUC: My big sis taught me all\nabout POKéMON.\pI wonder if I'm better?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_BarryRematchIntro
lines.text: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_ShirleyRematchIntro
lines.text: Are you jealous that I'm\nvacationing on SEAFOAM?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_TiffanyRematchIntro
lines.text: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_IreneRematchIntro
lines.text: Were you on vacation, too?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DeanRematchIntro
lines.text: Check out my physique!\pIt's even more buff than ever\nbefore!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_DarrinRematchIntro
lines.text: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nHaven't you learned to swim yet?$

lines.label: Route20_Text_RogerRematchIntro
lines.text: I rode my bird POKéMON here.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_NoraRematchIntro
lines.text: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.\nAnd, they've grown bigger!$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MissyRematchIntro
lines.text: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, like I said.$

lines.label: Route20_Text_MelissaRematchIntro
lines.text: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldRematchIntro
lines.text: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_WadeRematchIntro
lines.text: I got a big haul again!\nWanna go for it once more?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerRematchIntro
lines.text: The sea cleanses my body and soul!$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallRematchIntro
lines.text: きょうも　およぎに\nきちまったぜ$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JackRematchIntro
lines.text: I caught my POKéMON at sea.\nAnd that's where I train them.$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeRematchIntro
lines.text: Right now, I'm in another triathlon\nmeet!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_RolandRematchIntro
lines.text: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeRematchIntro
lines.text: Hey, cut it out already.\nYou always scare away the fish!$

lines.label: Route21_South_Text_NolanRematchIntro
lines.text: Keep me company till I get a hit.$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_LilRematchIntro
lines.text: LIL: Huh? A battle again?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?$

lines.label: Route21_North_Text_IanRematchIntro
lines.text: IAN: My sis is still a slob.\nHelp me get her into shape!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
lines.text: I won't lose while I'm here!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_DanRematchIntro
lines.text: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FlintRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!\pI'll show her how cool I am for\nsure this time!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_KelseyRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!\lMy conditioning's good today!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_ChadRematchIntro
lines.text: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you again!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
lines.text: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_FranklinRematchIntro
lines.text: I just trained up on MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

lines.label: Route25_Text_NobRematchIntro
lines.text: A POKéMANIAC lives on the cape.\nHave you seen his collection?$

lines.label: Route25_Text_WayneRematchIntro
lines.text: You're going to see BILL again?\nFirst, we battle!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ShaneRematchIntro
lines.text: I saw your feat from the grass!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_EthanRematchIntro
lines.text: Okay!\nI'll stomp you!$

lines.label: Route24_Text_ReliRematchIntro
lines.text: You always look so busy…\nAren't you getting tired?$

lines.label: Route24_Text_TimmyRematchIntro
lines.text: You really must love coming to\nNUGGET BRIDGE.$

lines.label: Route24_Text_AliRematchIntro
lines.text: The time we battled…\pEven though I was the second in\nline, I was the best, wasn't I?$

lines.label: Route24_Text_CaleRematchIntro
lines.text:
People call this the NUGGET
BRIDGE!\pYou've already beaten us, so you're
not allowed to take the challenge…\p…But, you're welcome to battle with
us again.$

lines.label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraRematchIntro
lines.text: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nI don't notice time slipping by…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaRematchIntro
lines.text: The weather's gorgeous!\nI'll try not to spoil it.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
lines.text: My sunburn is starting to hurt…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnRematchIntro
lines.text: The fire bird's mountain casts\na huge shadow…$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettRematchIntro
lines.text: I have this strong feeling that\nI can win this time!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyRematchIntro
lines.text: Wait! Wait a second!\nI'm sure I've hooked a big one!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonRematchIntro
lines.text: You'll help me out with my\ntraining again?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaRematchIntro
lines.text: We haven't missed a single day of\ntraining yet!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaRematchIntro
lines.text: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island…\lThree times!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughRematchIntro
lines.text: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit, I said!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceRematchIntro
lines.text: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireRematchIntro
lines.text: I ate too much again, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaRematchIntro
lines.text: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!\pWe won't lose this time!$

lines.label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikRematchIntro
lines.text: MIK: Together with KIA, we're\nafraid of nothing!\pWe'll prove it to you this time!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiRematchIntro
lines.text: Are we to battle again?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletRematchIntro
lines.text: From where have you come, and\nwhere are you bound?$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraRematchIntro
lines.text: I want to swim without my float\nring soon.$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisRematchIntro
lines.text: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, no, didn't I tell you already?\nPlease, stay away from me!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyRematchIntro
lines.text: JOY: We've gotten stronger!\nLots and lots!$

lines.label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegRematchIntro
lines.text: MEG: You can't beat us today!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, hello!\pAre you raising your POKéMON in a\ngood environment?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyRematchIntro
lines.text: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory today.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaRematchIntro
lines.text: Must I repeat myself?\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaRematchIntro
lines.text: I haven't made any progress…\nI still can't get the right angle…$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, you will give me another\nopportunity to match wits with you?$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianRematchIntro
lines.text: They're almost finished making the\npool for my POKéMON.\pYou must drop in for a visit.$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm a good runner.\nI've gotten even faster!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyRematchIntro
lines.text: I say, friend!\nLet us enjoy our time together!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS. Remember me?\pThat's right, I'm the one who loves\nbirds for their beaks!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI'm the one that loves wings.\nLet's battle again!$

lines.label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI love birds for their down.\nI didn't think I'd see you again!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm still having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoRematchIntro
lines.text: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLAND's port\nin one go again.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleRematchIntro
lines.text: You always come along while I'm\nswimming.$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaRematchIntro
lines.text: AVA: Let's have another\ntwo-on-two marine battle today!$

lines.label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebRematchIntro
lines.text: GEB: My big sister and I are way\ntougher than before!$

lines.label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynRematchIntro
lines.text: …Huh?\pI envision my house, but TELEPORT\nalways brings me here!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, hello.\nA pleasant breeze is blowing again.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardRematchIntro
lines.text: Hehehe, I'm practicing in secret\nagain.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirRematchIntro
lines.text: What, you're sick of seeing\nSWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!\nBattle with me again.$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseRematchIntro
lines.text: Sigh…\nMy boyfriend's busy again…$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlRematchIntro
lines.text: Come on, tell me, where are the\nmountains around these parts?$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuRematchIntro
lines.text: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play again!$

lines.label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaRematchIntro
lines.text: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle again!$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyRematchIntro
lines.text: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi, didn't we meet before?\nWhat compelled you to come back?$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryRematchIntro
lines.text: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pHave you discovered anything since\nwe last met?$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylRematchIntro
lines.text: A rematch with you, so high up!$

lines.label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioRematchIntro
lines.text: I sensed your approach.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteRematchIntro
lines.text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahRematchIntro
lines.text: Kyahaha!\pComing back won't change a thing.\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonRematchIntro
lines.text: Howdy! You're a member of my\nfan club, isn't that right?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
lines.text: This island is too spread out…\nPatrolling the place is a drag…$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
lines.text: I don't forgive people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveRematchIntro
lines.text: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together again.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonRematchIntro
lines.text: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose, not ever.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
lines.text: Let's have another battle.\nMy conditioning's in top form!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanRematchIntro
lines.text: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
lines.text: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
lines.text: Every time we meet, you have those\nsnazzy shoes on.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyRematchIntro
lines.text: You must have gotten tougher.\nLet me battle you, please!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleRematchIntro
lines.text: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI won't lose this time.\nAbsolutely not!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexRematchIntro
lines.text: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe will win for certain!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaRematchIntro
lines.text: NYA: I won't drag down my mentor\nLEX! We're going to win!$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonRematchIntro
lines.text: Have you discovered anything about\nthis stone chamber?$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
lines.text: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaRematchIntro
lines.text: My teacher is showing me how to\npaint some more.$

lines.label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordRematchIntro
lines.text: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber again.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_TryPokemonPrinter
lines.text: It's a POKéMON PRINTER!\pIt can put a print of your POKéMON\non the back of your TRAINER CARD.\pIt costs only ¥50.\nWould you like to try it?$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
lines.text: You don't have enough money.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ChoosePrintType
lines.text: Please choose the print type.$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_BigSmileForPhoto
lines.text: A big smile for the photo, please!\nThree… Two… One…\pFlash!$

lines.label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_PrintIsReadyCheckTrainerCard
lines.text: Your POKéMON print is ready!\nCheck your TRAINER CARD.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WishICouldShowOffStickers
lines.text: Giggle…\nI collected a ton of STICKERS.\lI wish I could show them off…$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_GiveYouStickerIfYouBrag
lines.text:
Oh, excellent!
You've come to the right place!\pLook, look! See? See?
These are my STICKERS!\lLook how many I got!\pI bet you want some.
I bet you do!\pI'll give a STICKER if you can tell
me something awesome about\lyourself.\pWhat will you brag about?$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutSomethingForMe
lines.text: Brag about something for me.\nI'll give you a STICKER.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutWhatToday
lines.text: Oh, hi!\nHere comes the braggart.\pWhat are you going to brag about\ntoday?$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLowest
lines.text: Oh, wow, you made it into the\nHALL OF FAME.\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLow
lines.text: Oh, wow, you've entered the\nHALL OF FAME often!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHigh
lines.text: Whoa! You've made it into the\nHALL OF FAME that often?\lThat's seriously incredible, yup!\pYou own the POKéMON LEAGUE!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHighest
lines.text: No way! You've gone into the\nHALL OF FAME that many times?\pYou're beyond incredible, yup!\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_HoFStickerApplied
lines.text: The HALL OF FAME STICKER was\napplied to the TRAINER CARD.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryHoF
lines.text: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendHoF
lines.text: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLowest
lines.text: Oh, wow, there are POKéMON EGGS?\nI didn't know that!\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLow
lines.text: You've hatched that many EGGS?\nYou really must like them!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHigh
lines.text: Whoa! You've hatched a whole\nbunch of EGGS!\pYou're an EGG-hatching machine!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHighest
lines.text: Wh… You hatched that many EGGS?\pWhat's behind your love of EGGS?\nIt's beyond incredible, yup!\pYou're too awesome, I tell you.\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_EggStickerApplied
lines.text: The EGG STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryEggs
lines.text: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendEggs
lines.text: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLowest
lines.text: Oh, wow, you've had success\nlink battling?\pYou're pretty strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLow
lines.text: You've beaten your friends a lot\nlink battling, huh?\pYou're impressively strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHigh
lines.text: Whoa! You've beaten your friends\na frightful number of times.\pHave you lost friends over this?\nI'll give you one of these.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHighest
lines.text:
Wh… Wickedly whoa!
You've won mind-blowingly often!\pIt just knocks me out thinking
about how tough you are.\pYou're the stuff of nightmares!
That's it, I have to give you this.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_VictoryStickerApplied
lines.text: The VICTORY STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryLinkWins
lines.text: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

lines.label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendLinkWins
lines.text: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

lines.label: Text_FirstShouldRestoreMonsHealth
lines.text: First, you should restore your\nPOKéMON to full health.$

lines.label: Text_MonsHealedShouldBuyPotions
lines.text:
Your POKéMON have been healed
to perfect health.\pIf your POKéMON's energy, HP,
is down, please come see us.\pIf you're planning to go far in the
field, you should buy some POTIONS\lat the POKéMON MART.\pWe hope you excel!$

lines.label: Text_MonsHealed
lines.text: Your POKéMON have been healed\nto perfect health.\pWe hope you excel!$

lines.label: Text_HadQuiteAnExperienceTakeRest
lines.text:
MOM: {PLAYER}!
Welcome home.\pIt sounds like you had quite
an experience.\pMaybe you should take a quick
rest.$

lines.label: Text_MomExplainHPGetPotions
lines.text:
MOM: Oh, good! You and your
POKéMON are looking great.\pI just heard from PROF. OAK.\pHe said that POKéMON's energy is
measured in HP.\pIf your POKéMON lose their HP,
you can restore them at any\lPOKéMON CENTER.\pIf you're going to travel far away,
the smart TRAINER stocks up on\lPOTIONS at the POKéMON MART.\pMake me proud, honey!\pTake care!$
